{"decision":{"adopted_chinese":"这个盒子里满是堕落巫师的奇异实验残留。打开它可能会释放一只友好的变异兽：\n每只奇异的生物都有自己的一套特质。魔力释放技能越强，释放出的野兽就越强。\n\n有六种已知的特质：\n ＊蝙蝠野兽能飞行且十分迅捷，但行动失序。\n ＊火焰野兽能抵抗并喷吐火焰。\n ＊公牛野兽耐寒，皮毛厚实，能击退敌人。\n ＊电击野兽能抵抗电流并能变形成活体闪电。\n ＊刺叮野兽能抵抗毒素，并以可隔格攻击的毒尾刺击敌人。\n ＊诡秘野兽能看见隐形生物并用触手进行束缚攻击。\n\n据目前所知，每只野兽都恰好具有上述两种特质。","adopted_english":"A box filled with the bizarre leftovers of a depraved wizard's magical\nexperimentations. {"decision":{"adopted_chinese":"一个蜈蚣盘绕石头的微小雕像。紧握它，就会使其变成与你身体融合的活体武器。\n这件武器相当于能延伸攻击的短刃，攻击可以使目标中毒。\n\n用这件武器攻击一定次数后，它会脱离持用者的身体，作为独立盟友\n与你并肩作战片刻，随后死亡。\n\n变形术技能会提高这只蜈蚣在武器与昆虫形态下的力量，以及毒素的效力，\n最终使其有时甚至能让敌人减速或麻痹。","adopted_english":"A tiny figurine of a centipede coiled around a stone. {"decision":{"adopted_chinese":"一本关于电对从锯末到斯诺兹黄瓜等一切事物影响的详尽研究笔记汇编，\n穿插着法术公式和可用的技术图解。作者在关于小精灵电生理学的章节中，\n笔迹恶化得令人震惊，引发了关于其身份及其自我保护意识的诸多猜测。","adopted_english":"An exhaustive collection of research notes on the effects of electricity upon\neverything from sawdust to snozzcumbers, interspersed with spell formulae and\nusable technical schematics. {"decision":{"adopted_chinese":"一本关于攻城战的分析性专论，以清晰易懂的方式撰写。\n大部分章节涉及后勤和补给线维护，但有几章详述了用于突破防御工事\n（以及其他更柔软之物）的法术。","adopted_english":"An analytical treatise on siege warfare, written in a clear and readable manner.\nA majority of its chapters are concerned with logistics and the maintenance of\nsupply lines, but several detail spells useful for breaching fortifications\n(and also other, softer, things).","consumer":"item_def::name(DESC_DBNAME) -> getLongDescription","current_chinese":"一本关于攻城战的分析性专论，以清晰易懂的方式撰写。\n大部分章节涉及后勤和补给线维护，但有几章详述了用于突破防御工事\n（以及其他更柔软之物）的法术。","english_source":"An analytical treatise on siege warfare, written in a clear and readable manner.\nA majority of its chapters are concerned with logistics and the maintenance of\nsupply lines, but several detail spells useful for breaching fortifications\n(and also other, softer, things).","input":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt","lifecycle":"current","metadata":{"category":"item-description","description_key":"compendium of siegecraft"},"pre_review_chinese":"一本关于攻城战的分析性专论，以清晰易懂的方式撰写。\n大部分章节涉及后勤和补给线维护，但有几章详述了用于突破防御工事\n（以及其他更柔软之物）的法术。","producer":"DescriptionDB key compendium of siegecraft","reentry_trigger":"Re-review if this identity's logical source dependencies, decision fields, or glossary authority change.","semantic_reason":"keep: item-description:compendium of siegecraft at DescriptionDB key compendium of siegecraft -> item_def::name(DESC_DBNAME) -> getLongDescription has no adopted semantic field differing from the review base; the adopted rendering preserves the accepted meaning, terminology, grammar identity, and gameplay-facing consumer.","terminal_conclusion":"keep"},"identity":"item-description:compendium of siegecraft","source_dependencies":[]}
{"decision":{"adopted_chinese":"这件魔法装置能将周围的能量凝结成各种具有破坏性的云。\n激活时，这些云会在使用者附近的敌对怪物周围形成。\n云的数量和杀伤力会随魔力释放技能的提升而增加。\n威力较低时，它会生成毒烟；随着威力提高，毒烟会让位于咆哮的烈焰、冰冻蒸汽和毒气。\n威力处于最高几档时，还可生成风暴云、酸雾和带来极度痛苦的云雾。","adopted_english":"A magical device that condenses ambient energy into various destructive clouds.\nWhen evoked these clouds form around hostile monsters near the user. The\nquantity and lethality of these clouds increases with Evocations skill. At low\npower it will create noxious fumes, and as power increases this gives way to\nroaring flames, freezing vapours, and poisonous gas. At the highest tiers of\npower storm clouds, acidic fog and clouds of excruciating misery become\navailable.","consumer":"item_def::name(DESC_DBNAME) -> getLongDescription","current_chinese":"这件魔法装置能将周围的能量凝结成各种具有破坏性的云。\n激活时，这些云会在使用者附近的敌对怪物周围形成。\n云的数量和杀伤力会随魔力释放技能的提升而增加。\n威力较低时，它会生成毒烟；随着威力提高，毒烟会让位于咆哮的烈焰、冰冻蒸汽和毒气。\n威力处于最高几档时，还可生成风暴云、酸雾和带来极度痛苦的云雾。","english_source":"A magical device that condenses ambient energy into various destructive clouds.\nWhen evoked these clouds form around hostile monsters near the user. {"decision":{"adopted_chinese":"一件精致的雕刻品，镶嵌着龙牙和龙鳞。{{\n    local race = you.race()\n    local desc = \"将佩戴者变成强大的\"\n\n    if race:find(\"Draconian\") then\n        desc = desc .. \"龙。佩戴者能抵抗毒\"\n        if race == \"Draconian\" then\n            desc = desc .. \"、火和寒。\"\n        else\n            desc = desc .. \"，先天吐息攻击的威力和充能速度都会大幅提高。\"\n        end\n    else\n        desc = desc .. \"金龙。佩戴者能抵抗火、寒和毒，\" ..\n                       \"并获得强大的吐息攻击，造成火焰和寒冷伤害，并留下毒云，\" ..\n                       \"但只能通过获取经验值来充能。\"\n    end\n    return desc\n}}","adopted_english":"An intricate carving, inlaid with dragon tooth and scale. {{\n    local race = you.race()\n    local desc = \"Transforms the wearer into a mighty\"\n\n    if race:find(\"Draconian\") then\n        desc = desc .. \" dragon. {"decision":{"adopted_chinese":"一个装有令人不安发光物质的小玻璃球。捏碎它将使你充满变形能量，\n使你的物理形态在基本层面上变得不稳定。\n\n在这种变形状态下，你的近战攻击弱得多，但每次命中都会用变形能量污染\n目标——对同一目标的第三次命中会使能量积蓄得如此强烈，以至于令其身体\n扭曲变形，造成显著伤害。物理形态的不确定性也使你更难被击中，\n尽管你发光的方式会妨碍潜行。\n\n每个小球中蕴含的力量是有限的，一旦通过传播给敌人而耗尽，\n你将恢复之前的形态。","adopted_english":"A small glass bauble containing an ominously glowing substance. Crushing it will\nflood you with transmutational energy, leaving your physical form unstable at a\nfundamental level.\n\nIn this state of flux, your melee attacks are much weaker, but each strike will\ncontaminate whatever you hit with transmutational energy - growing so intense\nupon the third strike that it will cause their body to twist and deform,\ninflicting significant damage. The lack of certainty in your physical form also\nmakes you much harder to hit, though you glow in a way that hinders stealth.\n\nThe power contained in each bauble is finite, and once it is exhausted by\nspreading it to enemies, you will return to your previous form.","consumer":"item_def::name(DESC_DBNAME) -> getLongDescription","current_chinese":"一个装有令人不安发光物质的小玻璃球。捏碎它将使你充满变形能量，\n使你的物理形态在基本层面上变得不稳定。\n\n在这种变形状态下，你的近战攻击弱得多，但每次命中都会用变形能量污染\n目标——对同一目标的第三次命中会使能量积蓄得如此强烈，以至于令其身体\n扭曲变形，造成显著伤害。物理形态的不确定性也使你更难被击中，\n尽管你发光的方式会妨碍潜行。\n\n每个小球中蕴含的力量是有限的，一旦通过传播给敌人而耗尽，\n你将恢复之前的形态。","english_source":"A small glass bauble containing an ominously glowing substance. {"decision":{"adopted_chinese":"一个用贝壳碎片雕刻而成的微型城垛。它会将佩戴者变成一只重甲螃蟹，\n把身上的身体护甲融入甲壳，并放大其大部分效益。在此形态下，\n佩戴者移动缓慢，却防御出色，甚至能用巨大的主螯持用双手武器。\n虽然如此笨重，却十分适应水中环境。还能消耗自身生命值喷吐锈蚀云雾，\n腐蚀并削弱敌人。","adopted_english":"A miniature battlement, carved from a piece of shell. In this form, they are slow-moving,\nbut well-defended and even capable of wielding a two-handed weapon in their\nlarge main claw. Despite all this bulk, they are well-adapted to the water. They\ncan also breathe clouds of rust at the cost of their own HP, which corrode and\nweaken enemies.","consumer":"item_def::name(DESC_DBNAME) -> getLongDescription","current_chinese":"一个用贝壳碎片雕刻而成的微型城垛。它会将佩戴者变成一只重甲螃蟹，\n把身上的身体护甲融入甲壳，并放大其大部分效益。在此形态下，\n佩戴者移动缓慢，却防御出色，甚至能用巨大的主螯持用双手武器。\n虽然如此笨重，却十分适应水中环境。还能消耗自身生命值喷吐锈蚀云雾，\n腐蚀并削弱敌人。","english_source":"A miniature battlement, carved from a piece of shell. Transforms the wearer into\na heavily armoured crab, fusing whatever body armour they are wearing into the\nshell and magnifying most of its benefits. In this form, they are slow-moving,\nbut well-defended and even capable of wielding a two-handed weapon in their\nlarge main claw. Despite all this bulk, they are well-adapted to the water. They\ncan also breathe clouds of rust at the cost of their own HP, which corrode and\nweaken enemies.","input":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt","lifecycle":"current","metadata":{"category":"item-description","description_key":"fortress talisman"},"pre_review_chinese":"一个从贝壳碎片雕刻而成的微型城垛。将佩戴者变成一只重甲螃蟹，\n在此过程中将其穿戴的身体护甲融入壳中。在此形态下，它们移动缓慢，\n但防御良好，甚至能用其大螯持有武器。尽管如此笨重，\n它们非常适应水中环境。它们还可以消耗自身生命值喷吐锈蚀云雾，\n腐蚀并削弱敌人。","producer":"DescriptionDB key fortress talisman","reentry_trigger":"Re-review if this identity's logical source dependencies, decision fields, or glossary authority change.","semantic_reason":"adjust: item-description:fortress talisman at DescriptionDB key fortress talisman -> item_def::name(DESC_DBNAME) -> getLongDescription changes display/component Chinese; the candidate adopts that targeted wording or structural correction while preserving the same gameplay identity.","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"},"identity":"item-description:fortress talisman","source_dependencies":[]}
{"decision":{"adopted_chinese":"一条危急时脱落的尾巴留下的干枯残骸。它会让使用者部分变成迷魂壁虎，\n一种变色能力非凡的爬行动物。它们的皮肤会自然变色，与周围环境融为一体，\n使其善于潜行；严重受伤时，它们会本能地脱落尾巴，让尾巴闪烁鲜艳的色彩作为诱饵，\n从而逃走，甚至从盲区袭击那些分心的捕食者。","adopted_english":"The dried remains of a tail shed under duress. {"decision":{"adopted_chinese":"一面铜和钨制成的铃鼓，在你的手中兴奋地振动着，仿佛渴望被使用。\n\n正如音乐将人们聚到一起，以正确的节奏摇动它将把一大群怪物吸引到\n一个狭窄的空间中，并用无法逃脱的碾压重力波将所有敌对目标\n固定在原地一小段时间。\n\n效果范围和持续时间随魔力释放技能提升。","adopted_english":"A copper and tungsten tambourine that vibrates excitedly in your hands, as if\neager to be used.\n\nJust as music brings people together, shaking it with the proper rhythm will\ndraw a large group of monsters into a narrow space and hold any hostile ones in\nplace for a short time with inescapable waves of crushing gravity.\n\nThe area of effect and duration increases with Evocations skill.","consumer":"item_def::name(DESC_DBNAME) -> getLongDescription","current_chinese":"一面铜和钨制成的铃鼓，在你的手中兴奋地振动着，仿佛渴望被使用。\n\n正如音乐将人们聚到一起，以正确的节奏摇动它将把一大群怪物吸引到\n一个狭窄的空间中，并用无法逃脱的碾压重力波将所有敌对目标\n固定在原地一小段时间。\n\n效果范围和持续时间随魔力释放技能提升。","english_source":"A copper and tungsten tambourine that vibrates excitedly in your hands, as if\neager to be used.\n\nJust as music brings people together, shaking it with the proper rhythm will\ndraw a large group of monsters into a narrow space and hold any hostile ones in\nplace for a short time with inescapable waves of crushing gravity.\n\nThe area of effect and duration increases with Evocations skill.","input":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt","lifecycle":"current","metadata":{"category":"item-description","description_key":"gell's gravitambourine"},"pre_review_chinese":"一面铜和钨制成的铃鼓，在你的手中兴奋地振动着，仿佛渴望被使用。\n\n正如音乐将人们聚到一起，以正确的节奏摇动它将把一大群怪物吸引到\n一个狭窄的空间中，并用无法逃脱的碾压重力波将所有敌对目标\n固定在原地一小段时间。\n\n效果范围和持续时间随激活技能提升。","producer":"DescriptionDB key gell's gravitambourine","reentry_trigger":"Re-review if this identity's logical source dependencies, decision fields, or glossary authority change.","semantic_reason":"adjust: item-description:gell's gravitambourine at DescriptionDB key gell's gravitambourine -> item_def::name(DESC_DBNAME) -> getLongDescription changes display/component Chinese; the candidate adopts that targeted wording or structural correction while preserving the same gameplay identity.","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"},"identity":"item-description:gell's gravitambourine","source_dependencies":[]}
{"decision":{"adopted_chinese":"一块美得超凡脱俗的石头，在地牢之外价值几乎难以估量。\n但在地牢之内，它毫无用处。\n\n佐特小心翼翼地贮藏着这些宝石，\n冒险者进入存放宝石的地牢分支后不久，佐特就会恶意地打碎相应宝石。\n然而，一个行动极其迅速的冒险者有机会抓到一个宝石，并保留其珍贵的碎片。\n佐特无法在存放宝石的原分支之外继续追踪它，\n因此，如果有真正惊人的速度，是有可能带着一颗完好无损的宝石成功逃脱……\n然而这样的壮举简直是天方夜谭，而且可能毫无意义。\n\n一旦佐特宝珠被拿走，佐特将无法打碎任何宝石。","adopted_english":"A stone of unearthly beauty and almost immeasurable value outside the dungeon.\nWithin its confines, it is utterly useless.\n\nZot hoards these gems jealously, and will spitefully smash them soon after an\nadventurer enters the branch of the Dungeon in which they rest. Still, a very\nquick-moving adventurer might seize one first and keep its precious shards.\nZot cannot track gems outside their home branches, so with truly astonishing\nspeed, it might be possible to abscond with one still intact... but such a\nfeat is difficult to credit, and likely pointless besides.\n\nOnce the Orb of Zot is taken, Zot will be unable to smash any gems.","consumer":"item_def::name(DESC_DBNAME) -> getLongDescription","current_chinese":"一块美得超凡脱俗的石头，在地牢之外价值几乎难以估量。\n但在地牢之内，它毫无用处。\n\n佐特小心翼翼地贮藏着这些宝石，\n冒险者进入存放宝石的地牢分支后不久，佐特就会恶意地打碎相应宝石。\n然而，一个行动极其迅速的冒险者有机会抓到一个宝石，并保留其珍贵的碎片。\n佐特无法在存放宝石的原分支之外继续追踪它，\n因此，如果有真正惊人的速度，是有可能带着一颗完好无损的宝石成功逃脱……\n然而这样的壮举简直是天方夜谭，而且可能毫无意义。\n\n一旦佐特宝珠被拿走，佐特将无法打碎任何宝石。","english_source":"A stone of unearthly beauty and almost immeasurable value outside the dungeon.\nWithin its confines, it is utterly useless.\n\nZot hoards these gems jealously, and will spitefully smash them soon after an\nadventurer enters the branch of the Dungeon in which they rest. Still, a very\nquick-moving adventurer might seize one first and keep its precious shards.\nZot cannot track gems outside their home branches, so with truly astonishing\nspeed, it might be possible to abscond with one still intact... but such a\nfeat is difficult to credit, and likely pointless besides.\n\nOnce the Orb of Zot is taken, Zot will be unable to smash any gems.","input":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt","lifecycle":"current","metadata":{"category":"item-description","description_key":"gem"},"pre_review_chinese":"一块来自地牢之外美丽绝伦、价值难以估量的石头。在它的范围内，它是完全无用的。\n\n佐特小心翼翼地贮藏着这些宝石，\n一旦冒险者进入存在宝石的地牢分支，佐特就会恶意地打碎相应宝石。\n然而，一个行动极其迅速的冒险者有机会抓到一个宝石，并保留其珍贵的碎片。\n佐特无法在存放宝石的原分支之外继续追踪它，\n因此，如果有真正惊人的速度，是有可能带着一颗完好无损的宝石成功逃脱……\n然而这样的壮举简直是天方夜谭，而且可能毫无意义。\n\n一旦佐特宝珠被拿走，佐特将无法打碎任何宝石。","producer":"DescriptionDB key gem","reentry_trigger":"Re-review if this identity's logical source dependencies, decision fields, or glossary authority change.","semantic_reason":"adjust: item-description:gem at DescriptionDB key gem -> item_def::name(DESC_DBNAME) -> getLongDescription changes display/component Chinese; the candidate adopts that targeted wording or structural correction while preserving the same gameplay identity.","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"},"identity":"item-description:gem","source_dependencies":[]}

{"decision":{"adopted_chinese":"一个用多色玉石雕刻而成的小雕像，静静震颤着力量。\n它会使大片与元素共鸣的晶体从佩戴者的头部和上身长出，如衣般覆盖身体，\n提高其对火焰、寒冰、大地和空气魔法的掌握，却削弱其他所有学派。\n\n每次佩戴者施放这四个学派之一的法术，都会为相应晶体充能，\n并释放一阵造成伤害的魔法。如果四块晶体同时充满能量，\n佩戴者的抗性与韧性就会暂时增强。","adopted_english":"A small statuette carved out of multi-hued jade which thrums with quiet power.\nCauses a great mantle of elementally-attuned crystal to grow out of the wearer's\nhead and upper body, increasing their proficiency with fire, ice, earth, and air\nmagic, but impairing all other schools.\n\nEach time the wearer casts a spell from one of those four schools, it will\nempower the corresponding crystal and unleash a burst of damaging magic. {"decision":{"adopted_chinese":"一个不断涌出烟雾的小香炉，会将佩戴者的头部变成翻腾的雾团。\n在此形态下饮用的药水会迅速分解成气体，佩戴者能通过近战攻击将其喷出，\n释放成有害的云雾。还能缓慢凝结地牢中的空气，制成雾药水，\n让自己变得没有实体，并使怪物失明。\n\n不过，缺少正常的口腔结构会使咒语难以发音，大幅减慢施法速度。","adopted_english":"A small censer from which pours an endless smoky haze. {"decision":{"adopted_chinese":"隐形时，大多数怪物攻击你的命中率会大幅降低，无法发动借机攻击，\n施放的法术有时也会瞄准错误的位置。它们还可能四处踉跄，最终失去你的踪迹，\n智力较低的怪物尤其如此。\n\n此外，你对这些生物发动近战攻击时，有一定几率打它们一个措手不及，\n造成更高伤害；这一几率与你的潜行和武器技能成正比，使用短刃时尤其有效。\n\n某些生物能看穿这种隐形，而站在水中时，隐形总会完全失效。","adopted_english":"While invisible, most monsters have greatly reduced accuracy against you,\ncannot make attacks of opportunity, and the spells they cast may sometimes be\naimed at the wrong location. They may also stumble around and eventually lose\ntrack of you, especially if their intelligence is low.\n\nIn addition, melee attacks you make against such creatures have a chance\n(proportional to your stealth and weapon skill) of catching them off-guard and\ndealing increased damage, especially if performed with a short blade.\n\nCertain creatures can see through this invisibility and it will always be\ncompletely ineffective while standing in water.","consumer":"item_def::name(DESC_DBNAME) -> getLongDescription","current_chinese":"隐形时，大多数怪物攻击你的命中率会大幅降低，无法发动借机攻击，\n施放的法术有时也会瞄准错误的位置。它们还可能四处踉跄，最终失去你的踪迹，\n智力较低的怪物尤其如此。\n\n此外，你对这些生物发动近战攻击时，有一定几率打它们一个措手不及，\n造成更高伤害；这一几率与你的潜行和武器技能成正比，使用短刃时尤其有效。\n\n某些生物能看穿这种隐形，而站在水中时，隐形总会完全失效。","english_source":"While invisible, most monsters have greatly reduced accuracy against you,\ncannot make attacks of opportunity, and the spells they cast may sometimes be\naimed at the wrong location. They may also stumble around and eventually lose\ntrack of you, especially if their intelligence is low.\n\nIn addition, melee attacks you make against such creatures have a chance\n(proportional to your stealth and weapon skill) of catching them off-guard and\ndealing increased damage, especially if performed with a short blade.\n\nCertain creatures can see through this invisibility and it will always be\ncompletely ineffective while standing in water.","input":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt","lifecycle":"current","metadata":{"category":"item-description","description_key":"player invis desc"},"pre_review_chinese":null,"producer":"DescriptionDB key player invis desc","reentry_trigger":"Re-review if this identity's logical source dependencies, decision fields, or glossary authority change.","semantic_reason":"adjust: item-description:player invis desc at DescriptionDB key player invis desc -> item_def::name(DESC_DBNAME) -> getLongDescription changes display/component Chinese; the candidate adopts that targeted wording or structural correction while preserving the same gameplay identity.","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"},"identity":"item-description:player invis desc","source_dependencies":[]}

{"decision":{"adopted_chinese":"这瓶药水能让饮用者陷入一种失去理智的狂暴状态，\n极大地但暂时地提升其生命值、伤害力和速度。\n作为代价，他们的心智会被愤怒所蒙蔽，只能进行移动和近战攻击。\n如果不攻击怪物，狂暴状态会迅速消退；状态结束后，饮用者将陷入疲惫，\n行动大幅减缓，并在短时间内无法再次狂暴。","adopted_english":"A potion which can send one into an incoherent rage, granting them a great but\ntemporary increase to their health, damage, and speed. {"decision":{"adopted_chinese":"这瓶药水会将饮用者变成一棵会动的榕树，以树液为血，枝干能够持用武器。\n这种树的闪避能力极低，但生命值和天然护甲得到增强，具有毒素抗性，\n并免疫负能量、折磨、睡眠和致盲，也无需呼吸。\n\n然而，在变化持续期间，它会扎根原地，无法传送。","adopted_english":"A potion which transforms the imbiber into an animated banyan tree, with sap for\nblood and branches capable of holding weapons. {"decision":{"adopted_chinese":"[[gem]]\n\n一些人击败了死神，把自己埋在自己建造的坟墓里，而且并不耻于自己的野心。\n他们的主出于对小玩意儿的喜好和自负，把这颗宝石戴在胸前，\n进入了他们永恒的动荡之中。","adopted_english":"[[gem]]\n\nThey who smote down Death herself and buried themselves in a Tomb of their own\nmaking were not shy of their ambitions. {"decision":{"adopted_chinese":"一瓶翻涌的鲜血，随着一颗无形心脏的搏动而脉动。\n它会将佩戴者变成可怕的吸血鬼，一种徘徊于生与不死边界的生物。\n佩戴者可以吸取活物的生命之血来治疗自己，甚至将潜行击杀的生物变成吸血仆从，\n但察觉到附近有构成威胁的敌人时，常规生命值再生就会停止。\n其催眠目光往往能使被惊动的怪物无法喊叫，甚至可能令其眩晕。\n还能费力地散成一群蝙蝠，用来逃跑或攻击敌人。","adopted_english":"A vial of roiling blood that pulses with the beat of an unseen heart. Transforms\nthe wearer into a fearsome vampire - a creature that straddles the border between\nlife and undeath. They can drink the lifeblood of the living to heal themselves,\nand even turn those they slay stealthily into vampiric thralls, but their normal\nhealth regeneration stops while they are aware of nearby threatening enemies.\nTheir hypnotic gaze often prevents monsters from shouting when alerted and may\neven daze them. At great effort, they can also\nscatter into a swarm of bats - either to flee or to assail their enemies.","consumer":"item_def::name(DESC_DBNAME) -> getLongDescription","current_chinese":"一瓶翻涌的鲜血，随着一颗无形心脏的搏动而脉动。\n它会将佩戴者变成可怕的吸血鬼，一种徘徊于生与不死边界的生物。\n佩戴者可以吸取活物的生命之血来治疗自己，甚至将潜行击杀的生物变成吸血仆从，\n但察觉到附近有构成威胁的敌人时，常规生命值再生就会停止。\n其催眠目光往往能使被惊动的怪物无法喊叫，甚至可能令其眩晕。\n还能费力地散成一群蝙蝠，用来逃跑或攻击敌人。","english_source":"A vial of roiling blood that pulses with the beat of an unseen heart. Transforms\nthe wearer into a fearsome vampire - a creature that straddles the border between\nlife and undeath. They can drink the lifeblood of the living to heal themselves,\nand even turn those they slay stealthily into vampiric thralls, but their normal\nhealth regeneration stops while they are aware of nearby threatening enemies.\nTheir hypnotic gaze often prevents monsters from shouting when alerted and may\neven daze them. At great effort, they can also\nscatter into a swarm of bats - either to flee or to assail their enemies.","input":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt","lifecycle":"current","metadata":{"category":"item-description","description_key":"sanguine talisman"},"pre_review_chinese":"一瓶翻涌的鲜血，随着一颗无形心脏的搏动而脉动。将佩戴者变成一个\n可怕的吸血鬼——一种跨越生命与亡灵界限的生物。它们可以吸取活物的\n生命之血来治愈自己，甚至可以将那些潜行击杀的生物变成吸血仆从，\n但在有怪物时不会自然恢复。在巨大努力下，它们可以散开成一群蝙蝠——\n要么逃跑，要么攻击敌人。","producer":"DescriptionDB key sanguine talisman","reentry_trigger":"Re-review if this identity's logical source dependencies, decision fields, or glossary authority change.","semantic_reason":"adjust: item-description:sanguine talisman at DescriptionDB key sanguine talisman -> item_def::name(DESC_DBNAME) -> getLongDescription changes display/component Chinese; the candidate adopts that targeted wording or structural correction while preserving the same gameplay identity.","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"},"identity":"item-description:sanguine talisman","source_dependencies":[]}

{"decision":{"adopted_chinese":"这张卷轴能给武器加上一个随机的铭印。\n任何已有的铭印会被一个不同的替代，且不会加上你当前的神所抵触的铭印。\n神器无法以这种方式获得铭印。\n\n近战武器通常会获得火焰、冰冻、重击、淬毒或防护铭印，\n（或该类武器专属的特殊铭印），但很少会被印上汲取、电击、幽魂、吸血或混沌铭印。\n\n远程武器通常会获得火焰、冰冻、重击或汲取铭印，\n但很少会获得电击或混沌铭印。","adopted_english":"A scroll that imbues a weapon with a random brand. {"decision":{"adopted_chinese":"一件由蜕下的蛛形纲外骨骼用蜘蛛丝捆扎成的奇异护符。将佩戴者变成\n一只敏捷的跳蛛，能迅速向敌人移动，并对任何被其发现的毫无防备者\n造成重创。它不会被网困住，但其攻击可以将敌人困入网中。\n它也可以迅速跳离许多危险。","adopted_english":"A strange charm made from shed arachnid exoskeletons bound together with silk.\nTransforms the wearer into an agile jumping spider who can move swiftly towards\nfoes and inflict grievous damage on any it catches unaware. {"decision":{"adopted_chinese":"一个灰黑色的容器，以令人不安的仪式向其注入了黑暗的力量。\n它能将使用者变成对生命本身永不消亡的亵渎之物。\n\n被使用者用近战武器或手击中的敌人会被虚弱、减速、衰竭。\n使用者还可以通过折磨附近的活物敌人来治疗自己；提升变形术技能能增加治愈量。\n此外，使用者将能抵抗寒冷，意志力会增强，并免疫毒、瘴气、负能量和折磨。\n\n使用者还能从这副亡灵身躯中获得一些颇为可疑的好处。\n然而，使用者易受神圣攻击和驱散亡灵的伤害，且无法服用药水。","adopted_english":"A grey-black vessel, infused with dark power through a sickening ritual.\nTransforms the wearer into an undying offence against life itself.\n\nFoes struck by wearer's melee weapons or hands are weakened, slowed, and drained.\nThe wearer can also heal themself by tormenting living foes nearby; Shapeshifting\nskill increases the amount healed. Further, the wearer resists cold, has enhanced\nwillpower, and is immune to poison, miasma, negative energy, and torment.\n\nThe wearer also gains some of the more dubious benefits of having an undead body.\nThey are vulnerable to holy damage and Dispel Undead, and cannot consume potions.","consumer":"item_def::name(DESC_DBNAME) -> getLongDescription","current_chinese":"一个灰黑色的容器，以令人不安的仪式向其注入了黑暗的力量。\n它能将使用者变成对生命本身永不消亡的亵渎之物。\n\n被使用者用近战武器或手击中的敌人会被虚弱、减速、衰竭。\n使用者还可以通过折磨附近的活物敌人来治疗自己；提升变形术技能能增加治愈量。\n此外，使用者将能抵抗寒冷，意志力会增强，并免疫毒、瘴气、负能量和折磨。\n\n使用者还能从这副亡灵身躯中获得一些颇为可疑的好处。\n然而，使用者易受神圣攻击和驱散亡灵的伤害，且无法服用药水。","english_source":"A grey-black vessel, infused with dark power through a sickening ritual.\nTransforms the wearer into an undying offence against life itself.\n\nFoes struck by wearer's melee weapons or hands are weakened, slowed, and drained.\nThe wearer can also heal themself by tormenting living foes nearby; Shapeshifting\nskill increases the amount healed. {"decision":{"adopted_chinese":"一组休眠的、有磁性的土元素，外形是微小的、非常重的鹅卵石。\n当释放时，元素会被磁力吸引到附近怪物的中心，\n在那里，它们会因在休眠时被扰动而愤怒地爆炸。\n震颤石通常会稍微偏离目标，并且使用者总有被击中的风险。\n然而，护甲在抵挡震颤石的爆炸中所迸发的轻质岩石碎片非常有效，\n所以一个护甲精良的使用者没什么好担心的。提升魔力释放技能能增加爆炸次数。","adopted_english":"A set of dormant, magnetic earth elementals in the form of tiny, very heavy\npebbles. When released, the elementals are drawn magnetically to the center of\nnearby monsters, where they literally explode with rage at their rest being\ndisturbed. Tremorstones usually land slightly off-target, and the user is\nalways at risk of being hit. However, armour is extremely effective at\nrepelling the lightweight fragments of rock from a tremorstone's explosion, so\na well-armoured wielder has little to fear. {"decision":{"adopted_chinese":"一本分析性的著作，讨论构建令人眼花缭乱的各种陷阱的方法和材料——\n从旨在保护储藏室免受蚂蚁侵害的陷阱，到连最虐待狂的地牢建筑师\n都会满意的陷阱。","adopted_english":"An analytical volume discussing methods and materials with which to construct a\ndizzying array of traps - from those intended to safeguard a pantry from ants to\nones which would please even the most sadistic dungeon architect.","consumer":"item_def::name(DESC_DBNAME) -> getLongDescription","current_chinese":"一本分析性的著作，讨论构建令人眼花缭乱的各种陷阱的方法和材料——\n从旨在保护储藏室免受蚂蚁侵害的陷阱，到连最虐待狂的地牢建筑师\n都会满意的陷阱。","english_source":"An analytical volume discussing methods and materials with which to construct a\ndizzying array of traps - from those intended to safeguard a pantry from ants to\nones which would please even the most sadistic dungeon architect.","input":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt","lifecycle":"current","metadata":{"category":"item-description","description_key":"treatise on traps"},"pre_review_chinese":"一本分析性的著作，讨论构建令人眼花缭乱的各种陷阱的方法和材料——\n从旨在保护储藏室免受蚂蚁侵害的陷阱，到连最虐待狂的地牢建筑师\n都会满意的陷阱。","producer":"DescriptionDB key treatise on traps","reentry_trigger":"Re-review if this identity's logical source dependencies, decision fields, or glossary authority change.","semantic_reason":"keep: item-description:treatise on traps at DescriptionDB key treatise on traps -> item_def::name(DESC_DBNAME) -> getLongDescription has no adopted semantic field differing from the review base; the adopted rendering preserves the accepted meaning, terminology, grammar identity, and gameplay-facing consumer.","terminal_conclusion":"keep"},"identity":"item-description:treatise on traps","source_dependencies":[]}

{"decision":{"adopted_chinese":"一个带有眼睛图样的小护符，会赋予佩戴者超自然的视觉，\n让其看见生物施法时留下的魔法残余云雾。触碰这些云雾，\n便能将残余魔法转化为必定命中的投射物，攻击附近敌人。\n\n这第三只眼甚至能让人看见比原本更远的地方{{\n    if you.get_base_mutation_level(\"+LOS\") > 0 then\n        return \"（不过，你自身的视野已经达到极限）。\"\n    else\n        return \"，但要当心——你以这种方式看到的生物也会看到你。\"\n    end\n}}","adopted_english":"A small charm bearing the likeness of an eye. {"decision":{"adopted_chinese":"一个似乎能涌出无尽之水的小型双耳瓶。它会将佩戴者的血肉变成元素之水，\n使其能够灵活移动，从很远的距离延伸攻击，但在远处无法完成偷袭所需的精确动作。\n佩戴者时而甚至能让周围的水升起，淹没敌人。\n\n这种水的可塑性保留了佩戴者生理构造的其他大部分特征，如血液与骨骼，\n甚至能保留其身体变异带来的好处，但寒冷攻击能将其冻成固体，\n火焰则可能使其迸发蒸汽。","adopted_english":"A small amphora from which pours a seemingly unending quantity of water.\nTransforms the wearer's flesh into elemental water, allowing them to move flexibly\nand reach to attack from a great distance, though without the precision needed\nto stab from range. From time to time, they can even cause the water around them\nto rise up and drown their enemies.\n\nThe malleability of this water preserves most other aspects of the wearer's\nphysiology such as their blood and bones, and even allows them to retain the\nbenefits of their physical mutations, but cold attacks can freeze it solid and\nfire may cause it to erupt with steam.","consumer":"item_def::name(DESC_DBNAME) -> getLongDescription","current_chinese":"一个似乎能涌出无尽之水的小型双耳瓶。它会将佩戴者的血肉变成元素之水，\n使其能够灵活移动，从很远的距离延伸攻击，但在远处无法完成偷袭所需的精确动作。\n佩戴者时而甚至能让周围的水升起，淹没敌人。\n\n这种水的可塑性保留了佩戴者生理构造的其他大部分特征，如血液与骨骼，\n甚至能保留其身体变异带来的好处，但寒冷攻击能将其冻成固体，\n火焰则可能使其迸发蒸汽。","english_source":"A small amphora from which pours a seemingly unending quantity of water.\nTransforms the wearer's flesh into elemental water, allowing them to move flexibly\nand reach to attack from a great distance, though without the precision needed\nto stab from range. From time to time, they can even cause the water around them\nto rise up and drown their enemies.\n\nThe malleability of this water preserves most other aspects of the wearer's\nphysiology such as their blood and bones, and even allows them to retain the\nbenefits of their physical mutations, but cold attacks can freeze it solid and\nfire may cause it to erupt with steam.","input":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt","lifecycle":"current","metadata":{"category":"item-description","description_key":"wellspring talisman"},"pre_review_chinese":"一个似乎能涌出无尽之水的小型双耳瓶。将佩戴者的肉体变成元素之水，\n使其能够灵活移动并从很远的距离攻击。\n偶尔，它们甚至可以让周围的水升起并淹死敌人。\n\n这种水的可塑性甚至允许它们保留物理变异的好处，但寒冷攻击可以将水\n冻结成固体，火焰可能导致其爆发出蒸汽。","producer":"DescriptionDB key wellspring talisman","reentry_trigger":"Re-review if this identity's logical source dependencies, decision fields, or glossary authority change.","semantic_reason":"adjust: item-description:wellspring talisman at DescriptionDB key wellspring talisman -> item_def::name(DESC_DBNAME) -> getLongDescription changes display/component Chinese; the candidate adopts that targeted wording or structural correction while preserving the same gameplay identity.","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"},"identity":"item-description:wellspring talisman","source_dependencies":[]}

{"decision":{"adopted_chinese":"暮星锤\"光辉\"","adopted_english":"eveningstar \"Brilliance\"","consumer":"get_artefact_name display; canonical English get_unrand_name_en TextDB lookup","current_chinese":"暮星锤\"光辉\"","english_source":"eveningstar \"Brilliance\"","input":"crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt","lifecycle":"current","metadata":{"category":"unrand","description_current_chinese":"伊莱德莱姆努尔在堕落不久后，试图将神圣能量扭曲成对自身的黑暗嘲讽，\n使其转而对抗其源头，并削弱其对亡灵和恶魔的效力。\n直到为时已晚，人们才发现如此彻底的扭曲是不可控的；污秽的火焰使注入的\n一切不稳或毁灭，除了几个恶魔实验体和一件被窃的神圣武器。\n一种较弱但更稳定的黑暗能量被证明是可行的，并为伊莱德莱姆努尔带来了暗影。\n\n这就是那件武器：一把光芒早已消逝的昏星锤——尽管它名为\"光辉\"，\n而其影子令那些它的光芒曾经抚慰过的人唯恐避之不及……","description_pre_review_chinese":"伊莱德莱姆努尔在堕落不久后，试图将神圣能量扭曲成对自身的黑暗嘲讽，\n使其转而对抗其源头，并削弱其对亡灵和恶魔的效力。\n直到为时已晚，人们才发现如此彻底的扭曲是不可控的；污秽的火焰使注入的\n一切不稳或毁灭，除了几个恶魔实验体和一件被窃的神圣武器。\n一种较弱但更稳定的黑暗能量被证明是可行的，并为伊莱德莱姆努尔带来了暗影。\n\n这就是那件武器：一把光芒早已消逝的昏星锤——尽管它名为\"光辉\"，\n而其影子令那些它的光芒曾经抚慰过的人唯恐避之不及……","description_present_at_review_base":true,"description_present_in_candidate":true},"pre_review_chinese":"暮星锤\"光辉\"","producer":"art-data.txt -> unranddata[]","reentry_trigger":"Re-review if this identity's logical source dependencies, decision fields, or glossary authority change.","semantic_reason":"keep: unrand:UNRAND_BRILLIANCE at art-data.txt -> unranddata[] -> get_artefact_name display; {"decision":{"adopted_chinese":"火龙神秘学者鳞甲","adopted_english":"fire dragon occultist's scales","consumer":"get_artefact_name display; canonical English get_unrand_name_en TextDB lookup","current_chinese":"火龙神秘学者鳞甲","english_source":"fire dragon occultist's scales","input":"crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt","lifecycle":"current","metadata":{"category":"unrand","description_current_chinese":"喷火巨龙兹米苏娅身上鸣响的鳞片。她是一位古老的神秘学者，喜好衰弱与毁灭。\n她与古龙奥术师因佐娅相爱相争，造成的破坏堪称传奇；为战胜彼此，\n双方不断寻求无穷无尽的神秘强化。即使到了今天，这些鳞片仍在嗡鸣，\n渴望在死亡之外，与对方留下的残骸再度交锋。","description_pre_review_chinese":"伟大的喷火龙兹姆苏亚的回响鳞片，她是一位喜爱衰弱与毁灭的古代秘法师。\n她与古龙奥术师因佐娅之间的爱恨竞争以其毁灭性而闻名，导致双方不断\n寻求无尽的秘法增强来战胜对方——即便是现在，这些鳞片仍然发出渴望\n在死亡之外与对方残骸对抗的低鸣。","description_present_at_review_base":true,"description_present_in_candidate":true},"pre_review_chinese":null,"producer":"art-data.txt -> unranddata[]","reentry_trigger":"Re-review if this identity's logical source dependencies, decision fields, or glossary authority change.","semantic_reason":"retranslate: unrand:UNRAND_FIRE_DRAGON_OCCULTIST_SCALES at art-data.txt -> unranddata[] -> get_artefact_name display; {"decision":{"adopted_chinese":"真菌拳斗篷","adopted_english":"fungal fisticloak","consumer":"get_artefact_name display; canonical English get_unrand_name_en TextDB lookup","current_chinese":"真菌拳斗篷","english_source":"fungal fisticloak","input":"crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt","lifecycle":"current","metadata":{"category":"unrand","description_current_chinese":"一位疯狂真菌学家的作品，他曾试图通过培育一种可以轻松携带而不打扰\n它们的物种来克服徘徊蘑菇的遗传焦虑。结果既是一件衣物，也是一个活的\n有机体，每根亚麻纤维都与真菌菌丝交织在一起，从佩戴者身上汲取营养\n和信心。作为对这些微不足道的血液或肽类物质的交换，菌落会本能地\n猛烈反击被它们视为威胁的任何东西来保护佩戴者。\n\n这就像同时穿着上千个小小的朋友！它们在黑暗中充满你心灵的嗡嗡声\n其实相当催人入睡……\n\n（这件物品也占据你的头盔槽位。）","description_pre_review_chinese":"一位疯狂真菌学家的作品，他曾试图通过培育一种可以轻松携带而不打扰\n它们的物种来克服徘徊蘑菇的遗传焦虑。结果既是一件衣物，也是一个活的\n有机体，每根亚麻纤维都与真菌菌丝交织在一起，从佩戴者身上汲取营养\n和信心。作为对这些微不足道的血液或肽类物质的交换，菌落会本能地\n猛烈反击被它们视为威胁的任何东西来保护佩戴者。\n\n这就像同时穿着上千个小小的朋友！它们在黑暗中充满你心灵的嗡嗡声\n其实相当令人安心……\n\n（这件物品也占据你的头盔槽位。）","description_present_at_review_base":true,"description_present_in_candidate":true},"pre_review_chinese":"真菌拳斗篷","producer":"art-data.txt -> unranddata[]","reentry_trigger":"Re-review if this identity's logical source dependencies, decision fields, or glossary authority change.","semantic_reason":"retranslate: unrand:UNRAND_FISTICLOAK at art-data.txt -> unranddata[] -> get_artefact_name display; {"decision":{"adopted_chinese":"冰龙奥术师鳞甲","adopted_english":"ice dragon arcanist's scales","consumer":"get_artefact_name display; canonical English get_unrand_name_en TextDB lookup","current_chinese":"冰龙奥术师鳞甲","english_source":"ice dragon arcanist's scales","input":"crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt","lifecycle":"current","metadata":{"category":"unrand","description_current_chinese":"喷霜巨龙因佐娅身上震颤的鳞片。她是一位古老的奥术师，喜好奇观与毁灭。\n她与古龙神秘学者兹米苏娅动荡不定的关系声名狼藉；为了争取更多和解的时间，\n双方不断寻求无穷无尽的神秘强化。即使到了今天，这些鳞片仍在回响，\n渴望在死亡之外，回到对方留下的残骸身边。","description_pre_review_chinese":"伟大的喷霜龙因佐娅的低鸣鳞片，她是一位喜爱壮观景象与毁灭的古代奥术师。\n她与古龙秘法师兹姆苏亚之间动荡的关系极为臭名昭著，导致双方不断寻求\n无尽的秘法增强以求更多时间来和解——即便是现在，这些鳞片仍然回荡着\n渴望在死亡之外回归对方残骸的饥渴。","description_present_at_review_base":true,"description_present_in_candidate":true},"pre_review_chinese":null,"producer":"art-data.txt -> unranddata[]","reentry_trigger":"Re-review if this identity's logical source dependencies, decision fields, or glossary authority change.","semantic_reason":"retranslate: unrand:UNRAND_ICE_DRAGON_ARCANIST_SCALES at art-data.txt -> unranddata[] -> get_artefact_name display; | body:items:acid dragon scales | <br>The scales of an acid dragon. Although it does not provide its wearer with as<br>much protection as the armour made from the scales of some larger dragons, it is<br>somewhat lighter and less encumbering. It is also remarkably smooth, letting<br>corrosive slime flow off it like water. | <br>一套酸龙鳞甲。尽管它不像一些由更大的龙的鳞片制成的护甲那样，<br>能为穿戴者提供更多的防护，但它却更轻便、妨碍也更少。<br>它也非常光滑，腐蚀性的黏液会像水那样从上面流走。 | keep | 较更大龙鳞甲防护低但更轻且负重少、光滑使腐蚀黏液流走三命题完整；未把抗腐蚀改作酸免疫。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:2；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:2；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:amulet of chemistry | <br>An amulet which allows the wearer to extract small amounts of magical energy<br>from any potion they drink and also enhances the power of their alchemy spells.<br>The magic restoration effect requires the amulet to attune itself to the<br>wearer's body while their reserves of magic are full. | <br>一条允许佩戴者从他们饮用的任何药水中提取少量法力的项链，<br>还能增强其炼金系法术的威力。法力恢复效果需要项链在法力储备<br>已满时与佩戴者的身体相协调。 | keep | 饮任意药水提少量MP、炼金威力增强、法力满时身体同调才回MP，条件和两个效益完整。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:9；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1393；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:amulet of dissipation | <br>An amulet which causes magic contamination and negative status effects upon the<br>wearer to expire twice as quickly with time. | <br>这条项链使佩戴者身上的诱变辐射和负面状态效果随时间消退的速度加倍。 | adjust | 诱变辐射及负面效果均随时间两倍消退；魔法污染术语错误且随时间流逝速度翻倍病句，须改消退速度。 确认问题：相同玩家机制 magical contamination 被写成魔法污染；不是环境污染。消散项链正文还将消退写成随时间流逝速度翻倍。 已修复 I-CONTAM：相同玩家机制 magical contamination 被写成魔法污染；不是环境污染。消散项链正文还将消退写成随时间流逝速度翻倍。；处理：采用诱变辐射，明确辐射与负面效果消退速度翻倍。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:16；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1399；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377；docs/glossary.md:820；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc:386；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:1889 |
| body:items:amulet of faith | <br>A charm crafted to call the attention of the gods to its wearer. This divine<br>attention makes it easier to please your god, but your god will also take more<br>notice of your transgressions. The amulet will drain some of your divine favour<br>when removed. | <br>这条精致的项链旨在引起神对佩戴者的留意。<br>在神的注意下会更易取悦你的神，但神也会更容易察觉到你的冒犯。<br>当这条项链被取下时，神会减少对你的好感。 | keep | 引神注意、好恶都更明显、卸下损部分神眷，未虚构只能提升无代价。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:21；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:8；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:amulet of guardian spirit | <br>An amulet containing a protective spirit which will cause any damage taken to<br>be divided between the wearer's reserves of health and magic. | <br>这条项链含有守护之灵，能将佩戴者受到的任何伤害<br>分摊到其生命值和法力储备上。 | adjust | 守护灵使任何所受伤在HP/MP储备分摊完整；分摊承受受到语病须删重复。 确认问题：分摊承受受到重复动词导致病句。 已修复 I-GUARDIAN-GRAMMAR：分摊承受受到重复动词导致病句。；处理：使受到的伤害在生命值与法力储备之间分摊。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:28；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:14；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:amulet of magic regeneration | <br>An amulet that increases the wearer's rate of magic regeneration. In order to<br>function, it must first attune itself to the wearer's body with full reserves<br>of magic. | <br>这条项链可以提升佩戴者的法力恢复速度。<br>佩戴期间法力全满时，它就会与身体完成同调，从而发挥作用。 | keep | 提高回MP、需要满MP同调后生效，当前中文佩戴期间与满储备正确。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:33；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:19；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:amulet of nothing | <br>An amulet with no special properties. | <br>这条项链没有特殊属性。 | keep | 无特殊属性，当前特殊生成而非普通可随机获得；简单文字无别义。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:39；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:24；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:amulet of reflection | <br>An amulet which improves its wearer's ability to shield against attacks. If<br>no shield is worn, the force the amulet emits can serve as a weak shield on<br>its own. Regardless, any ranged attacks the wearer blocks will be reflected<br>back toward the attacker. | <br>这条项链可以提升佩戴者格挡攻击的能力。<br>如果没有装备盾牌，这条项链本身就相当于较弱的盾牌。<br>无论是否装备盾牌，佩戴者格挡的远程攻击都会被反射回攻击者。 | keep | 增强格挡、无盾仍弱SH、所有格挡远程攻击反回攻击者；条件完整，不由能力名字虚构所有伤害均可反射。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:43；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:28；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:amulet of regeneration | <br>An amulet that increases the wearer's rate of health regeneration. In order to<br>function, it must first attune itself to the wearer's body at full health. | <br>这条项链可以增加佩戴者的生命值恢复速度。<br>佩戴期间生命值全满时，它就会与身体完成同调，从而发挥作用。 | keep | 提高回HP、满HP同调才有效，未和法力同调混淆。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:50；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:34；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:amulet of the acrobat | <br>An amulet that allows the user to tumble and roll to evade the blows of their<br>enemies, but only while moving and waiting. While taking other actions<br>(including climbing stairs) the amulet conveys no benefits. | <br>这条项链，能让佩戴者以翻滚的方式躲避敌人的攻击，<br>但这只会在移动和等待时生效。在进行其他动作（包括爬楼梯）时，<br>这条项链并不会带来相应正面效果。 | keep | 翻滚闪敌只移动等待、其他行动包括楼梯均无效，两个条件及例外齐全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:55；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:39；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:amulet of wildshape | <br>An amulet which improves its wearer's skill with Shapeshifting. | <br>一条提升佩戴者变形术技能的项链。 | keep | 提升变形术技能，不误称所有法术威力提升；数值在动态表。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:61；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1403；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:animal skin | <br>A large piece of thick skin covered in fur, cut from the corpse of an animal<br>and worn as a primitive garment. It offers rudimentary protection against harm,<br>but, having never been tanned, it carries a light stench of rotting flesh. | <br>一个从动物的尸体上切下的大块厚皮，上面还有毛，作为简陋的衣着。<br>它也能提供基础的保护以抵挡伤害。<br>由于没有鞣制过，这东西闻起来有一点腐肉的味道。 | keep | 动物尸取厚毛皮作原始衣、防基础伤、未鞣制轻腐肉臭，完整。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:65；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:45；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:arbalest | <br>A large piece of machinery used for firing bolts, braced with steel and cranked<br>with a windlass. It takes some time to load and fire. | <br>一架用于发射弩矢的巨大器械，以钢材加固，并用曲柄转动绞盘。<br>装填和发射都需要一些时间。 | keep | 大器械射弩矢、钢加固绞盘曲柄、装填发射耗时，物理形制和节奏齐全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:71；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:51；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:assassin centipede | <br>A living weapon whose forcipules are dagger-sharp and reach is long. Its sting<br>can deliver crippling toxins to those it strikes and at higher levels of<br>enchantment, can even briefly slow or paralyse foes.<br><br>After performing a moderate number of attacks with this, it will separate itself<br>from your body to attack foes independently for a short while before dying. | <br>一件活体武器，毒颚如匕首般锋利，攻击距离很远。<br>它的蜇刺会向命中的目标注入令人衰弱的毒素；附魔等级较高时，<br>甚至能让敌人短暂减速或麻痹。<br><br>用它攻击一定次数后，它会脱离你的身体，独立攻击敌人片刻，随后死亡。 | keep | 活武器利毒颚长触及、附魔高可短慢麻痹、适量攻击后离体独战片刻死亡；完整两段条件与顺序。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:76；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1678；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:athame | <br>An ornate and bewitched ritual knife. Even just wielding it will cost a small<br>piece of your health, but blows made with it against those suffering negative<br>statuses (other than poison) have increased base damage, up to +4 for two<br>such baleful ailments. | <br>一把华丽而施有魔法的仪式匕首。仅仅持用它就会消耗你少量生命值，<br>但用它攻击遭受负面状态（中毒除外）的目标时，基础伤害会增加。<br>目标同时遭受两种这样的有害状态时，增幅最多可达+4。 | keep | 仅持就耗健康、命中负面状态但排毒增强基础伤、两类负面至多+4；实际扣血/衰竭语义待装备路径核，不盲信health。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:85；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1407；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:azure gem | <br>[[gem]]<br><br>As clear and blue as a cloudless sky or a depthless sea, this gem holds its<br>secrets locked within impenetrable depths. | <br>[[gem]]<br><br>这颗宝石像万里无云的天空或深不可测的大海那样清澈湛蓝，<br>它那难以穿透的深处隐藏着不为人知的秘密。 | keep | gem引用保留，云天/深海两比喻、清蓝及不可穿透深藏秘密完整。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:92；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:56；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:baked corpse | <br>A baked corpse. Warm, useless, and dead. | <br>一具烤熟的尸体。温热、无用、死透了。 | keep | 烤熟、温、无用、已死四项幽默均保留。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:100；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1413；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:bardiche | <br>A long pole with an enormous, cleaving blade on one end. | <br>一根长杆，一端装有巨大的劈砍斧刃。 | keep | 长杆一端巨大劈斧刃，区别glaive长柄刀，不由名字省物理结构。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:104；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:63；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:barding | <br>Armour for the scaly midsections of nagas and centaurs. | <br>用于保护纳迦和半人马有鳞身体中段的护甲。 | keep | 纳迦半人马有鳞中段护甲，中文对象与部位对应；当前半人马玩家兼容另列。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:108；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:67；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:battleaxe | <br>A large war axe with a formidable double-sided head. | <br>一把有着令人生畏的双面斧头的大型战斧。 | keep | 大双面斧头且可怖，和war axe同根但不同武器大小。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:112；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:71；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:blade talisman | <br>A jagged cluster of blades, almost impossible to grasp without injury. Causes<br>long, needle-thin blades to grow from the wearer's body, allowing them to<br>perform rapid auxiliary melee attacks and even parry blows. Having so many<br>fragments of metal inside one's body reduces the effectiveness of body armour,<br>but Shapeshifting skill mitigates this effect as well as increases the damage<br>dealt. | <br>锯齿状的一簇刀片，很难抓着它而不受伤。<br>它能令使用者身体长出长长的、针般薄的刀片，使其能够进行快速的辅助近战攻击，<br>甚至能格挡攻击。体内有如此多的金属碎片会降低身体护甲的效力，<br>但变形术技能可以减轻这种影响，并增加造成的伤害。 | keep | 尖锐刃簇难无伤握、身长针细长刃快辅助近战与招架、体甲减效但变形术可缓并增伤，两增益与代价齐全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:116；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:75；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of air | <br>A primer on the elemental magics of Air. The great minotaur hero Vuxhurn, given<br>a copy of this book while trapped atop the tower of a wizard with a particularly<br>perverse sense of humour, used its pages to construct a rudimentary glider and<br>soared to freedom. | <br>一本空气魔法的入门读物。<br>伟大的牛头人英雄乌克斯胡恩被困在一个有着特别过分的幽默感的巫师塔塔顶时，<br>得到了这本书的副本，他用这本书的书页搭建了一个简陋的滑翔机，飞向了自由。 | keep | 空气入门、牛头人英雄受困坏幽默巫师塔顶、获副本用书页做滑翔机逃脱，完整因果。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:125；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:82；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of annihilations | <br>A tome of arcane fury, greatly sought after by sorcerers. It allows the gifted<br>and resourceful to conjure destruction with ease. | <br>一本关于奥术狂暴的巨著，深受术士追捧。有天赋和机敏的人能凭借它轻易唤起毁灭。 | keep | 奥术毁灭巨著受术士求、有天赋机敏者易唤毁灭，意象与读者都在。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:132；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:88；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of armaments | <br>A book describing various magical arms and armours. It was written in the midst<br>of a particularly bloody civil war, and the text is made substantially less<br>helpful by its author's frequent digressions describing the crimes committed by<br>the other side. | <br>一本描述各种魔法武器和盔甲的书。<br>它是在一场特别血腥的内战中写成的，<br>由于作者频繁地离题描述对方所犯下的罪行，文本在很大程度上不太有帮助。 | keep | 魔法武器护甲、血腥内战写作、作者离题谴敌罪导致实用性降，完整。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:137；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:92；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of battle | <br>An astonishingly vain and self-aggrandising work. The author claims credit for a<br>wide swathe of weapon-augmenting magics, but seems to have misunderstood or<br>misrepresented most of them. Only a few of the spells described in the book<br>actually work. | <br>一部极其自负、自我膨胀的作品。作者声称这一系列武器增强魔法归功于他，<br>但从这本书来看，作者似乎不理解或误传了其中大部分内容。<br>这本书中描述的咒语中只有少数能起作用。 | keep | 虚荣自夸、声称多武器增强术作者却误解歪曲多数、只有少数可用，保留转折与数量。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:144；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:98；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of beasts | <br>A book of spells focused on the summoning of beasts. Its pages nip at careless<br>readers' fingers. | <br>一本专注于野兽召唤术的书。它的书页会夹住粗心读者的手指。 | keep | 召兽书页夹粗心读者手指，nip小咬意象作夹指可接受。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:151；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:104；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of blasting | <br>A book of spells used to set off powerful explosions. This edition's binder<br>was careful to pad the cover, so that if its reader lacked sufficient caution,<br>the book, at least, would survive. | <br>一本关于制造强大爆炸的魔法书。这一版本的装订工小心地给封面包着护垫，<br>这样即使读者不够小心，至少这本书能保留下来。 | keep | 强爆炸书、装订者封面加垫让书而非读者保全，反讽保留。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:156；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:108；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of blood | <br>A book of works dedicated to the manipulation of blood, both that of the caster<br>and of creatures with particularly unusual ichor flowing through their veins.<br>Some claim it to have been composed by the vampire lord Jory, but it's unclear<br>why he would deign to share his secrets with others. | <br>一本关于操控血液的书，包括施法者的和血管中流着不寻常灵液的生物的血液。<br>有些人声称它是由吸血鬼领主乔里创作的，<br>但不清楚他为什么要屈尊于与他人分享其秘密。 | keep | 操己血与异类体液、传乔里吸血鬼领主撰而分享动机不明；本体血液类而非腐液，专名待实体组。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:162；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:113；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of burglary | <br>A book containing spells useful for theft, breaking and entering, and other<br>miscellaneous larceny. | <br>这本书收录了多种关于偷盗、破坏、入室等各种行窃的实用法术。 | keep | 偷盗破门入室多种窃术实用法术，breaking and entering可理解破门入室，当前列破坏+入室为同一事的拆法非独立严重错误。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:169；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:119；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of callings | <br>An introductory text on the magical summoning of beasts and beings from other<br>realms. | <br>这是一本关于以魔法召唤野兽和异界生物的入门读物。 | keep | 魔法召兽及异界生物入门，来源及基础程度完整。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:174；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:123；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of cantrips | <br>A book containing a small selection of very basic magic spells, intended for<br>beginners who wish to learn the rudiments of one of the featured magical<br>schools. | <br>这本书收录了少量非常基础的法术，面向想要学习本书所涉及的<br>某一魔法学派基础的初学者。 | adjust | 少量极基础法术、给想学书中某学派根基者；featured被写特色而非本书介绍，语义限定需纠正。 确认问题：featured是本书所涉及的学派，不是特色学派。 已修复 I-CANTRIPS：featured是本书所涉及的学派，不是特色学派。；处理：学习本书介绍的某一魔法学派的基础。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:179；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:127；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of chaos | <br>A book of spells that leave the caster's surroundings in a state of complete<br>disarray. It's not clear why anyone would write such a thing, but it's here. | <br>一本能让施法者周围一片混乱的魔法书。<br>不清楚为什么会有人写这样的东西，但它就是在这里。 | keep | 令周遭彻底混乱、为何著此不明但现成的幽默；此disarray普通混乱不机械改成混沌。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:185；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:132；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of conjurations | <br>A book containing an introduction to the destructive magical arts of<br>Conjurations. | <br>一本介绍咒法系破坏性法术的书。 | keep | 咒法系破坏术入门，学派与用途相符。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:190；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:137；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of contraptions | <br>A book of schematics and spells to construct a variety of elaborate mechanisms.<br>The obvious safety hazards involved with many of them are relegated to a single<br>footnote on page 157, but to an enterprising adventurer, that might be<br>considered an upside. | <br>一本关于构建各种精巧机械装置的图纸与法术的书。<br>其中涉及的许多明显安全隐患被归入第157页的一个单独脚注中，<br>但对勇于尝试的冒险者来说，这或许算是优点。 | adjust | 精巧装置图纸法术、157页单脚注安全隐患、进取冒险者反觉优点；enterprising译对应变的造成词义/语病。 确认问题：enterprising译为对应变的，语义与语法皆错。 已修复 I-CONTRAPTIONS：enterprising译为对应变的，语义与语法皆错。；处理：对勇于尝试的冒险者而言。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:195；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1417；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of cryoformation | <br>An illustrated guide to shaping ice into both practical and artistic forms. An<br>entire chapter is devoted to tables of mineral impurities and their effect on<br>colour and melting point. | <br>一本关于将冰塑造成实用和艺术形态的图文指南。<br>一整章专门介绍矿物杂质的表格及其对颜色和熔点的影响。 | keep | 图解塑冰实用艺术双形、整章矿杂质对色熔点，静态手艺不误成变身法术。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:202；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1423；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of dangerous friends | <br>A book describing the creation and use of magical entities best kept at arm's<br>reach. Or, preferably, even farther. | <br>一本描述创造和利用魔法造物的书。这些魔法实体最好保持在一臂之外，<br>或者更远。 | keep | 创造利用魔法实体、最好一臂距离或更远的危险朋友反讽，中文保持。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:208；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:141；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of death | <br>A manuscript containing dark spells of Necromancy. Each page is filled with<br>grotesque art depicting scenes of disgusting decay. | <br>一个记载黑暗的死灵术咒语的手稿。<br>每一页都以怪诞的风格绘满了令人作呕的腐烂场景。 | keep | 死灵黑术手稿、每页怪诞腐烂图，完整。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:213；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:146；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of debilitation | <br>A spellbook containing spells known for having a particularly unpleasant<br>effect on their victims. It's considered something of a faux pas in the<br>wizarding community to be seen with this book in one's collection. | <br>一本包含能对受击者产生特别不愉快效果的咒语的魔法书。<br>在巫师界，如果有人看到有谁收藏了这本书，会认为这种行为有失体统。 | keep | 敌不适法术、巫师界藏此书被视失礼，受众与评价完整。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:218；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:151；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of decay | <br>A book of Necromancy, dictated by the god Kikubaaqudgha to an unfortunate<br>apostle across the course of a nine-day fugue. The necromancer is said to have<br>finished the dread work with their own life's blood... but of course this is<br>just a copy, written in almost entirely normal ink. | <br>一本死灵之书，由奇库巴库哈神在九天的神游过程中传述给一个不幸的门徒。<br>据说，死灵法师是用他们的鲜血完成了这个可怕的工作……<br>当然，这本书只是副本，几乎完全是用正常的墨水写成的。 | keep | 九日神游中神口述不幸门徒、本人生命之血完成、此副本几乎全普通墨水；单一死灵法师被中文他们泛复数可改其，不强套限域代词词库。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:224；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:156；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of displacement | <br>A book of spells to bring others closer, or sometimes farther, depending on the<br>user's whim. | <br>一本能依使用者意愿将他者拉近、或移得更远的法术书。 | keep | 依使用者意愿拉近/有时拉远，中文双方向在；sometimes限定程度可润色而不评分。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:231；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:162；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of dreams | <br>The somniloquent utterings of a famed mystic, using uniquely bizarre imagery<br>and cryptic digressions to describe spells drawn from the mystic's visions. | <br>本书收录了一位著名秘术师在睡梦中的呓语，<br>以独特而怪诞的意象和晦涩的离题之谈，描述源自这位秘术师异象的法术。 | adjust | 著名秘术师梦中呓语、独特怪异意象和隐晦离题解释梦视法术；漏famed且somniloquent误成神游，须改。 确认问题：somniloquent是睡梦中说话，并非神游；famed遗漏。 已修复 I-DREAMS：somniloquent是睡梦中说话，并非神游；famed遗漏。；处理：著名秘术师的梦中呓语，保留异象与旁逸描述。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:236；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:166；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of duality | <br>An eclectic spellbook, mingled with rambling philosophical anecdotes about the<br>twin nature of every action.
