| body:items:book of scorching | <br>A magical book, blasted and scoured by long exposure to the desert sun. Upon<br>its badly-weathered pages lie the secrets to inflicting the desert's dangers<br>upon the caster's foes. | <br>这本魔法书长期暴露在沙漠烈日下，已被炙烤侵蚀得破损褪色。<br>它那饱经风吹日晒的书页上，记载着让施法者的敌人遭受沙漠种种危险的奥秘。 | keep | 久晒沙漠烈日剥蚀、风化书页载沙漠危险施敌术，材质因果完整。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:359；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:236；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of sloth | <br>A lazily written book. | <br>一本懒散地写下的书。 | keep | 懒散写书句，简短幽默保留。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:365；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:241；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of spatial translocations | <br>A basic spellbook on the magical field of Translocations. Many would-be mages<br>have seen it disappear just as they needed it most. | <br>一本关于传送系魔法的初级魔法书。<br>许多即将成为法师的人在最需要它的时候，它却凭空消失了。 | keep | 传送基础书、准法师最需时书却消失，中文句式可润但命题在。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:369；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:245；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of spectacle | <br>A book covered in glittering sequins. An impromptu lightshow bursts from every<br>page, clearly reserving this book for only the tackiest of wizards. | <br>这本书上满是闪烁的亮片。每翻动一页就有一阵即兴的灯光秀，<br>显然，只有最俗气的巫师才会喜欢这本书。 | adjust | 亮片每页灯光秀、专供最俗气巫师，当前译成巫师留下，改错归属/预期读者。 确认问题：reserving for only tackiest描述只合最俗气巫师胃口，并非他们留下了书。 已修复 I-SPECTACLE：reserving for only tackiest描述只合最俗气巫师胃口，并非他们留下了书。；处理：显然专供最俗气的巫师欣赏。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:374；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:250；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of spontaneous combustion | <br>A heavy tome written with wildly flammable ink. Care must be taken even opening<br>it, but the power of the spells described therein is undeniable.<br>{{<br>    if you.can_smell() then<br>        return "Its desiccated pages smell faintly of sulphur."<br>    end<br>}} | <br>一本厚重的巨著，书写这本书所用的墨水非常易燃，<br>即便只是打开它也必须要小心，但书中记录的咒语的威力却是毋庸置疑的。<br>{{<br>    if you.can_smell() then<br>        return "它干燥的书页散发着淡淡的硫磺味。"<br>    end<br>}} | keep | 厚本易燃墨、即使打开也小心但法术强；Lua can_smell条件及干页淡硫磺味完全保留。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:379；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:255；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of storms | <br>A book written by the magician Lan Shi, who was preoccupied with the study and<br>control of natural phenomena. Most of Shi's works have been lost, but those<br>still remaining are treasured by wizards lucky (or unscrupulous) enough to get<br>their hands on a copy. | <br>这本书由魔法师兰石编写，他致力于研究和控制自然现象。<br>石的大部分作品已经失传；残存的作品则被那些有幸（或不择手段）<br>得到副本的巫师珍藏。 | keep | 兰石法师研究控制自然、其作品多数失传、少数幸运/无原则者获副本珍惜，完整数量与评价。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:395；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:271；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of the dragon | <br>A magical book of spells which allow some command over dragons and their<br>aspects. | <br>一本收录着能在一定程度上支配龙及其特质的法术的魔法书。 | adjust | 咒语支配龙及其aspects特质，当前其他关于龙泛化，需保特质而非全龙题材。 确认问题：their aspects是龙的特质，其他关于龙的咒语遗漏这些法术的具体效果。 已修复 I-DRAGON-ASPECTS：their aspects是龙的特质，其他关于龙的咒语遗漏这些法术的具体效果。；处理：能支配龙及其特质的法术。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:402；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:277；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of the earth | <br>A guide to drawing immense power from the depths of the earth. The original was<br>written as a collaboration between the hill dwarves and the mountain dwarves, but<br>its compilation was cut short when a massive wave of earthquakes plunged the hill<br>dwarves' civilisation into ruin. | <br>一本讲解如何从大地深处汲取巨大力量的指南。<br>原著由丘陵矮人与山地矮人合著，但一连串大地震使丘陵矮人文明覆灭，<br>编纂也因此中断。 | adjust | 地深巨大力量指南、丘陵山地矮人协写、震潮毁丘陵文明使编纂截断；一波地震误成一场，需保复数序列。 确认问题：a massive wave of earthquakes被压成一场地震，事件串变单次。 已修复 I-EARTH-QUAKES：a massive wave of earthquakes被压成一场地震，事件串变单次。；处理：一连串大地震/一波剧烈地震。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:417；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:291；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of the fortress | <br>A book of spells that purports to make their caster as resilient as a stone<br>fortress. Its cover is fashioned from thick, magically-reinforced steel, making<br>the book unreasonably heavy for no obvious benefit. | <br>一本声称能使其施法者像石头堡垒一样坚韧的法术书。<br>其封面由厚实的魔法强化钢制成，使这本书异常沉重，却毫无明显用途。 | keep | 自称坚如石堡、厚魔钢封面异常沉重无益；未把自称保护当既成效果。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:272；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1451；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of the grave | <br>A heavy tome of necromantic spells. Those who touch it frequently report a<br>palpable sense of unease, as if something unwholesome were buried between its<br>very pages.<br>{{<br>    if you.can_smell() then<br>        return "Its vellum smells faintly of dirt and decay."<br>    end<br>}} | <br>一本厚重的死灵系法术书。触碰它的人常常报告一种明显的莫名不安感，<br>仿佛有某种不洁之物埋藏在书页之间。<br>{{<br>    if you.can_smell() then<br>        return "它的羊皮纸隐约散发出泥土和腐朽的气味。"<br>    end<br>}} | keep | 厚死灵书、触者常明显不安似埋不洁物；Lua嗅觉条件及羊皮纸泥土腐朽味逐字分支保留。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:283；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1456；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of the hunter | <br>A mundane book on hunting. Someone has gone through and covered the book in<br>corrections and scathing criticisms, crossing out entire sections in favour of<br>spells that accomplish the same task. | <br>一本关于狩猎的平淡无奇的书。<br>有人翻阅完这本书，所做的修正和严厉的批评涂满了整本书，<br>甚至还划掉了整个章节，换用了能完成相同任务的咒语。 | keep | 普通猎书遭满页纠错痛批、整段划去换能做同事的魔法，中文非魔法意涵可由普通/魔法对比明确作建议。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:424；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:297；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of the moon | <br>A book written by a mad wizard, who had become convinced that the moon far above<br>was composed, not of shining light, but of rock as solid as that beneath one's feet.<br>Many of the pages have been mangled beyond recognition, seemingly shredded by a<br>pair of powerful claws... but what would a troll be doing with a spellbook? | <br>这本书由一位疯狂的巫师所写，他深信天边的月亮不是由闪亮的光构成的，<br>而是像脚下那样坚硬的岩石构成的。<br>许多书页已被撕得面目全非，这似乎是被一对有力的爪子撕碎的……<br>但巨魔拿着一本魔法书做什么？ | keep | 疯巫师信月非光而坚岩、书被强爪撕坏、巨魔为何读书反问，双关完整。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:430；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:303；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of the senses | <br>A scholarly work, describing the senses used by living creatures to perceive the<br>world around them. A handful of spells are included to demonstrate the principles<br>being described. | <br>这部学术作品描述生物用来感知周围世界的各种感官。<br>它包含了一些咒语，以演示其所描述的原理。 | keep | 生物感知世界学术书、少量法术演示原则，目的保留。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:437；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:310；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of the spheres | <br>A book containing a well-rounded collection of sphere-related spells. Its<br>final pages begin to describe a spell titled 'Summon Orb of Zot', but sadly,<br>the remainder of the book has been completely vaporised. | <br>这本书中包含着与球体相关的详尽的咒语。<br>它的最后几页写着一个名为“召唤佐特宝珠”的咒语，<br>但遗憾的是，这本书的剩余部分已经完全蒸发了。 | keep | 全面球类法术、最后开讲召OrbZot但后页蒸发，源虚构法术标题作为书中引用而非真实可学声明。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:389；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:265；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of the tundra | <br>A frost-gripped tome describing icy spells, somewhat abridged. The Vaults are<br>said to hold the full text, but the guardians of that place guard their<br>treasures jealously. | <br>一部结满冰霜的巨著，上面描写着冰系魔法，有些删节。<br>据说宝库里藏有全文，但那里的守卫对他们的宝藏严加保护。 | keep | 霜卷冰术有删节、宝库藏全本且守卫惜财，分支语境可辨。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:452；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:322；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of the warp | <br>A book of advanced Translocations spells, written by a particularly<br>misanthropic mage. After its completion, they were never seen again, which may<br>or may not have been the point. | <br>一本高级传送系法术书，由一位格外厌世的法师所写。<br>编写完成后，这位法师便再也没有出现过——这或许正是其目的，也或许不是。 | adjust | 高级传送、厌世作者成书后不再见、这也许正是目的；point误重点而非用意，应改。 确认问题：the point指厌世作者消失也许就是写书目的，重点未表达目的关系。 已修复 I-WARP-POINT：the point指厌世作者消失也许就是写书目的，重点未表达目的关系。；处理：这或许正是作者的目的，也或许不是。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:458；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:327；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of the wilderness | <br>A book holding lore ripped from distant and untamed lands, allowing their<br>denizens to be called forth to serve the reader.<br>{{<br>    if you.can_smell() then<br>        return "It smells distressingly musty."<br>    end<br>}} | <br>这本书收录了从遥远蛮荒之地搜集来的知识，<br>可召唤那里的生物为读者效力。<br>{{<br>    if you.can_smell() then<br>        return "它有股难闻的霉味。"<br>    end<br>}} | keep | 远蛮地知识召当地生物服务；Lua嗅觉控制令人不安霉臭，条件和效果完整。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:407；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:281；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of touch | <br>A book describing spells requiring very close proximity to their target. The<br>author seems to have had a low opinion of their wizardly peers, and spends much<br>of the text describing the hygiene and social etiquette needed to enter close<br>proximity to other sentient beings. | <br>这本书描述着需要邻近目标才能施放的咒语。作者似乎对他的同辈巫师评价很低，<br>还花了大量篇幅描述了接近其他有意识的生物所需的卫生和社交礼仪。 | keep | 很近距离法术、作者低评同行、篇幅教卫生和接近智性生物礼仪，嘲讽完整。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:464；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:332；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of transmutation | <br>A meticulous compendium of research notes, filled with formulae for decomposing<br>and reconstituting all manner of substances. It was written by one of the<br>legendary alchemists among the sludge elves, before that species mysteriously<br>vanished from the world. The author appears to have had a strange obsession with<br>becoming a butterfly, but even if their ultimate aim eluded them, many of the<br>spells detailed therein are nonetheless quite practical. | <br>一份细致的研究笔记摘要，里面充满了分解和重组各种物质的公式。<br>它由污泥精灵中一位传奇炼金术士所写，在那个种族神秘地从世界上消失之前。<br>作者似乎对变成蝴蝶有一种奇怪的痴迷，<br>但即使他们的最终目标没能实现，书中详述的许多咒语仍然相当实用。 | keep | 细致分解重组研究、污泥精灵传奇炼金士在族消失前写、痴变蝶终未成但多法实用，完整；单一作者他们指代建议改作者/其。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:443；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:315；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of unlife | <br>An unholy book describing a variety of magical methods for the creation and<br>command of undead servants. | <br>这本邪恶的书描述了多种以魔法创造并控制亡灵仆从的方法。 | keep | 不洁书讲创造/控制亡灵魔法，未误活体疗愈。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:471；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:337；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of vapours | <br>A book of magic spells for creating an assortment of clouds, vapours and mists.<br>It is difficult to read, as the text is frequently interrupted by descriptions<br>of unusually-shaped clouds the author spotted while writing. | <br>一本关于创造各种云雾和蒸汽的魔法书。<br>它很难阅读，因为文本经常被打断，作者常常插叙在写作时碰到的奇形怪状的云。 | defer terminology | 云蒸气雾多类法、作者插怪形云写作见闻使难读；保留孤立旧书，不由现有同类书推旧法术。 延期理由：无当前普通生产名称/查询调用，保留孤立旧正文，已完整读其文本；不能从现代相近书推断历史功能。 责任：parent / item lifecycle or legacy restoration owner；重入：有真实当前/兼容消费者接入或该书恢复时，重新绑定效果再审。；保留值见中文列。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:476；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:341；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of weapons | <br>A book of spells used by rebels against an ancient and evil empire. The rebels<br>were crushed, but this book was rediscovered years later, found by paladins of<br>the crusade that finally destroyed the empire and slew its immortal twin<br>sovereigns. | <br>一本叛军用来对抗古老邪恶帝国的法术书。叛军虽遭镇压，<br>但数年后，圣战中的圣骑士重新发现了此书。<br>正是那场圣战最终摧毁了帝国，并杀死了它不朽的孪生君主。 | adjust | 远古邪国叛军魔法书、叛军败、数年后最终覆国杀不死双君主之圣战骑士重得书；漏years later并弱化圣战主体，需补。 确认问题：years later遗漏；摧毁帝国杀双君主的是发现书的圣骑士所属圣战，中文改成无施事的后续事件。 已修复 I-WEAPONS-HISTORY：years later遗漏；摧毁帝国杀双君主的是发现书的圣骑士所属圣战，中文改成无施事的后续事件。；处理：数年后，被最终推翻帝国、杀死其不朽孪生君主的那场圣战中的圣骑士重新发现。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:482；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:346；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of wicked creation | <br>A long-forbidden tome, describing spells for various unholy (or, at least,<br>underhanded) creations. It would be unwise to bring such a book back to the<br>surface world - better to read it and discard it in some well-hidden location. | <br>一本长期被禁的巨著，描述了各种不神圣（或至少是不光彩）的创造法术。<br>将这样一本书带回地面世界是不明智的——最好阅读后将其丢弃在<br>某个隐蔽的地方。 | keep | 禁忌造物之失传、邪恶卑劣构造与读后藏书不带回地表三句全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:489；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1466；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:book of winter | <br>A book of spells written by the sorceress Ellawe, who sought to use her time<br>productively while trapped inside by particularly harsh weather for over six<br>months. A postscript details the bloody vengeance she took after discovering<br>the weather mage responsible. | <br>这本魔法书由女术师埃拉薇撰写，<br>她因特别恶劣的天气而被困在室内六个多月，期间试图充分利用时间。<br>后记详细记载了她发现罪魁祸首是天气法师后所展开的血腥报复。 | keep | 冬季作者宅居半年后被揭为复仇天气巫师，时长、动机与产量保留。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:495；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:352；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:boomerang | <br>A curved, flat, throwing baton designed to return to its user. | <br>一个弯曲的、扁平的投掷短棒，其设计使它能回到使用者手上。 | keep | 弯曲扁平投掷棍及能回到手中完整。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:502；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:358；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:box of beasts | <br>A box filled with the bizarre leftovers of a depraved wizard's magical<br>experimentations. Opening it might set loose a friendly mutant beast: bizarre<br>creatures, each with their own combination of traits. Increased skill with<br>Evocations will allow stronger beasts to be released.<br><br>There are six known traits:<br> * Bat beasts fly and move very quickly, but erratically.<br> * Fire beasts resist and breathe fire.<br> * Ox beasts resist cold, are armoured with thick fur, and can knock back foes.<br> * Shock beasts resist electricity and can transform into living lightning.<br> * Sting beasts resist poison and have a reaching poison-tail attack.<br> * Weird beasts can see invisible and attack with constricting tentacles.<br><br>As far as anyone knows, all beasts have exactly two of these traits. | <br>这个盒子里满是堕落巫师的奇异实验残留。打开它可能会释放一只友好的变异兽：<br>每只奇异的生物都有自己的一套特质。魔力释放技能越强，释放出的野兽就越强。<br><br>有六种已知的特质：<br> ＊蝙蝠野兽能飞行且十分迅捷，但行动失序。<br> ＊火焰野兽能抵抗并喷吐火焰。<br> ＊公牛野兽耐寒，皮毛厚实，能击退敌人。<br> ＊电击野兽能抵抗电流并能变形成活体闪电。<br> ＊刺叮野兽能抵抗毒素，并以可隔格攻击的毒尾刺击敌人。<br> ＊诡秘野兽能看见隐形生物并用触手进行束缚攻击。<br><br>据目前所知，每只野兽都恰好具有上述两种特质。 | keep | 友方突变兽与六种兽性及各两效果完整，魔力释放增强非必定友方。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:506；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:362；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:broad axe | <br>An axe with langets, spikes, a lengthed haft and a single-bladed crescent head. | <br>一把带有细金属条、尖刺和一个月牙状的刃的长柄斧子。 | keep | 薄金属条、尖刺、长柄与月刃逐项对应。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:523；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:377；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:buckler | <br>A small piece of wood and metal, to be strapped on one arm for defence. | <br>一小块木头和金属，通过绑在一只手臂上进行防御。 | keep | 木金属小盾绑手臂防御。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:527；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:381；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:centipede bauble | <br>A tiny figurine of a centipede coiled around a stone. Gripping it tightly will<br>transform it into a living weapon that merges with one's own body. This weapon<br>functions as a reaching short blade whose attacks can poison targets.<br><br>After performing a moderate number of attacks with this weapon, it will separate<br>itself from its wielder's body and fight alongside you as an independent ally<br>for a short time before dying.<br><br>Shapeshifting skill increases the power of this centipede in both weapon and<br>insect form, as well the potency of its toxins - eventually allowing it to<br>sometimes slow or even paralyse foes. | <br>一个蜈蚣盘绕石头的微小雕像。紧握它，就会使其变成与你身体融合的活体武器。<br>这件武器相当于能延伸攻击的短刃，攻击可以使目标中毒。<br><br>用这件武器攻击一定次数后，它会脱离持用者的身体，作为独立盟友<br>与你并肩作战片刻，随后死亡。<br><br>变形术技能会提高这只蜈蚣在武器与昆虫形态下的力量，以及毒素的效力，<br>最终使其有时甚至能让敌人减速或麻痹。 | keep | 石像蜈蚣变体短刃触及、中毒、分离盟友、寿限及两形态随变形术成长全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:531；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1686；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:chain mail | <br>A suit of armour made entirely out of tiny metal rings. | <br>一件完全用小金属环制成的护甲。 | keep | 微小环扣构成整身链甲。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:545；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:385；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:cloak | <br>A cloth cloak. | <br>一件布披风。 | keep | 简单布制披风，无附加效果。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:549；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:389；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:club | <br>A heavy piece of wood. While clubs are rather primitive weapons, bashing<br>someone's skull in with one remains a very popular and effective means of<br>dispute resolution. | <br>一块沉重的木头。虽然棍棒是相当原始的武器，<br>但猛击某人的头颅仍是解决争端的一种十分流行且有效的方法。 | keep | 木棒砸头与解决争端的黑色幽默保留。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:553；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:393；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:codex of conductivity | <br>An exhaustive collection of research notes on the effects of electricity upon<br>everything from sawdust to snozzcumbers, interspersed with spell formulae and<br>usable technical schematics. The author's handwriting deteriorates shockingly in<br>the middle of the chapter on spriggan electrophysiology, leading to much<br>speculation about both their identity and their sense of self-preservation. | <br>一本关于电对从锯末到斯诺兹黄瓜等一切事物影响的详尽研究笔记汇编，<br>穿插着法术公式和可用的技术图解。作者在关于小精灵电生理学的章节中，<br>笔迹恶化得令人震惊，引发了关于其身份及其自我保护意识的诸多猜测。 | keep | 技术图示与电学法术、木屑到怪黄瓜、作者在树精电生理章节中途笔迹恶化；中文未明确中途，可补而不捏造书内机制。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:559；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1472；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:compendium of siegecraft | <br>An analytical treatise on siege warfare, written in a clear and readable manner.<br>A majority of its chapters are concerned with logistics and the maintenance of<br>supply lines, but several detail spells useful for breaching fortifications<br>(and also other, softer, things). | <br>一本关于攻城战的分析性专论，以清晰易懂的方式撰写。<br>大部分章节涉及后勤和补给线维护，但有几章详述了用于突破防御工事<br>（以及其他更柔软之物）的法术。 | keep | 攻城后勤占大部、少量破防魔法及软目标玩笑全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:567；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1478；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:condenser vane | <br>A magical device that condenses ambient energy into various destructive clouds.<br>When evoked these clouds form around hostile monsters near the user. The<br>quantity and lethality of these clouds increases with Evocations skill. At low<br>power it will create noxious fumes, and as power increases this gives way to<br>roaring flames, freezing vapours, and poisonous gas. At the highest tiers of<br>power storm clouds, acidic fog and clouds of excruciating misery become<br>available. | <br>这件魔法装置能将周围的能量凝结成各种具有破坏性的云。<br>激活时，这些云会在使用者附近的敌对怪物周围形成。<br>云的数量和杀伤力会随魔力释放技能的提升而增加。<br>威力较低时，它会生成毒烟；随着威力提高，毒烟会让位于咆哮的烈焰、冰冻蒸汽和毒气。<br>威力处于最高几档时，还可生成风暴云、酸雾和带来极度痛苦的云雾。 | keep | 周敌云雾按魔力释放增量强度，低迷惑中火冷毒高雷酸苦痛各类保留。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:574；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:398；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
