| body:items:everburning encyclopedia | <br>A book of magical spells, meticulously organised, dense, and almost entirely<br>burnt black. Only a few pages are still legible, but the power within still<br>blasts the reader with a furnace-like heat. | <br>一本魔法书，精心编排，密密麻麻，却几乎完全被烧成黑色。<br>只有几页仍清晰可辨，但其中的力量仍以火炉般的热浪扑向读者。 | keep | 烧焦严谨百科仅少页可读却传炉热全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:700；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:507；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:executioner's axe | <br>A fearsome weapon covered in dried blood and crude engravings of torture and<br>death, bearing an enormous axehead. | <br>一件可怕的武器，上面有着凝固的血和关于酷刑与死亡的粗糙雕刻，<br>带有一个巨大的斧头。 | keep | 巨斧干血、刑死粗刻与大斧头全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:706；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:512；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:falchion | <br>A long single-edged sword with a slightly curved blade. | <br>一把长长的单刃剑，刀刃略微弯曲。 | keep | 长而略弯单刃弯刀全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:711；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:517；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:fen folio | <br>A collection of spells once used by the great swamp civilisations. | <br>伟大的沼泽文明使用过的法术合集。 | keep | 远古沼泽文明释放的法术主题全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:715；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:521；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:figurine of a ziggurat | <br>A small figurine made of some strange material, shaped like a stepped pyramid.<br>It is remarkably detailed – almost like a real, vast structure, shrunk somehow<br>smaller than a human hand. | <br>一个由某种奇特物质制成的小雕像，形状像带有阶梯的金字形神塔。<br>它非常细致——比人手还小，却几乎像是以某种方式由真实、巨大的建筑缩放而来的。 | keep | 金字塔微型雕像似被缩小、异质材料、细节全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:719；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:525；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:fire dragon scales | <br>The scales of a fire-breathing dragon. It provides great protection from fire,<br>while rendering its wearer more susceptible to cold. | <br>吐息火焰之龙的鳞甲。<br>它能够提供极好的火抗，也致使它的穿戴者更易受到寒冷的影响。 | keep | 火龙鳞强火抗与冷弱点对称保留。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:725；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:530；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:flail | <br>A mace with a short chain connecting the head to the haft. | <br>一把用短链把锤头连在柄上的钉头锤。 | keep | 短链连柄与锤头全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:730；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:535；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:flux bauble | <br>A small glass bauble containing an ominously glowing substance. Crushing it will<br>flood you with transmutational energy, leaving your physical form unstable at a<br>fundamental level.<br><br>In this state of flux, your melee attacks are much weaker, but each strike will<br>contaminate whatever you hit with transmutational energy - growing so intense<br>upon the third strike that it will cause their body to twist and deform,<br>inflicting significant damage. The lack of certainty in your physical form also<br>makes you much harder to hit, though you glow in a way that hinders stealth.<br><br>The power contained in each bauble is finite, and once it is exhausted by<br>spreading it to enemies, you will return to your previous form. | <br>一个装有令人不安发光物质的小玻璃球。捏碎它将使你充满变形能量，<br>使你的物理形态在基本层面上变得不稳定。<br><br>在这种变形状态下，你的近战攻击弱得多，但每次命中都会用变形能量污染<br>目标——对同一目标的第三次命中会使能量积蓄得如此强烈，以至于令其身体<br>扭曲变形，造成显著伤害。物理形态的不确定性也使你更难被击中，<br>尽管你发光的方式会妨碍潜行。<br><br>每个小球中蕴含的力量是有限的，一旦通过传播给敌人而耗尽，<br>你将恢复之前的形态。 | adjust | 变化无常的碎珠、弱近战、污染叠三次、变形伤害与有限耗能复原全；第三次攻击应明确命中次数，melee-attack.cc:716,1015仅命中应用。 确认问题：第三次攻击容易将未命中也计入触发次数，实际污染仅在命中阶段叠层。 已修复 I-FLUX-HITS：第三次攻击容易将未命中也计入触发次数，实际污染仅在命中阶段叠层。；处理：明确计数的是对目标的污染命中，不计挥空攻击；不额外要求连续三次攻击同一目标。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:734；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1497；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:716；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:1015 |
| body:items:fortress talisman | <br>A miniature battlement, carved from a piece of shell. Transforms the wearer into<br>a heavily armoured crab, fusing whatever body armour they are wearing into the<br>shell and magnifying most of its benefits. In this form, they are slow-moving,<br>but well-defended and even capable of wielding a two-handed weapon in their<br>large main claw. Despite all this bulk, they are well-adapted to the water. They<br>can also breathe clouds of rust at the cost of their own HP, which corrode and<br>weaken enemies. | <br>一个用贝壳碎片雕刻而成的微型城垛。它会将佩戴者变成一只重甲螃蟹，<br>把身上的身体护甲融入甲壳，并放大其大部分效益。在此形态下，<br>佩戴者移动缓慢，却防御出色，甚至能用巨大的主螯持用双手武器。<br>虽然如此笨重，却十分适应水中环境。还能消耗自身生命值喷吐锈蚀云雾，<br>腐蚀并削弱敌人。 | keep | 要塞蟹：护甲融合且留大部收益、慢走高防、双手主螯、适水与耗HP锈云腐蚀虚弱全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:749；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1510；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:gecko talisman | <br>The dried remains of a tail shed under duress. Partially transforms the user<br>into a hypnogecko, a reptile with a remarkable degree of metachrosis. Their skin<br>naturally changes colour to blend in with their surroundings, making them<br>stealthy, and when badly injured, they reflexively shed their own tail and make<br>it scintillate with bright colours as a decoy - allowing them to either flee or<br>even strike at their distracted predators from a blind spot. | <br>一条危急时脱落的尾巴留下的干枯残骸。它会让使用者部分变成迷魂壁虎，<br>一种变色能力非凡的爬行动物。它们的皮肤会自然变色，与周围环境融为一体，<br>使其善于潜行；严重受伤时，它们会本能地脱落尾巴，让尾巴闪烁鲜艳的色彩作为诱饵，<br>从而逃走，甚至从盲区袭击那些分心的捕食者。 | keep | 壁虎尾脱色潜行、受伤放亮尾诱饵便逃走或偷袭全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:770；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1697；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:gell's gravitambourine | <br>A copper and tungsten tambourine that vibrates excitedly in your hands, as if<br>eager to be used.<br><br>Just as music brings people together, shaking it with the proper rhythm will<br>draw a large group of monsters into a narrow space and hold any hostile ones in<br>place for a short time with inescapable waves of crushing gravity.<br><br>The area of effect and duration increases with Evocations skill. | <br>一面铜和钨制成的铃鼓，在你的手中兴奋地振动着，仿佛渴望被使用。<br><br>正如音乐将人们聚到一起，以正确的节奏摇动它将把一大群怪物吸引到<br>一个狭窄的空间中，并用无法逃脱的碾压重力波将所有敌对目标<br>固定在原地一小段时间。<br><br>效果范围和持续时间随魔力释放技能提升。 | keep | 铜钨铃鼓引怪聚集重力短缚，仅敌方、半径时长随魔力释放全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:759；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1518；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:gem | <br>A stone of unearthly beauty and almost immeasurable value outside the dungeon.<br>Within its confines, it is utterly useless.<br><br>Zot hoards these gems jealously, and will spitefully smash them soon after an<br>adventurer enters the branch of the Dungeon in which they rest. Still, a very<br>quick-moving adventurer might seize one first and keep its precious shards.<br>Zot cannot track gems outside their home branches, so with truly astonishing<br>speed, it might be possible to abscond with one still intact... but such a<br>feat is difficult to credit, and likely pointless besides.<br><br>Once the Orb of Zot is taken, Zot will be unable to smash any gems. | <br>一块美得超凡脱俗的石头，在地牢之外价值几乎难以估量。<br>但在地牢之内，它毫无用处。<br><br>佐特小心翼翼地贮藏着这些宝石，<br>冒险者进入存放宝石的地牢分支后不久，佐特就会恶意地打碎相应宝石。<br>然而，一个行动极其迅速的冒险者有机会抓到一个宝石，并保留其珍贵的碎片。<br>佐特无法在存放宝石的原分支之外继续追踪它，<br>因此，如果有真正惊人的速度，是有可能带着一颗完好无损的宝石成功逃脱……<br>然而这样的壮举简直是天方夜谭，而且可能毫无意义。<br><br>一旦佐特宝珠被拿走，佐特将无法打碎任何宝石。 | adjust | gem将地牢之外的价值误成来自地牢之外，范围与来源反转；进入分支不久后碎裂被写一旦就；快拾保碎片、极快保整、带出分支不再追踪及拾宝珠后禁碎全。 确认问题：outside the dungeon修饰价值适用范围，来自地牢之外误成石头来源；soon after被误为一旦就。 已修复 I-GEM-SCOPE：outside the dungeon修饰价值适用范围，来自地牢之外误成石头来源；soon after被误为一旦就。；处理：在地牢之外价值难估，在地牢内无用；进入分支不久后佐特会击碎。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:779；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:539；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:334 |
| body:items:giant club | <br>A giant lump of wood. | <br>一块非常大的木头。 | keep | 巨型木棒简单物理特征全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:793；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:552；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:giant spiked club | <br>A giant lump of wood with sharp spikes at one end. | <br>一个巨型木棒，一端装有尖木刺。 | keep | 巨型带刺棒的锋利尖刺被增木材质，可删木但属非关键偏好。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:797；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:556；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:glaive | <br>A pole with a large, heavy blade on one end. | <br>杆子一端有着又大又重的刀刃。 | keep | 长柄重刃偃月刀全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:801；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:560；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:gold piece | <br>A pile of glittering gold coins. | <br>一堆闪闪发亮的金币。 | keep | 一堆闪光金币全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:810；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:568；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:golden dragon scales | <br>The scales of a golden dragon. It is much heavier than most dragon scale<br>armours, and grants its wearer resistance to poison, fire and cold. | <br>一套金龙鳞甲。它比大多数龙鳞甲重得多，但能给穿戴者提供毒抗、火抗、寒抗。 | keep | 金龙鳞比大部更重，毒火冷三抗全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:805；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:564；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:grand grimoire | <br>A book describing how the mighty among summoners can bend to their will the<br>terrible things from betwixt the planes. Many have been the unwary souls,<br>however, who have toyed with this tome and been driven mad by unimaginable<br>eldritch horrors. | <br>这本书讲述强大的召唤者如何使位面夹缝中的可怖存在屈从于自己的意志。<br>然而，许多轻率摆弄此书的人都被难以想象的异界恐怖逼疯。 | keep | 强召唤法师束缚异界恐怖及不慎疯狂全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:821；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:579；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:granite talisman | <br>A heavy stone icon, bearing the countenance of some long-forgotten king or god.<br>Transforms the wearer into a slow, stone statue. The wearer's stone body is<br>immune to poison and miasma, and gains resistance to electricity, negative<br>energy, and torment. Shapeshifting skill increases armour granted. | <br>一个沉重的石符，上面有一个被遗忘已久的国王或是神明的头像。<br>它能将使用者变成一个缓慢的石像。<br>使用者的石质身躯免疫毒和瘴气，并获得对电、负能量和折磨的抗性。<br>提升变形术技能可以增加该形态赋予的护甲。 | keep | 花岗岩遗忘王/神之脸，石像慢速、毒瘴免疫、电负能量折磨抵抗与技能加甲全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:814；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:572；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:great mace | <br>An enormous metal war club, of great cumbrousness. | <br>一根巨型金属战棍，非常笨重。 | keep | 巨重金属战棒全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:828；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:584；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:great sword | <br>A sword with a very long, heavy blade and a long handle. | <br>一把有着长柄和很长的沉重剑刃的剑。 | keep | 长重刃柄巨剑全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:832；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:588；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:great wizards, vol. ii | <br>A collection of spells from great wizards throughout history. The author seems<br>to have been extremely enthusiastic, and each wizard is described in voluminous,<br>comprehensive detail. | <br>历史上伟大巫师的咒语集。作者似乎非常热情，<br>对每个巫师都有浩繁、全面的描述。 | keep | 大法师II热情周全且卷帙浩繁全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:836；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:592；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:great wizards, vol. vii | <br>A collection of spells from great wizards throughout history. The author seems<br>to have been quite tired of their project - the wizards' descriptions are terse<br>and minimal, meeting the lowest requirement for completeness. | <br>历史上伟大巫师的咒语集。作者似乎对他们的项目已经厌倦了——<br>对巫师的描述简明扼要，只是满足了对完整性的最低要求。 | keep | VII作者厌烦历史只写最低要求法术句全，singular they不机械视作正式规则错误。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:842；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:598；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:halberd | <br>A polearm consisting of an axe blade topped with a spike, mounted on a long<br>shaft. | <br>一把长柄武器，在长柄的顶端，有一个带刺的斧刃。 | keep | 戟长杆、斧刃与顶刺全，几何表述可更具体但非机制缺失。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:848；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:603；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:hammer | <br>A blunt striking weapon, essentially equivalent to a mace. | <br>一把钝击武器，基本上相当于钉头锤。 | adjust | hammer本质同mace，中文误作权杖；兼容身份仍必须保留正确物件对照。 确认问题：mace误成权杖(sceptre)，是另一类器物。 已修复 I-HAMMER-MACE：mace误成权杖(sceptre)，是另一类器物。；处理：本质上很像钉头锤。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:853；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:607；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:530；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:1044 |
| body:items:hand axe | <br>A small axe. | <br>一把小斧头。 | keep | 小型单手斧全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:857；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:611；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:hand cannon | <br>A machine that fires metal slugs via applied thaumaturgy. Some enchant their<br>projectiles to fall forward instead of down, others bewitch the slugs with a<br>fatal attraction to their targets. All are slow, loud, and blast out thick<br>smoke with each shot. | <br>一台运用奇术发射金属弹丸的机械。<br>一些人为弹药附魔，使其向前而不是向下坠落；<br>另一些人为弹药附加了致命的朝向目标的引力。<br>所有手炮都缓慢、响亮，每次发射都会喷出浓烟。 | adjust | 手炮金属弹丸的材质被省略；魔法机械、慢响、厚烟及两条前/下射击吸引死亡警告全。 确认问题：metal slugs的金属弹丸信息省为泛称弹药。 已修复 I-HAND-CANNON-METAL：metal slugs的金属弹丸信息省为泛称弹药。；处理：发射金属弹丸的奇术机械；同时理顺首句重复用于。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:861；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:615；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:handbook of applied construction | <br>A practical introduction to Forgecraft, covering basic principles and their<br>common applications. | <br>一本关于锻造术的实用入门书，涵盖了基本原理及其常见应用。 | keep | 构造实用初等锻造与常见用途全；书名建筑可建议构造以免过窄，不用机制改写书名。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:868；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1528；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:hat | <br>A cloth hat. | <br>一顶布帽。 | keep | 简单布帽全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:873；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:622；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:helmet | <br>A piece of metal headgear. | <br>一个金属头盔。 | keep | 金属头盔全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:877；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:626；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:hive talisman | <br>A preserved and decorated hive, still dripping with ambrosial nectar. Transforms<br>the wearer into a living beehive, filled with the buzz of countless insects<br>labouring inside them. The nectar produced within greatly increases the wearer's<br>health and magic regeneration and if they become seriously injured, angry bees<br>will swarm out to defend their hive. | <br>一个经过保存和装饰的蜂巢，仍然滴着神酒般的甘露。将佩戴者变成<br>一个活蜂巢，充满了无数在里面劳作的昆虫的嗡嗡声。内部产生的甘露<br>大大提高了佩戴者的生命值和法力恢复速度，如果佩戴者严重受伤，<br>愤怒的蜜蜂将蜂拥而出保卫蜂巢。 | keep | 甜花蜜蜂巢变成活蜂巢、HP/MP大再生及严重受伤蜂群护主全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:881；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1532；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:horn of geryon | <br>The horn belonging to Geryon, guardian of the Vestibule of Hell. It has the<br>power to call forth demonic beasts. With high Evocations skill, it will call<br>greater numbers of beasts, with lower chances of those beasts being hostile. | <br>这个号角属于格律翁，他是地狱前庭的守卫者。它能够用来召唤恶魔野兽。<br>魔力释放技能越高，它就能召唤更多的野兽，<br>并且这些野兽是敌对的几率也会更低。 | keep | 革律翁门卫巨角召恶魔兽，魔力释放增数降敌对率全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:889；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:630；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:ice dragon scales | <br>The scales of a cold-breathing dragon. It provides great protection from cold,<br>while rendering its wearer more susceptible to fire. | <br>吐息寒冰之龙的鳞甲。<br>它能够提供极好的寒抗，也致使它的穿戴者更易受到火的影响。 | keep | 冰龙鳞强冷抗与火弱点全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:900；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:640；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:inkwell talisman | <br>A small bottle filled with mystical ink. Transforms the wearer into a walking<br>scroll whose body is tattooed with the knowledge of a hundred mages. Being an<br>omnibus of magical techniques gives them increased skill with all spell schools,<br>which improves with Shapeshifting skill, but the form's ability to channel such<br>magic is limited, and it cannot cast spells above level 4.<br><br>Its attacks are also very weak, but have a chance of restoring 1 MP when they<br>hit. | <br>一个装满神秘墨水的小瓶子。将佩戴者变成一卷行走的卷轴，<br>其身体上纹有百位法师的知识。作为魔法技艺的百科全书，<br>使佩戴者在所有法术学派中获得更高的技能，这随变形术技能提升而增加，<br>但此形态引导此类魔法的能力有限，无法施放4级以上的法术。<br><br>其攻击也非常弱，但命中时有概率恢复1点法力。 | keep | 活卷轴纹身百法师学派知识随变形术增技能，不能施&gt;4级法术，弱攻击命中回复1MP全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:905；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1539；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:ivory gem | <br>[[gem]]<br><br>Countless spirits swirl around this gem, shrouding it in a bone-deep chill.<br>Unwelcome in the Good gods' afterlife, they find here a heaven of their own. | <br>[[gem]]<br><br>无数灵体围绕着这颗宝石旋转，将它笼罩在彻骨的寒意中。<br>这些灵体不受善神掌管的死后世界欢迎，却在这里找到了自己的天堂。 | adjust | 象牙宝石good gods' afterlife误成善神转生后的时间；应是不受善神死后世界欢迎的灵魂自寻天堂。 确认问题：good gods' afterlife意为善神掌管的死后世界，不是善神转生之后；整个因果场景错误。 已修复 I-IVORY-AFTERLIFE：good gods' afterlife意为善神掌管的死后世界，不是善神转生之后；整个因果场景错误。；处理：不受善神的死后世界欢迎的灵魂，在此找到了自己的天堂。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:916；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:645；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:jade gem | <br>[[gem]]<br><br>Sigils of fire burn deep within this gem, symbol of the eternal compact between<br>naga and salamander. Their bond is that of the poison which scourges the impure<br>and the flame which burns away impurity. | <br>[[gem]]<br><br>这颗宝石的深处燃烧着火焰的印记，它象征着纳迦和火蜥蜴之间永恒的契约。<br>他们的结合是毒与火的结合，毒液责罚着腐化之物，火焰烧除着罪恶之物。 | keep | 翡翠宝石那伽火蜥蜴永恒契约，毒涤不洁火去杂质全，罪恶属于文学发挥可建议更中性。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:923；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:652；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:jade talisman | <br>A small statuette carved out of multi-hued jade which thrums with quiet power.<br>Causes a great mantle of elementally-attuned crystal to grow out of the wearer's<br>head and upper body, increasing their proficiency with fire, ice, earth, and air<br>magic, but impairing all other schools.<br><br>Each time the wearer casts a spell from one of those four schools, it will<br>empower the corresponding crystal and unleash a burst of damaging magic. If all<br>four crystals become charged at once, the wearer's resistances and fortitude<br>will be temporarily enhanced. | <br>一个用多色玉石雕刻而成的小雕像，静静震颤着力量。<br>它会使大片与元素共鸣的晶体从佩戴者的头部和上身长出，如衣般覆盖身体，<br>提高其对火焰、寒冰、大地和空气魔法的掌握，却削弱其他所有学派。<br><br>每次佩戴者施放这四个学派之一的法术，都会为相应晶体充能，<br>并释放一阵造成伤害的魔法。如果四块晶体同时充满能量，<br>佩戴者的抗性与韧性就会暂时增强。 | keep | 四元素水晶充能、四系技能升其他降、每次法术对应元素充能爆发及四晶满暂增抗性坚韧全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:931；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1704；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:javelin | <br>A lightweight penetrating spear, designed for throwing. It will pass through the<br>targets it hits, potentially hitting all targets in its path until it reaches<br>maximum range.<br>{{<br>    if you.race() == "Kobold" or you.race() == "Spriggan" then<br>        return "Unfortunately, it is too long and awkward for you to use."<br>    end<br>}} | <br>一根用于投掷的轻型穿透长矛。它会穿过命中的目标，<br>可能击中路径中的所有目标，直到达到最大射程。{{<br>    if you.race() == "Kobold" or you.race() == "Spriggan" then<br>        return "很遗憾，它对你来说太长而且太笨拙，无法使用。"<br>    end<br>}} | adjust | 标枪穿透沿途至射程，Kobold/Spriggan Lua限制译为不方便过弱；item-prop.cc:2273实际禁止小于中型投掷，应无法使用。 确认问题：小种族Lua译不方便使用弱化实际不能投掷的限制。 已修复 I-JAVELIN-RESTRICTION：小种族Lua译不方便使用弱化实际不能投掷的限制。；处理：对你而言太长而笨拙，无法使用。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:943；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:659；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:2273 |
| body:items:kite shield | <br>A piece of wood and metal, to be strapped on one arm for defence. | <br>一块木头和金属，通过绑在一只手臂上进行防御。 | keep | 木金属鸢盾绑臂防御全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:954；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:668；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:lajatang | <br>A very rare and extremely effective weapon, featuring a pole with half-moon<br>blades at both ends. | <br>一把十分罕见而极为高效的武器，杆子的两端各有一个半月形的刃。 | keep | 双端半月形刃、少见有效长兵器全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:958；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:672；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:large rock | <br>A very large and very heavy stone. {{<br>    if you.race() == "Oni"<br>       or you.race() == "Troll"<br>   then<br>       return ""<br>   else<br>       return "Only large creatures are capable of throwing it."<br>   end<br>}} | <br>一块沉重的巨石。{{<br>    if you.race() == "Oni"<br>       or you.race() == "Troll"<br>   then<br>       return ""<br>   else<br>       return "只有大型生物才能投掷它。"<br>   end<br>}} | keep | 巨石仅大体型可投；Oni/Troll Lua省略警告其余显示，分支与原文同。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:963；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:676；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:leather armour | <br>A suit made from layers of tanned animal hide. It provides basic protection<br>with almost no hindrance to spellcasting or stealthy movement. | <br>这件护甲是用几层鞣过的动物皮做成的。<br>穿着它几乎不会对施法或潜行造成阻碍，不过它只能提供一点最基础的防护。 | keep | 皮甲基础保护且几乎不妨碍施法潜行全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:975；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:688；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:lightning rod | <br>A rod that allows its wielder to fire unavoidable blasts of lightning.<br>Consecutive evocations cause the discharge to be sustained, which increases the<br>power level up to four times and allows the blast to be redirected to affect an<br>area. The strength of the blast increases with Evocations skill and, for<br>redirected blasts, decreases with the size of the affected area. | <br>这根杆子能让使用者射出无法闪避的闪电冲击。<br>连续激活将使其释出的能量增强，直至达到四倍的强度，<br>同时能够改变方向来攻击一整片区域。冲击的强度随魔力释放技能的提高而提高，<br>变换了方向的冲击会随受影响区域的扩大而减弱。 | keep | 闪电杖连续激活至四倍、区域重导更大但较弱、魔力释放提升范围威力全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:980；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:693；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:long sword | <br>A sword with a long, slashing blade. | <br>一把剑刃修长、用于劈斩的剑。 | adjust | 长剑slashing blade被译成凌厉的剑，缺劈斩特征；建议剑刃修长适于劈斩。 确认问题：slashing blade的劈斩特征被换成凌厉这一泛评价。 已修复 I-LONG-SWORD：slashing blade的劈斩特征被换成凌厉这一泛评价。；处理：剑刃修长、用于劈斩的剑。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:988；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:700；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:longbow | <br>A long, strong bow made of yew. | <br>一张紫杉制成的长而坚固的弓。 | keep | 长强紫杉木长弓全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:992；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:704；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:lupine talisman | <br>A painted eyepatch made from a scrap of wolf pelt. Transforms the wearer into a<br>vicious werewolf, muscles surging with predatory instinct. Killing enemies with<br>melee attacks in this form will give a stacking bonus to your damage and<br>accuracy, and slaying enough of them in a row will cause you to unleash a<br>vicious howl that makes any still alive cower in fear - and leaves them<br>susceptible to a devastating leaping takedown. | <br>一块由狼皮碎片制成的涂色眼罩。将佩戴者变成一只凶猛的狼人，<br>肌肉涌动着掠食本能。在此形态下用近战攻击击杀敌人将为你提供<br>叠加的伤害和命中加成，连续击杀足够多的敌人将导致你释放出<br>凶猛的嚎叫，使任何还活着的敌人因恐惧而畏缩——<br>并使它们容易被毁灭性的跳跃扑杀攻击。 | keep | 狼皮眼罩使狼肌肉，近战击杀叠准确伤害，连续击杀触嚎恐惧与跃扑全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:996；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1548；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:mace | <br>A short club with a metal head. | <br>一根带金属头的短棒。 | keep | 短棒金属头，mace译钉头锤准确。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1005；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:708；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:manual | <br>A valuable book which allows one to learn a certain skill faster. | <br>一本很有用的书，能让人更快地学习某种技能。 | keep | 技能手册加快特定技能学习，未虚构直接技能点。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1009；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:712；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:maw talisman | <br>A miniature, desiccated head of some ferocious and hopefully extinct creature.<br>Transforms the wearer's midsection into a giant mouth, gnashing and ready to devour<br>foes. This maw confers a powerful bite attack which scales additionally with the<br>wearer's own strength and can devour slain creatures to temporariy increase<br>one's regeneration. Unfortunately, it also confers such profound hunger that it<br>can be difficult to pull oneself away from particularly appetising foes. | <br>某种凶猛而且但愿已经灭绝的生物的干缩头颅。<br>它能将使用者的腹部变成一个咬牙切齿、准备吞食敌人的大嘴。<br>这张大嘴能赋予强大的咬击，其伤害还会随使用者的力量进一步提升，<br>并且可以吞食被杀死的生物来暂时提升使用者的再生速度。<br>不幸的是，它也会带来极度的饥饿感，让人难以摆脱特别诱人的敌人。 | keep | 干头、腹部巨口、力量额外加成、吞死者暂加再生及饥饿难离诱人敌全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1019；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:722；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:maxwell's memoranda | <br>A loosely bound collection of the infamous Maxwell's schemes, diagrams and plans.<br>Amidst messages written to and by his many minions, allies of convenience and<br>hated rivals, a patient reader can discover spells of electrifying power. | <br>一本松散的装订集，收录着臭名昭著的麦克斯韦的草图、图表和计划。<br>在与他的众多下属、因利害暂时结盟的盟友和讨厌的竞争对手的往来信息中，<br>耐心的读者可以发现电能的咒语。 | adjust | 麦克斯韦松装方案、下属与权宜盟友及仇敌往来；allies of convenience误成处得来的友人，权宜关系丢失。 确认问题：allies of convenience是出于利害的权宜盟友，不是处得来的友人。 已修复 I-MAXWELL-ALLIANCE：allies of convenience是出于利害的权宜盟友，不是处得来的友人。；处理：权宜盟友/因利益暂时结盟者。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1013；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:716；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:medusa talisman | <br>A fossilised jellyfish polyp, inscribed with sigils. Causes a mane of long<br>stinging tendrils to sprout from the wearer's head which lash out at nearby<br>enemies whenever the wearer attacks, poisoning them. When they feel their host's<br>life is in danger, they can even turn these poisoned foes to stone. | <br>一块刻有符印的水母螅体化石。使佩戴者头部生出长长的<br>螫刺触须鬃毛，每当佩戴者攻击时向附近敌人挥击，使其中毒。<br>当它们感到宿主生命垂危时，甚至可以将这些中毒的敌人变成石头。 | keep | 美杜莎水母石化触须、每次攻击附近毒击及濒危时石化已中毒敌全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1028；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1556；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:midnight gem | <br>[[gem]]<br><br>The stoneborn brought forth this gem from the uttermost depths of the earth as<br>a gift and a warning: beware Zot! That it lies now within Zot's power is a sure<br>proof of the perversity of mortals and fate alike. | <br>[[gem]]<br><br>石裔从大地最深处带来了这块宝石，既是礼物，也是警告：当心佐特！<br>如今它却落入佐特的掌控之中，这无疑证明了凡人与命运同样乖戾。 | adjust | 午夜宝石石裔赠礼警告，凡人与命运同样乖戾误成凡人堕落一如它的命运，命题关系错。 确认问题：mortals and fate alike的共同乖戾被改成凡人堕落和宝石自身命运，主语关系错。 已修复 I-MIDNIGHT-FATE：mortals and fate alike的共同乖戾被改成凡人堕落和宝石自身命运，主语关系错。；处理：凡人与命运同样乖戾/荒诞的明证。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1035；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:730；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:milky-white gem | <br>[[gem]]<br><br>Smooth as a spider's silk, white as the eyes of some crawling thing which has<br>lived too long in the dark, this gem buzzes with a fearful potential. Still, to<br>a certain eye, it possesses a strange allure... | <br>[[gem]]<br><br>这颗宝石光滑得像蜘蛛丝，白得像久居黑暗的爬行动物的眼睛，<br>嗡嗡作响，充满了可怕的潜能。<br>尽管如此，在某些人眼中，它仍有一种奇异的吸引力…… | adjust | 乳白宝石光滑白眼、久暗潜能；to a certain eye是某些观察者眼中，不是某种程度。 确认问题：to a certain eye是某类观察者的眼中，不是某种程度。 已修复 I-MILKY-EYE：to a certain eye是某类观察者的眼中，不是某种程度。；处理：不过，在某些人眼中，它仍有一种奇异的吸引力。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1043；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:737；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:mist talisman | <br>A small censer from which pours an endless smoky haze. Transforms the wearer's<br>head into a billowing shroud of mist. Any potions they drink in this form will<br>be rapidly decomposed into gases which they can expel via melee attacks as<br>blasts of harmful clouds. They can also slowly condense the dungeon's air into<br>potions of mist, allowing them to become intangible and blind monsters.<br><br>However, the lack of typical mouth parts makes it difficult to pronounce<br>incantations, greatly slowing the speed at which they cast spells. | <br>一个不断涌出烟雾的小香炉，会将佩戴者的头部变成翻腾的雾团。<br>在此形态下饮用的药水会迅速分解成气体，佩戴者能通过近战攻击将其喷出，<br>释放成有害的云雾。还能缓慢凝结地牢中的空气，制成雾药水，<br>让自己变得没有实体，并使怪物失明。<br><br>不过，缺少正常的口腔结构会使咒语难以发音，大幅减慢施法速度。 | keep | 雾护符头变雾、药水拆有害云并凝雾药、虚体致盲、口部缺失慢施法全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1051；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1714；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:morningstar | <br>A mace with a head covered in short spikes. | <br>一把锤头覆有短刺的钉头锤。 | keep | 晨星钉头锤短刺全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1062；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:745；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:mossy gem | <br>[[gem]]<br><br>Though it drips with mud and muck, still a peculiar dignity attaches itself to<br>this gem. The people of the Swamp, who first carried this stone, struggled<br>against insurmountable odds. They failed, but there is much to admire even in<br>the ruin of their efforts. | <br>[[gem]]<br><br>尽管这颗宝石滴着泥浆和淤泥，但它仍带着一种特殊的高贵气质。<br>最先拿起这块石头的沼泽居民曾与不可逾越的困难作了斗争。<br>他们失败了，但即使他们的努力付之东流，也有很多值得钦佩的地方。 | keep | 苔绿宝石沼泽人失败的奋争仍可钦佩全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1066；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:749；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:my sojourns in swampland | <br>While purporting itself to be the personal account of a famous naturalist, it<br>becomes clear upon reading that this book was compiled from multiple unrelated<br>sources, including notes from a stagehand of a travelling magical circus. The<br>travelogue may be fictitious, but some of the spell diagrams carefully<br>transcribed in the margins seem quite real. | <br>虽然自称是一位著名博物学家的个人记述，但阅读后很快发现这本书<br>是从多个不相关的来源汇编的，包括一个巡回魔法马戏团舞台助手的笔记。<br>旅行记录可能是虚构的，但页边仔细抄录的一些法术图示似乎非常真实。 | keep | 沼地游记冒名自然学家、多来源含马戏舞台助手、故事假法术真全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1075；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1562；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:necronomicon | <br>An extremely rare book, powerful and sinister. Many foolhardy magicians have<br>tried to study this tome, only to find themselves entangled within necromantic<br>forces they could not hope to control. | <br>一本极为罕见的书，强大而邪恶。许多鲁莽的魔法师试图研究这本巨著，<br>却发现自己已陷入了他们无法控制的亡灵力量之中。 | keep | 极罕邪恶强书、鲁莽研究者困不能控死灵力量；亡灵力量可理解，但术语可明确死灵之力。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1083；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:757；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:orb | <br>A sphere of crystal, carried in place of a shield. Magic scintillates within<br>its interior. | <br>一个水晶球，可拿在装备盾牌的位置。魔法在里面闪烁着。 | keep | 球体水晶持盾位闪魔光全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1089；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:762；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:orb of zot | <br>An invaluable artefact. Once you have escaped to the surface with it, your<br>quest is complete. | <br>一个无价之宝。只要你能带着它逃到地面，你的任务就宣告完成。 | keep | 宝珠带出地面完成冒险全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1094；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:766；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:orcbow | <br>A recurved bow, crudely crafted from troll-bone and warg hair. The cave orcs'<br>use of archery, so unlike their surface-dwelling ancestors, shows the influence<br>of their elvish allies. | <br>这把反曲弓是用巨魔的骨头和座狼的毛发粗糙地制作而成。<br>洞穴兽人与他们居于地表的祖先不同，他们掌握着箭术，<br>这表明他们受到了精灵盟友的影响。 | adjust | 兽人弓巨魔骨座狼毛，洞穴兽人不同地表祖先却误为表亲，血缘关系反转。 确认问题：surface-dwelling ancestors祖先误成表亲，血缘/年代关系变。 已修复 I-ORCBOW-ANCESTORS：surface-dwelling ancestors祖先误成表亲，血缘/年代关系变。；处理：与他们居于地表的祖先不同。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1099；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:770；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:pair of boots | <br>A pair of boots. They are worn on the feet, and cover all but the largest<br>hooves and talons. | <br>一双靴子。它们要穿在脚上，一般是合身的，除非是最大的蹄子或爪子。 | keep | 靴覆盖除最大蹄爪，中文合身表述完整。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1105；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:776；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:pair of gloves | <br>A pair of gloves. They are worn on the hands, and cover all but the largest<br>claws. | <br>一双手套。它们要戴在手上，一般是合身的，除非是最大的爪子。 | keep | 手套除最大爪，全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1110；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:780；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:parchment | <br>A brief text on magic, perhaps excerpted from some larger work. It contains<br>knowledge of one spell. | <br>一篇关于魔法的简短文本，或许是从某部更大的著作中摘录的。<br>它包含一个法术的知识。 | keep | 摘自大作短文，只载一个法术全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1115；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1568；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:partisan | <br>A long polearm with sharp protrusions on either side of the spearhead. | <br>一把长柄武器，矛头两侧有锋利的突出物。 | keep | 矛头两侧尖凸长兵器全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1120；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1573；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:pearl dragon scales | <br>The nacreous scales of a pearl dragon. It grants its wearer resistance to<br>negative energies. | <br>一套珍珠龙的珍珠质鳞甲。它赋予穿戴者对负能量的抗性。 | keep | 珍珠龙珍珠质鳞、负能量抗性全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1124；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:784；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:phantom mirror | <br>A hand mirror which can create a reflection of a nearby creature, clouding<br>in the process. The reflection's duration increases with Evocations skill and<br>decreases with the willpower of the target. It is, invariably, slightly weaker<br>than the creature it mirrors. | <br>这面手镜能创造附近生物的镜像，镜面也会在过程中变得浑浊。<br>镜像的持续时间随魔力释放技能的提升而增加，随目标的意志力越强而减少。<br>它总是比它所映射的生物稍弱些。 | keep | 镜像附近生物、镜浑浊、魔力释放增时意志减时、总略弱全；越强而减少语法可顺。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1129；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:788；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:phial of floods | <br>An enchanted vessel of elemental water. Removing the stopper unleashes a torrent<br>of water, smashing the target and flooding the nearby area. If any creatures<br>engulfed by the wave need air to breathe, they'll be unable to cast spells until<br>they recover. The strength of the torrent and the duration of the flooding<br>increase with Evocations skill. | <br>一只盛着元素之水的附魔容器。<br>拔掉瓶塞便会释放洪流，冲击目标并淹没周围区域。<br>被波浪吞没的生物若需要呼吸空气，在恢复之前便无法施法。<br>洪流的威力和淹水的持续时间都会随魔力释放技能提升。 | keep | 元素水容器洪流伤害淹区、需呼吸者恢复前禁施法、威力与淹水时长随魔力释放全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1136；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:794；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:plate armour | <br>A full suit of solid metal plate: cuirass, pauldrons, vambraces, waist plate<br>and greaves. It provides excellent protection. | <br>一整套实心金属板：胸甲、护肩、臂甲、腰甲和胫甲。它提供了出色的保护。 | keep | 实心板甲胸肩臂腰胫部件与优秀防护全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1144；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:801；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:player invis desc | <br>While invisible, most monsters have greatly reduced accuracy against you,<br>cannot make attacks of opportunity, and the spells they cast may sometimes be<br>aimed at the wrong location. They may also stumble around and eventually lose<br>track of you, especially if their intelligence is low.<br><br>In addition, melee attacks you make against such creatures have a chance<br>(proportional to your stealth and weapon skill) of catching them off-guard and<br>dealing increased damage, especially if performed with a short blade.<br><br>Certain creatures can see through this invisibility and it will always be<br>completely ineffective while standing in water. | <br>隐形时，大多数怪物攻击你的命中率会大幅降低，无法发动借机攻击，<br>施放的法术有时也会瞄准错误的位置。它们还可能四处踉跄，最终失去你的踪迹，<br>智力较低的怪物尤其如此。<br><br>此外，你对这些生物发动近战攻击时，有一定几率打它们一个措手不及，<br>造成更高伤害；这一几率与你的潜行和武器技能成正比，使用短刃时尤其有效。<br><br>某些生物能看穿这种隐形，而站在水中时，隐形总会完全失效。 | keep | 隐形命中大降、禁借机、法术可能错位、失追踪及低智尤其；潜行武器概率偷袭短刃优；看穿者与站水完全无效全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1208；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1723；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:potion of ambrosia | <br>A strange substance, produced by ghost moths. Consuming it causes regeneration<br>of health and magic, along with total befuddlement. The two effects are<br>fundamentally linked – the regeneration ends the moment the confusion does. | <br>其中的奇怪物质，是由鬼蛾产生的。<br>饮用它，会恢复生命值和法力，但也会让人完全混乱。<br>这两个效果根本相连——混乱一结束，生命值与法力恢复也会立即停止。 | keep | 鬼蛾神酿HPMP恢复与混乱相连、混乱终止就停恢复全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1149；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:805；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:potion of attraction | <br>A potion which makes the drinker attract enemies, translocating them quickly closer<br>for the duration of the effect. The effect is surprisingly subtle, and unwary<br>victims may sleep through it entirely. | <br>这瓶药水能让饮用者引来敌人，在效果持续期间，能迅速将敌人传送到近处。<br>其效果十分微妙，不警觉的、受影响的怪物可能仍在沉睡。 | adjust | 吸引药快速传近敌、持续效应及可能不醒全；持续时间能缺内属病句可窄修。 确认问题：在效果持续时间能缺少范围词，病句。 已修复 I-ATTRACTION-GRAMMAR：在效果持续时间能缺少范围词，病句。；处理：在效果持续期间迅速将敌人传近。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1263；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:885；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:potion of berserk rage | <br>A potion which can send one into an incoherent rage, granting them a great but<br>temporary increase to their health, damage, and speed. In exchange, their mind<br>is clouded by anger, only allowing them to move and attack in melee. The rage<br>will wear off quickly if they do not attack monsters, and upon expiry, the<br>imbiber will be fatigued, causing them to slow dramatically and rendering them<br>unable to berserk again for a short duration. | <br>这瓶药水能让饮用者陷入一种失去理智的狂暴状态，<br>极大地但暂时地提升其生命值、伤害力和速度。<br>作为代价，他们的心智会被愤怒所蒙蔽，只能进行移动和近战攻击。<br>如果不攻击怪物，狂暴状态会迅速消退；状态结束后，饮用者将陷入疲惫，<br>行动大幅减缓，并在短时间内无法再次狂暴。 | keep | 狂暴暂增HP伤速、仅移动近战、不攻击快结束、之后疲惫大减速与短禁再狂暴全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1155；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:811；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:potion of blood | <br>A potion containing the essence of life. | <br>这个瓶子里装着生命的精华。 | keep | 旧血药装生命精华，全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1165；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:820；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:potion of brilliance | <br>A potion which increases the power of the drinker's spells and halves their<br>magic cost (rounding up). | <br>饮用这瓶药水会提高饮用者的法术威力，并且法力消耗减半（向上取整）。 | keep | 辉煌加法术威力、耗MP减半向上取整全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1169；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:824；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:potion of cancellation | <br>A potion which ends most magical effects, good or bad, affecting one who drinks<br>it. It also reduces magical contamination. | <br>这瓶药水对饮用它的人来说，能终结大多数或好或坏的魔法效果。<br>它也能减少诱变辐射。 | adjust | 取消大多数好坏魔法及减少诱变辐射，魔法污染术语须与dissipation同改。 确认问题：相同玩家机制 magical contamination 被写成魔法污染；不是环境污染。消散项链正文还将消退写成随时间流逝速度翻倍。 已修复 I-CONTAM：相同玩家机制 magical contamination 被写成魔法污染；不是环境污染。消散项链正文还将消退写成随时间流逝速度翻倍。；处理：采用诱变辐射，明确辐射与负面效果消退速度翻倍。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1174；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:828；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377；docs/glossary.md:820；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc:386；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:1889 |
| body:items:potion of curing | <br>A potion which restores a small amount of health, and cures poison and<br>confusion. | <br>这瓶药水能回复少量生命值，并治疗中毒和混乱。 | adjust | 治愈回少HP解毒混乱；健康值应生命值以免界面资源错称。 确认问题：health玩家资源误写健康值，界面实际为生命值。 已修复 I-CURING-HP：health玩家资源误写健康值，界面实际为生命值。；处理：回复少量生命值。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1179；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:833；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc:82 |
| body:items:potion of enlightenment | <br>A potion which uplifts both the body and mind of its drinkers, lifting them<br>from the ground and increasing their Will to resist the world's temptations. | <br>这瓶药水能够提升饮用者的身心，<br>将他们从地面升起，并增强他们抵抗世间诱惑的意志力。 | keep | 启迪飞行与意志抵诱惑两项全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1184；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:837；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:potion of experience | <br>A truly wonderful and very rare drink, which grants experience when consumed. | <br>一瓶非常罕见的极佳饮品，饮用时能给予经验。 | keep | 经验药稀少奇妙并给经验全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1189；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:842；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:potion of haste | <br>An enchanted beverage which speeds the actions of anyone who drinks it. | <br>这种魔力饮料，能加快饮用者的行动速度。 | keep | 加速行动而非只移速全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1193；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:846；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:potion of heal wounds | <br>A magical healing elixir which causes wounds to close and heal almost<br>instantly. | <br>一个神奇的疗伤灵药，能使伤口立刻愈合。 | keep | 伤口几乎立刻合拢，中文立即可接受。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1197；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:850；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:potion of invisibility | <br>A potion which confers invisibility on one who consumes it.<br><br>[[player invis desc]] | <br>这瓶药水能让饮用者隐形。<br><br>[[player invis desc]] | keep | 隐形药引用player invis desc完整，两级引用统一审。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1202；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:854；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:potion of lignification | <br>A potion which transforms the imbiber into an animated banyan tree, with sap for<br>blood and branches capable of holding weapons. Such a tree has minimal evasion<br>but increased health and natural armour, and is resistant to poison, and immune<br>to negative energy, torment, sleep, blinding, and does not need to breathe.<br><br>However, it is rooted in place while the transformation lasts, and cannot teleport. | <br>这瓶药水会将饮用者变成一棵会动的榕树，以树液为血，枝干能够持用武器。<br>这种树的闪避能力极低，但生命值和天然护甲得到增强，具有毒素抗性，<br>并免疫负能量、折磨、睡眠和致盲，也无需呼吸。<br><br>然而，在变化持续期间，它会扎根原地，无法传送。 | keep | 树形武器、低EV高HP甲、毒抗、负能量折磨睡眠盲免疫无呼吸、根定禁传全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1222；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:860；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:potion of magic | <br>A valuable potion which grants an infusion of magical energy. | <br>这是瓶很有用的药水，它能注入魔力。 | keep | 魔力药补魔力全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1231；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:868；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:potion of might | <br>A potion which greatly increases the power of the drinker's melee attacks. | <br>这瓶药水能大幅提升饮用者近战攻击的威力。 | keep | 力量药近战增强全，药名与Might状态可有上下文差异。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1235；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:872；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:potion of mist | <br>A vial of mist which temporarily turns the imbiber's body insubstantial,<br>protecting them from constriction, petrification, barbs, sticky flame, webs,<br>nets, and being caught by bolas.<br><br>It will also end most of those effects if they are already afflicted. | <br>一瓶雾气，会暂时使饮用者的身体变为虚体，免疫束缚、石化、倒刺、<br>黏着火焰、蛛网、网和流星索的缠缚。<br><br>如果饮用者已经受到这些效果影响，它也会解除其中大部分效果。 | keep | 雾药暂虚体免疫七类含流星索且结束大部已有状态全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1239；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1734；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:potion of moonshine | <br>A potent alcohol, distilled in some dubious corner of the dungeon. Drinking it<br>reduces the imbiber's accuracy, evasion, and spellcasting success for a while. | <br>一种在地牢某个可疑角落蒸馏的烈酒。饮用后会在一定时间内降低饮用者<br>的命中率、闪避和施法成功率。 | keep | 月光酒暂降准确EV施法成功三项全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1247；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1577；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:potion of mutation | <br>A potion which mutates the drinker, removing several mutations then<br>granting a few random mutations, which are likely (but not guaranteed) to be<br>beneficial. | <br>这瓶药水会使饮用者发生突变：先移除数个突变，再赋予数个随机突变；<br>后者很可能有益，但并无保证。 | keep | 突变药先去数个后给若干随机、可能非必好全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1252；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:876；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:potion of resistance | <br>A potion which grants temporary resistance to a variety of harmful effects:<br>fire, cold, electricity, poison, and acid. | <br>这瓶药水能暂时地赋予饮用者对一些有害效果的抗性：火、寒、电、毒和酸。 | keep | 抵抗药暂火冷电毒酸五抗全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1258；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:881；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:prismatic gem | <br>[[gem]]<br><br>Shining with every colour of the rainbow and a few others besides, some<br>consider this gem 'a bit tacky'. Preposterous! | <br>[[gem]]<br><br>这颗宝石闪耀着彩虹色和其他几种颜色，但一些人认为这颗宝石“有点俗气”。真是荒唐！ | keep | 棱彩宝石彩虹外另色、有人嫌俗反驳笑话全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1269；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:890；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:protean talisman | <br>An ever-changing fragment of something primordial; its substance seems to<br>undulate between flesh and bone and perhaps even metal. A sufficiently skilled<br>shapeshifter can stabilise it into a useable - if unpredictable - form.<br><br>(If your Shapeshifting skill is at least 6, attempting to put this on will<br>transform it into a random one of: Rimehorn, Scarab, Medusa, or Spore talismans.) | <br>一块不断变化的原始物质碎片；其物质似乎在血肉、骨骼甚至金属之间波动。<br>足够熟练的变形者可以将其稳定成可用的——尽管不可预测的——形态。<br><br>（如果你的变形术技能至少为6，尝试戴上它将使其随机变成以下之一：<br>霜角、圣甲虫、美杜莎或孢子护符。） | keep | 原始变幻护符，变形术至少6尝试佩戴才随机霜角/圣甲虫/美杜莎/孢子四一全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1276；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1582；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:quad damage | <br>A mysterious item resembling a rune of some kind. Once evoked, it will make the<br>user glow blue and add a reverb to all sound... and there may be other effects<br>as well. | <br>一个看上去像是某种符文的神秘物品。<br>激活它会导致使用者身上发出蓝光并能给所有声音加入混响……也许还有其他效果。 | keep | 四倍伤神秘类符物、激活蓝光混响且暗示其他效应全，未泄源未说的具体倍数承诺。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1285；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:896；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:quarterstaff | <br>A sturdy wooden pole, meant for fighting. | <br>一根结实的用于战斗的木棍。 | keep | 结实战斗木杆全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1291；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:901；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:quick blade | <br>A dagger with an uncanny enchantment upon it, allowing it to strike twice<br>for every blow its wielder makes. It takes great skill to use to its full<br>potential. | <br>这把带有不可思议的魔力的匕首，能让使用者一次发动双重攻击。<br>但需要高超的技巧才能发挥其全部潜力。 | keep | 快刃每次挥击双重打击与高技能发挥全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1302；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:912；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:quicksilver dragon scales | <br>The scales of a quicksilver dragon. Although it does not provide its wearer<br>with as much protection as the scales of some heavier dragons, it is somewhat<br>lighter and less encumbering. The armour repels both attacks on the wearer's<br>willpower and magical modification of itself - it cannot be enchanted. | <br>一套水银龙鳞甲。尽管它不像一些更重的龙的鳞甲那样，<br>能为穿戴者提供更多的防护，但它却更轻便、妨碍也更少。<br>这套盔甲会抵抗对穿戴者意志力的攻击，<br>但也会抵抗针对自身的魔法改造——它不能被附魔。 | keep | 水银龙轻甲相对防护低、抗意志但不可附魔全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1295；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:905；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:quill talisman | <br>A spiny trinket reminiscent of a cactus. Causes sharp quills to grow all over<br>the wearer's body which may cause injury to anyone unwise enough to attack them<br>in melee. | <br>一个像仙人掌般的多刺饰品。使尖锐的刺生长遍布佩戴者的全身，<br>可能伤害任何愚蠢到用近战攻击佩戴者的人。 | keep | 尖刺全身、近战挨打可能伤攻击者全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1308；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1590；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:rapier | <br>A slender, sharply pointed sword, with an uncommonly elegant design. | <br>一把纤细、尖锐的剑，有着非凡的优雅设计。 | keep | 细尖雅致刺剑全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1314；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:917；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:riddle talisman | <br>An intricate puzzlebox containing an unknowable prize. Transforms the wearer into<br>a riddle-loving sphinx. In this form, they are {{<br>    if you.race() == "Felid" then<br>        return "normally capable of wearing a cloak and barding (though your" ..<br>               " own diminutive size would prevent this)"<br>    else<br>        return "capable of wearing a cloak and barding"<br>    end<br>}}, and their melee attacks cause powerful winds to strike their foe which do<br>increased damage for every open space next to them. They are also masterful<br>enchanters, casting Hex spells much more easily and ignoring a portion of their<br>foe's Willpower.<br><br>Alas, their love of riddles is so compulsive that even the most hardened<br>adventurer will be unable to resist posing them to new foes they encounter, no<br>matter how unwise this may be. | <br>一个内含未知奖品的精巧谜盒。将佩戴者变成一只爱好谜语的斯芬克斯。<br>在此形态下，佩戴者{{<br>    if you.race() == "Felid" then<br>        return "通常能够穿戴披风和马铠（尽管你自身的微小体型会阻止这一点）"<br>    else<br>        return "能够穿戴披风和马铠"<br>    end<br>}}，其近战攻击会引起强风打击敌人，相邻每多一格空地，伤害就越高。<br>佩戴者还是高超的惑控师，更容易施放诅咒系法术，<br>并忽略敌人一部分的意志力。<br><br>唉，佩戴者对谜语的热爱如此强烈，以至于即使是最坚毅的冒险者也无法<br>抗拒向遇到的新敌人提出谜语，无论这可能多么不明智。 | keep | 斯芬克斯谜盒、Felid衣服马铠不可穿Lua例外、敌旁空位增风击、Hex施法与穿部分意志及强迫问谜全；诅咒系为当前正式学派译名，惑控师为职业语境，不能强制统一。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1318；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1595；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:rimehorn talisman | <br>A crude ornament carved from the horn of a rare arctic beast - so cold to the<br>touch that ice still clings to it. Transforms the wearer into a rime yak, a hardy<br>ungulate that is highly resistant to cold and whose breath is so frigid that it<br>freezes the walls around itself as it fights. Being so attuned to arctic<br>temperatures also makes it easier for the wearer to cast Ice magic. | <br>一件由稀有极地野兽的角雕刻而成的粗糙饰品——触感如此寒冷，冰仍然附着<br>在上面。将佩戴者变成一头霜角牦牛，一种高度抵抗寒冷的坚韧有蹄动物，<br>其呼吸如此冰冷，以至于在战斗中会冻结周围的墙壁。对极地温度的如此适应<br>也使佩戴者更容易施放寒冰魔法。 | keep | 霜角极寒兽角、变霜牦牛高冷抗战斗冻墙及寒冰易施全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1337；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1611；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:ring mail | <br>A light leather suit reinforced with a covering of metal rings. It is<br>protective in combat, but slightly uncomfortable due to the added weight. | <br>一件覆有金属环的轻质皮革护甲。它在战斗中能提供防护，<br>但因重量的增加而略有妨碍。 | keep | 皮甲覆环轻且加重少妨碍全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1345；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:921；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
