| body:items:ring of wizardry | <br>A ring that increases the success rate of its wearer's magical spells. | <br>这枚戒指能提升佩戴者施法的成功率。 | keep | 巫术戒加施法成功非威力。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1413；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:986；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:robe | <br>A large, loose-fitting, wide-sleeved outer garment made of light cloth. It<br>offers little protection against physical harm, but does not hinder evasion or<br>spellcasting. | <br>一件有着宽袖的宽松大件外套，由轻质布料制成。<br>它几乎无法防备物理伤害，但不会妨碍闪避或施法。 | keep | 轻宽袖法袍小物防、不妨EV施法全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1417；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:990；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:rune of zot | <br>A charm which allows entry into the Realm of Zot. | <br>这个神符是打开佐特领域大门的钥匙。 | keep | 神符许可佐特门，钥匙比喻合理。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1423；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:995；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:sack of spiders | <br>A woven silk bag. Opening it will cover the area with webs, spiders, and other<br>skittering things. Evocations skill increases spider quality, quantity and webbing. | <br>一个用丝绸织成的袋子。打开它，蛛网、蜘蛛和其他爬虫会覆盖这片区域。<br>魔力释放技能会提高蜘蛛的质量与数量，并增加蛛网覆盖。 | keep | 蛛袋铺网蜘蛛等，魔力释放增质数量与网全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1427；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:999；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:sacred scourge | <br>A blessed weapon, woven by the saints in Heaven and hated by the unholy. It is<br>a favoured weapon of the Shining One's servants. | <br>这是一把神圣的武器，由天堂的圣徒所编织，并被邪恶者憎恨。<br>这件武器深受光辉者的信徒喜爱。 | keep | 天堂圣徒织祝福鞭、邪恶恨、光辉者仆偏爱全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1432；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1004；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:sanguine gem | <br>[[gem]]<br><br>They who smote down Death herself and buried themselves in a Tomb of their own<br>making were not shy of their ambitions. Fain to seize upon baubles and<br>overweening proud, their Lord journeyed into their eternal unrest with this gem<br>upon their breast. | <br>[[gem]]<br><br>一些人击败了死神，把自己埋在自己建造的坟墓里，而且并不耻于自己的野心。<br>他们的主出于对小玩意儿的喜好和自负，把这颗宝石戴在胸前，<br>进入了他们永恒的动荡之中。 | keep | 血红宝石弑死神自葬、野心、逐饰骄傲领主与永恒不宁完整；动荡可建议不宁以凸显亡灵。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1448；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1009；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:sanguine talisman | <br>A vial of roiling blood that pulses with the beat of an unseen heart. Transforms<br>the wearer into a fearsome vampire - a creature that straddles the border between<br>life and undeath. They can drink the lifeblood of the living to heal themselves,<br>and even turn those they slay stealthily into vampiric thralls, but their normal<br>health regeneration stops while they are aware of nearby threatening enemies.<br>Their hypnotic gaze often prevents monsters from shouting when alerted and may<br>even daze them. At great effort, they can also<br>scatter into a swarm of bats - either to flee or to assail their enemies. | <br>一瓶翻涌的鲜血，随着一颗无形心脏的搏动而脉动。<br>它会将佩戴者变成可怕的吸血鬼，一种徘徊于生与不死边界的生物。<br>佩戴者可以吸取活物的生命之血来治疗自己，甚至将潜行击杀的生物变成吸血仆从，<br>但察觉到附近有构成威胁的敌人时，常规生命值再生就会停止。<br>其催眠目光往往能使被惊动的怪物无法喊叫，甚至可能令其眩晕。<br>还能费力地散成一群蝙蝠，用来逃跑或攻击敌人。 | keep | 血红护符活/亡界、吸活血回血、潜行杀转仆、察威胁禁HP再生、目光禁喊与可能眩晕、费力散蝠全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1437；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1618；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:scale mail | <br>A leather suit covered with metal plates attached to each other in overlapping<br>rows to provide full protection, but at the cost of reduced freedom of<br>movement. | <br>一套皮革护甲，表面覆盖着相互重叠成排的金属片，能提供充分防护，<br>但代价是会对行动造成不便。 | keep | 重叠金属片皮甲防高活动受限全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1457；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1017；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:scarab talisman | <br>A small golden cameo of a beetle. Transforms the wearer into a sun scarab, a<br>fiery insect that carries around a mote of searing heat and light outside<br>itself, like a tiny sun.<br><br>This solar ember burns adjacent enemies every second time the scarab attacks,<br>and can be healed by swapping with it. In addition, the scarab's own mandibles<br>can reduce enemies' fire resistance and Fire spells are easier for the wearer<br>to cast. | <br>一个甲虫形状的小金浮雕。将佩戴者变成一只太阳圣甲虫，<br>一种携带着灼热与光明的火虫，在其身外像一颗微型太阳。<br><br>圣甲虫每攻击两次，这颗太阳余烬就会灼烧一次相邻的敌人；<br>与太阳余烬交换位置可以治疗它。此外，圣甲虫自身的下颚可以降低<br>敌人的火焰抗性，佩戴者也更容易施放火焰法术。 | keep | 日圣甲虫体外余烬两次攻击灼邻、交换治余烬、下颚减火抗与火易施全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1463；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1627；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:scarf | <br>A length of stylish fabric. At its creation, enchantments were woven into it,<br>and as such it cannot accept further enchantment. | <br>一段时髦的织物。在制作它时，已经织入了魔法，因此它不能继续附魔。 | keep | 围巾制作已织附魔所以不能再附魔全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1474；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1022；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:scimitar | <br>A long sword with a wide, curved blade. | <br>一把具有弯曲阔刃的长剑。 | keep | 长弯阔刃弯刀全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1479；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1026；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:scroll of acquirement | <br>A wonderful scroll which causes the creation of a valuable item, with the<br>reader choosing from a small selection. The items offered will often be a<br>good match for the reader's skills; and if nothing recommends itself, the<br>reader can always choose a heap of gold. | <br>这张奇妙的卷轴能创造一件珍贵物品，让读者从少量备选物品中挑选。所提供的物品通常与读者的技能非常匹配；<br>如果它推荐的东西没什么有用的，读者总是可以选择要一大堆金子。 | adjust | 获取卷轴实际从具体物品小列表选，中文写选择物品类型属旧机制；技能匹配与可选金堆全。 确认问题：选物品类型是旧机制；实际在已生成的少数具体物品中挑选。 已修复 I-ACQUIREMENT-TYPE：选物品类型是旧机制；实际在已生成的少数具体物品中挑选。；处理：让读者从少量备选物品中选一件珍贵物品。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1483；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1030；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:scroll of amnesia | <br>A scroll that allows its reader to selectively erase one spell from memory to<br>recapture the magical energy bound up with it. | <br>这张卷轴能让读者选择遗忘一个法术，<br>从而释放被该法术占用的记忆容量。 | keep | 遗忘一个自选法术释放占记忆容量，源magical energy是容量叙事，可保留准确实现表述。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1490；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1036；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:scroll of blinking | <br>A scroll that allows its reader to teleport a short distance, with precise<br>control. | <br>这张卷轴能够让读者进行一次精确的短距离传送。 | keep | 精确短传闪现全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1495；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1041；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:scroll of brand weapon | <br>A scroll that imbues a weapon with a random brand. Any existing brand will be<br>replaced with a different one, and any brand forbidden by your current god will<br>not be chosen. Artefacts cannot be branded in this way.<br><br>Melee weapons will commonly be branded with the flaming, freezing, heavy,<br>venom or protection brand (or with the special brand exclusive to the category<br>of weapon being branded), and rarely with the draining, electrocution, spectral,<br>vampiric or chaos brand.<br><br>Ranged weapons will commonly be branded with the flaming, freezing, heavy or<br>draining brand, and rarely with the electrocution or chaos brand. | <br>这张卷轴能给武器加上一个随机的铭印。<br>任何已有的铭印会被一个不同的替代，且不会加上你当前的神所抵触的铭印。<br>神器无法以这种方式获得铭印。<br><br>近战武器通常会获得火焰、冰冻、重击、淬毒或防护铭印，<br>（或该类武器专属的特殊铭印），但很少会被印上汲取、电击、幽魂、吸血或混沌铭印。<br><br>远程武器通常会获得火焰、冰冻、重击或汲取铭印，<br>但很少会获得电击或混沌铭印。 | keep | 随机铭印替换不同、禁神铭印不选、神器不能及近/远两概率分组全部读。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1500；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1045；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:scroll of butterflies | <br>A scroll that surrounds its user with a flight of beautiful butterflies, blowing<br>back other creatures nearby with the flapping of their wings. | <br>这张卷轴，能让使用者周围环绕着一群美丽的蝴蝶，<br>蝴蝶扇动翅膀，将附近其他生物吹退。 | keep | 蝴蝶围己扇翅吹退附近其他生物全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1514；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1057；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:scroll of enchant armour | <br>A scroll that places an enchantment on a piece of armour chosen by the reader.<br>Body armour and bardings can be enchanted up to the same value as their base<br>armour rating. Bucklers, kite shields and tower shields can be enchanted up to<br>+3, +5 or +8 respectively, and other armour can be enchanted up to +2. Magical<br>artefacts cannot be enchanted at all. | <br>这张卷轴，能让读者选择一件防具进行附魔。<br>铠甲和马铠可以附魔至与其自身护甲等级相同的值。<br>小圆盾、鸢盾和塔盾分别可以附魔至＋3、＋5或＋8，其他防具可以附魔至＋2。<br>神器无法继续附魔。 | keep | 护甲上限本身基础AC、盾3/5/8其他2神器不可全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1519；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1062；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:scroll of enchant weapon | <br>A scroll that places an enchantment on a weapon chosen by the reader,<br>increasing both accuracy and damage. Weapons can be enchanted up to +9. Magical<br>artefacts cannot be enchanted at all. | <br>这张卷轴，能让读者选择一件武器进行附魔，同时提升命中和伤害。<br>武器最多能附魔至＋9。神器无法继续附魔。 | keep | 武器增强命中伤、上限9神器不可全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1527；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1069；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:scroll of fear | <br>A scroll that causes great fear in nearby foes, causing them to flee until<br>attacked, cornered, or enough time has passed.<br><br>Non-living, undead and plant monsters cannot be feared, and berserk or frenzied<br>monsters are also immune. | <br>这张卷轴能极大地震慑附近的敌人，使他们逃跑，<br>除非他们受到攻击、走投无路或是已经过去了足够长的时间。<br>没有生命的、亡灵和植物类怪物不会吓到，狂暴或疯狂的怪物也对此免疫。 | keep | 恐惧持续至攻击困住或超时，无生亡灵植物和狂暴狂乱免疫全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1533；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1074；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:scroll of fog | <br>A scroll that surrounds the reader with a dense cloud of fog, which can block<br>vision temporarily. The fog takes a short time to fully spill out. | <br>这张卷轴能在读者身边生成一层浓雾，暂时阻挡视线。<br>浓雾需要短暂时间才能完全扩散开来。 | keep | 雾延迟扩散完全与暂遮视线全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1541；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1080；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:scroll of identify | <br>A useful magic scroll which identifies the properties of any unknown object. | <br>这张有用的魔法卷轴，可以鉴定任何未知物品的属性。 | keep | 鉴定未知物属性兼容正文全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1546；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1085；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:scroll of immolation | <br>A scroll that fills the creatures around the reader with an unstable and<br>powerful inner flame. This fire is released any time the victims are hit, and<br>explosively released upon their death. Giant creatures cause bigger explosions. | <br>卷轴令读者周围的生物充满强大而不稳定的内焰。<br>受害者每次被击中时都会释放火焰，死亡时则爆炸性释放；<br>巨型生物能造成更大的爆炸。 | keep | 内焰每次挨打释放火死亡爆炸巨物更大全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1550；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1089；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:scroll of noise | <br>A prank scroll that creates a loud noise when read. | <br>这个卷轴在阅读时会恶作剧般地制造大量噪音。 | keep | 噪音恶作剧巨响全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1556；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1095；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:scroll of poison | <br>A scroll that fills the air with poison, covering every unoccupied space in<br>sight with toxic fumes. | <br>这张卷轴能用于弥漫毒气，视线中每一个空置的空间都会被毒烟填充。 | keep | 剧毒视野空格填毒烟全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1560；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1099；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:scroll of revelation | <br>A scroll that reveals its reader's surroundings. The layout of the current<br>floor is fully mapped, and everything within a moderate radius, including<br>both visible and invisible monsters, is momentarily shown. | <br>这张卷轴能显现读者的周围环境。它会展现出当前楼层的所有布局，<br>并短暂显示一定范围内的所有东西，包括可见和隐形的怪物。 | adjust | 启示全层地图+中半径暂现所有怪，momentarily误成只立刻（缺短暂显示时限）。 确认问题：momentarily shown短暂显示被改成立刻显示，时限丢失。 已修复 I-REVELATION-DURATION：momentarily shown短暂显示被改成立刻显示，时限丢失。；处理：短暂显示一定范围内所有东西，包括可见和隐形怪。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1565；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1103；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:scroll of silence | <br>A scroll that eliminates all sound near the reader. This makes reading scrolls,<br>casting spells, invoking divine abilities, or shouting impossible in the<br>reader's vicinity.<br><br>Certain monsters have innate magical or special abilities which will still be<br>usable while silenced.<br><br>The effect starts out with a large radius, which will then shrink, eventually<br>covering only the reader, before it times out. | <br>这张卷轴可以消除读者周围的所有声音。<br>这使读者附近无法阅读卷轴、施放法术、调用神圣能力或喊叫。<br><br>某些怪物具有与生俱来的魔法或特殊能力，即使被沉默也能使用。<br><br>起始的生效范围较大，然后会缩小，最后只覆盖施法者，直到完全失效。 | keep | 沉默禁卷轴法术神赐与喊、天生特能例外、半径先大后缩最终只己全；末句施法者可窄为读者。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1571；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1108；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:scroll of summoning | <br>A scroll that calls forth several allied creatures woven from shadow into the<br>shapes of those beings found within the reader's immediate vicinity. | <br>这个卷轴能召唤出几个作为友方的阴影生物，<br>他们会以当前读者附近的生物为模样塑造形象。 | keep | 召唤暗影塑形附近可生怪，友方数只全，实际选floor population另核源称immediate vicinity非仅现已站怪。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1583；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1117；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:scroll of teleportation | <br>A scroll that translocates the reader to a random position after a short delay.<br>Reading this scroll while waiting for a teleportation will instead cancel it. | <br>这张卷轴能在一小段时间之后，将读者传送到一个随机的位置。<br>在等待传送时再阅读这种卷轴，会取消其效果。 | keep | 延迟随机传送，再读可取消全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1588；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1122；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:scroll of torment | <br>A scroll that calls on the powers of darkness to inflict great pain on any<br>nearby creature — including the reader! This halves the resilience of all<br>living creatures and cuts down all holy creature resilence by about a third,<br>although it is never directly fatal. | <br>此卷轴将召来黑暗能量，给附近所有生物以极大的痛楚——甚至包括读者！<br>它会使所有活物的生命值减半，并使所有神圣生物的生命值减少约三分之一，<br>但不会直接致死。 | keep | 折磨活物HP半、神圣约1/3且不直接致死全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1593；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1127；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:scroll of vulnerability | <br>A scroll that briefly halves the willpower of the reader and any nearby beings,<br>rendering them vulnerable to many magical effects. The scroll cannot affect<br>those fully immune to such effects. | <br>这张卷轴会将读者和周围的任何生物的意志力暂时减半，<br>使其易受许多魔法效果的影响。完全免疫这些效果的不受此卷轴影响。 | keep | 脆弱读者邻生物意志暂减半、完全免疫者例外全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1600；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1133；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:scythe | <br>A farm implement, usually only used by untrained mobs in combat. In practice,<br>it's quite similar to a halberd. | <br>这只是一个农具，通常只有没受过训练的家伙才会在战斗中使用它。<br>在使用时，它很像戟。 | defer terminology | 镰刀农具民兵与类似戟全，兼容并未排除。 延期理由：全文两语与所有可用条件已读，当前文字命题对应；但身份已移除/兼容，不把旧描述当现行正常玩法承诺，不作推测性重命名。 责任：parent / item lifecycle or compatibility restoration owner；重入：恢复此身份或明确要求覆盖其真实兼容暴露路径时重绑实现再审；此前保留本冻结中文。；保留值见中文列。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1606；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1138；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:serpent talisman | <br>A jade snake coiled around a fossilised egg. Transforms the wearer into an<br>amphisbaena - a legendary two-headed serpent. It is capable of wearing two<br>pieces of headgear at once and its powerful coils can wind around foes and crush<br>them to death, but its cold blood leaves it susceptible to being slowed by cold<br>attacks. | <br>一条玉蛇盘绕在一颗化石蛋的周围。<br>它能将使用者变成双头蛇——一种传说中的双头巨蛇。<br>它能同时佩戴两件头部装备，其强大的蛇身可以缠绕敌人并将其挤压至死，<br>但它的冷血使其容易被寒冷攻击减速。 | keep | 双头蛇可双头具、盘绞致死与冷血易慢全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1611；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1143；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:shadow dragon scales | <br>The scales of a great umbral dragon. It is heavier than most dragon scale<br>armours, but its encumbrance does not penalise the wearer's stealth. It also<br>grants additional stealth to the wearer. | <br>巨大的暗影龙的鳞甲。它比大多数龙鳞甲重，但其负重不会妨碍穿戴者潜行，<br>并会额外提升穿戴者的潜行能力。 | keep | 影龙较重但负重不减潜行且额外潜行全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1745；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1239；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:shimmering gem | <br>[[gem]]<br><br>Unearthly energies gently flow along the surface of this gem, guided by the<br>archmage who first built the Elven Halls. Countless generations of elves<br>flocked to learn from her, but her foremost pursuit was always the perfection<br>of this piece of art. | <br>[[gem]]<br><br>在最初建造精灵殿堂的大法师的引导下，超凡的能量沿着这颗宝石的表面缓缓流淌。<br>无数代精灵纷纷向她学习，但她的最高追求却始终是使这件艺术品臻于完美。 | keep | 精灵厅创始女大法师与完美宝石艺术的首要追求全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1627；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1157；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:shining gem | <br>[[gem]]<br><br>Many are the treasures of the Ironbound Order, but none older nor more precious<br>than this steel-shining gem. The Vaults were first forged to hold it, and none<br>who gazed within its depths could fault the choice. | <br>[[gem]]<br><br>铁缚会有很多珍宝，但没有比这颗发出钢铁光泽的宝石更古老、更珍贵的了。<br>宝库最初就是为了保存它而锻造的，凡是凝视过它深处的人，都觉得这一决定无可指摘。 | adjust | 闪耀宝石建宝库保石，none could fault the choice是无人能非议该选择，误成任何人不会作出错误选择。 确认问题：could fault the choice是不会非议造宝库保存此石的决定，不是窥宝石者不会作错选择。 已修复 I-SHINING-CHOICE：could fault the choice是不会非议造宝库保存此石的决定，不是窥宝石者不会作错选择。；处理：凝视宝石深处的人，无不觉得这一选择无可指摘。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1619；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1150；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:shop voucher | <br>A coupon good for one item of any price from any store in the dungeon, to be<br>used automatically when you would make a purchase that exceeds your funds. How<br>generous! No refunds. One coupon per purchase per customer. Offer limited by<br>availability. Void if defaced or otherwise altered. Valid only within the<br>dungeon of Zot and its subsidiary branches. Additional purchase not required. | <br>一张可在任何地牢商店兑换任意价格物品的优惠券，当你进行超出资金<br>的购买时自动使用。多么慷慨！概不退款。每笔交易每客户限用一张。<br>优惠受库存限制。如有涂改或以其他方式篡改则无效。<br>仅限佐特地牢及其附属分支有效。无需额外购买。 | keep | 购物券任意价超钱自动、一客一交易、无退货存货限篡改无效限地牢分支无需另购全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1636；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1636；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:short sword | <br>A personal stabbing weapon with a short grip. | <br>一件个人用的短柄刺杀武器。 | keep | 短柄个人刺击剑，刺杀可读为刺击但建议不暗示游戏偷袭条件。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1648；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1168；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:shortbow | <br>A curved piece of wood and string, for shooting arrows. | <br>一段弯曲的木头和绳子，用于射箭。 | keep | 木弓弦射箭全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1644；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1164；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:sling | <br>A piece of cloth and leather for launching stones, adequate for hunting small<br>game like rabbits or goblins. | <br>一段用来发射石头的布料和皮革，能够猎捕小型猎物，诸如兔子和地精。 | keep | 投石布皮带可猎兔地精全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:895；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:636；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:smoky gem | <br>[[gem]]<br><br>Swirls of dark smoke seem to lurk in the depths of this gem. Countless dark<br>deeds were done in the Dungeon even before Zot seized and remade it, and their<br>dreadful residue now taints every hint of beauty trapped within its confines. | <br>[[gem]]<br><br>这块宝石的深处似乎潜藏着一股黑烟。<br>甚至在佐特占领、改造地牢之前，就已经有无数的黑暗在地牢上演，<br>现在那些可怕的残留物玷污了困于地牢范围内每一个美丽的事物。 | keep | 烟宝石佐特之前恶行与残迹污染美，黑暗上演虽泛化文学可保留。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1652；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1172；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:spear | <br>A hunting weapon consisting of a wooden shaft with a pointed metal head<br>fastened on one end. | <br>一把用于狩猎的武器，由木杆和固定在一端的金属尖头组成。 | keep | 木柄端金属尖狩猎矛全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1660；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1180；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:spider talisman | <br>A strange charm made from shed arachnid exoskeletons bound together with silk.<br>Transforms the wearer into an agile jumping spider who can move swiftly towards<br>foes and inflict grievous damage on any it catches unaware. It cannot be<br>ensnared by webs, but its attacks can ensnare its enemies in them. It can also<br>leap briskly away from many dangers. | <br>一件由蜕下的蛛形纲外骨骼用蜘蛛丝捆扎成的奇异护符。将佩戴者变成<br>一只敏捷的跳蛛，能迅速向敌人移动，并对任何被其发现的毫无防备者<br>造成重创。它不会被网困住，但其攻击可以将敌人困入网中。<br>它也可以迅速跳离许多危险。 | keep | 跳蛛突进偷袭、蛛网不缠己而攻击缠敌、可跃逃全；网泛词可建议蛛网而非投网免疫暗示。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1665；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1643；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:spore talisman | <br>A small charm made from a still-living mushroom. Transforms one of the wearer's<br>arms and parts of their lower body into a vibrant mass of multicoloured fungus.<br>Melee attacks in this form may release spores that weaken their target, as well<br>as cause mushrooms to sprout on the ground behind them which will release their<br>own bursts of dazing spores if allowed to grow. Shapeshifting skill increases<br>the durability of these mushrooms as well as their damage. | <br>一件由仍活着的蘑菇制成的小护符。将佩戴者的一只手臂和部分下半身变成<br>一团充满活力的彩色真菌。在此形态下的近战攻击可能释放出削弱目标的孢子，<br>并导致蘑菇在目标后方的地面上生长，如果允许其生长，会释放出自身的<br>致眩孢子爆发。变形术技能提高这些蘑菇的耐久度和伤害。 | keep | 孢子手臂下身菌、近战削弱目标、目标后蘑菇成长眩孢、变形术耐久伤害全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1673；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1650；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:staff of air | <br>A staff that increases the power of air spells cast by its wielder, and<br>insulates them from electricity. If the wielder is skilled in Evocations and<br>Air Magic, they can shock those struck by it, dealing electrical damage which<br>bypasses half of defenders' armour. | <br>这根法杖能增强使用者施展空气魔法的威力，并能使其与电绝缘。<br>如果使用者精通魔力释放技能和空气系技能，就能用其电击受击者，<br>所造成的电击伤害会无视防御者一半的护甲。 | keep | 气杖增强空气、rElec、魔力释放+气系触电无视半甲全；绝缘修辞源本有，不能机械改免疫。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1682；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1184；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:staff of alchemy | <br>A staff that increases the power of alchemy spells cast by its wielder, and<br>protects them from the effects of poison. If the wielder is skilled in<br>Evocations and Alchemy, they can envenom those struck by it. | <br>这根法杖能增强使用者施展炼金系法术的威力，并保护其免受毒素影响。<br>如果使用者精通魔力释放技能和炼金系技能，就能用它使受击者中毒。 | keep | 炼金杖增强炼金毒抗、魔力释放炼金双技触毒全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1689；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1190；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:staff of cold | <br>A staff that increases the power of ice spells cast by its wielder, and<br>protects them from the effects of cold. If the wielder is skilled in Evocations<br>and Ice Magic, they can freeze those struck by it. | <br>这根法杖能增强使用者施展寒冰魔法的威力，并能帮助其抵御寒冷的影响。<br>如果使用者精通魔力释放技能和寒冰系技能，就能用其冰冻受击者。 | keep | 寒冰杖增强寒冰冷抗、双技能触冷全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1695；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1195；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:staff of conjuration | <br>A staff that increases the power of conjurations cast by its wielder. If the<br>wielder is skilled in Evocations and Conjurations, they can blast those they<br>strike with pure energy. | <br>这根法杖能增强使用者施展咒法系法术的威力。<br>若使用者精通魔力释放技能和咒法系，就能以纯粹能量轰击受击者。 | keep | 咒法杖增强咒法、双技纯能量击全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1701；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1200；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:staff of earth | <br>A staff that increases the power of earth spells cast by its wielder. If the<br>wielder is skilled in Evocations and Earth magic, they can fracture the ground<br>beneath those struck by it, dealing substantial damage - though much less to<br>creatures which fly. | <br>这根法杖能增强使用者施展大地魔法的威力。<br>如果使用者精通魔力释放技能和大地系技能，<br>就能破碎受击者脚下的地面，造成巨大伤害——尽管对飞行生物的伤害要小得多。 | keep | 地杖增强大地、双技碎地大伤但飞行显著少全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1714；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1211；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:staff of fire | <br>A staff that increases the power of fire spells cast by its wielder, and<br>protects them from the effects of fire. If the wielder is skilled in Evocations<br>and Fire Magic, they can burn those struck by it. | <br>这根法杖能增强使用者施展火焰魔法的威力，并能帮助其抵御火焰的影响。<br>如果使用者精通魔力释放技能和火焰系技能，就能用其烧灼受击者。 | keep | 火杖增强火法、火抗、双技灼烧全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1721；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1217；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:staff of necromancy | <br>A staff that increases the power of necromantic spells cast by its wielder, and<br>protects them from negative energy. If the wielder is skilled in Evocations and<br>Necromancy, they can inflict great pain on those living souls they strike,<br>dealing negative energy damage which bypasses armour. | <br>这根法杖能增强使用者所施展的死灵法术的威力，并帮助其抵御负能量的影响。<br>如果使用者精通魔力释放技能和死灵系技能，就能使被自己击中的活物承受巨大痛楚，<br>并对其造成无视护甲的负能量伤害。 | keep | 死灵杖增强死灵负能抗、双技仅活物穿甲负伤全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1707；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1205；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:starry gem | <br>[[gem]]<br><br>Odd lights twinkle within the depths of this gem. From what strange stuff is it<br>made, and from what distant land did it travel? | <br>[[gem]]<br><br>这颗宝石的深处闪烁着奇异的光芒。<br>它是用什么奇怪的物质制成的？它是从哪个遥远的地方流传过来的？ | keep | 群星宝石异物来源与远方来历疑问全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1727；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1222；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:steam dragon scales | <br>The scales of a steam-breathing dragon. Unlike the scales of some larger<br>dragons, it does not provide its wearer with much protection (beyond a<br>resistance to scalding steam), but it is extremely light and supple. | <br>吐息蒸汽之龙的鳞甲。<br>它为穿戴者提供的防护不如那些更大的龙的鳞甲（除了对灼热蒸汽的抵抗力），<br>但它却十分柔软、轻盈。 | keep | 蒸汽鳞轻柔而防低，仍抗烫蒸汽全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1734；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1229；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:stone | <br>A small chunk of dense but otherwise unremarkable natural mineral. It can be<br>thrown to cause minor damage. | <br>一小块致密而常见的天然矿物。投掷它可以造成少量伤害。 | keep | 石头小致密自然矿物、投小伤全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1740；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1235；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:storm dragon scales | <br>The scales of a lightning-breathing dragon. It is heavier than most dragon<br>scale armours, and gives its wearer resistance to electrical discharges. | <br>吐息闪电之龙的鳞甲。它比大多数龙鳞甲重，并赋予穿戴者电抗。 | keep | 风暴龙较重与电抗全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1751；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1244；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:storm talisman | <br>Lightning trapped, impossibly, in a bottle. Lets the wearer walk through the air<br>as a raging, lightning-filled tempest. The wearer's melee attacks are electrified<br>and strike all adjacent foes. The wearer also flies, gains immunity to poison,<br>miasma, petrification, constriction, and sticky flame, and also resists<br>electricity. They can launch themselves as a lightning bolt, blasting through<br>everything in their way. | <br>闪电不可思议地被捕获在一个瓶子里。<br>它能让使用者在空中穿行，如同一股狂暴的、充满闪电的风暴。<br>使用者的近战攻击将带有电属性，会打击到所有相邻的敌人。<br>使用者还能够飞行，免疫毒、瘴气、石化、束缚和粘性火焰，并有了电抗。<br>使用者可以像闪电箭一样发射自己，炸开挡路的一切。 | keep | 风暴护符邻敌电近战、飞行、毒瘴石化绞缠黏火免疫、电抗、雷冲全；黏火词应同根可建议统一黏着火焰。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1756；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1248；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:swamp dragon scales | <br>The scales of a swamp dragon. It confers resistance to poison on its wearer. | <br>一套沼泽龙鳞甲。它能赋予穿戴者对毒的抗性。 | keep | 沼龙毒抗全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1765；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1256；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:talisman of death | <br>A grey-black vessel, infused with dark power through a sickening ritual.<br>Transforms the wearer into an undying offence against life itself.<br><br>Foes struck by wearer's melee weapons or hands are weakened, slowed, and drained.<br>The wearer can also heal themself by tormenting living foes nearby; Shapeshifting<br>skill increases the amount healed. Further, the wearer resists cold, has enhanced<br>willpower, and is immune to poison, miasma, negative energy, and torment.<br><br>The wearer also gains some of the more dubious benefits of having an undead body.<br>They are vulnerable to holy damage and Dispel Undead, and cannot consume potions. | <br>一个灰黑色的容器，以令人不安的仪式向其注入了黑暗的力量。<br>它能将使用者变成对生命本身永不消亡的亵渎之物。<br><br>被使用者用近战武器或手击中的敌人会被虚弱、减速、衰竭。<br>使用者还可以通过折磨附近的活物敌人来治疗自己；提升变形术技能能增加治愈量。<br>此外，使用者将能抵抗寒冷，意志力会增强，并免疫毒、瘴气、负能量和折磨。<br><br>使用者还能从这副亡灵身躯中获得一些颇为可疑的好处。<br>然而，使用者易受神圣攻击和驱散亡灵的伤害，且无法服用药水。 | keep | 死亡容器仪式、亵渎永存形、近战虚弱慢衰竭、折磨活敌治疗随技能、冷抗意志免疫四、圣伤驱散易伤禁药全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1769；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1260；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:the unrestrained analects | <br>A collection of spells that assault everything in sight of the caster,<br>unrestrained by petty limitations like 'needing a clear shot' or 'concern about<br>collateral damage'. | <br>一本法术合集，收录着能攻击施法者视线范围内一切东西的咒语，<br>不受诸如“需要畅通的射击路径”或“担心附带伤害”等琐碎原则的局限。 | adjust | 肆无忌惮集视野全攻击且不需畅通射线/不顾连带；clear shot误作明确的射击，应畅通的攻击路径。 确认问题：clear shot是畅通的射击路径，明确的射击不通且漏障碍条件。 已修复 I-UNRESTRAINED-LOS：clear shot是畅通的射击路径，明确的射击不通且漏障碍条件。；处理：需要畅通的攻击路径/无遮拦的射线。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1854；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1325；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:there-and-back book | <br>A compilation of children's stories about great adventures, always ending with<br>the traveller returning to the place they started. The love infused into its<br>pages by countless generations has granted it power, allowing a skilled mage to<br>transport others by reciting specific passages. | <br>这本汇编收录着关于伟大冒险的儿童故事，<br>这些故事总会以旅行者回到他们开始的地方为结束。无数代人向其中注入了爱，<br>赋予了它力量，使得熟练的法师可以通过吟诵特定的段落传送他人。 | keep | 儿童冒险归乡、代代爱赋力吟特定段落传他者全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1782；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1272；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:throwing net | <br>A mesh of ropes knotted together with weights around the edge, used to entangle<br>and entrap targets. Struggling victims can eventually destroy the net and break<br>free, if they live long enough. | <br>一个在边缘打结了重物的绳网，用来缠住和诱捕猎物。<br>挣扎着的受害者最终能摧毁网并获得自由，如果他们能活到那么久的话。 | keep | 绳网边重物困目标、若活够久可挣毁逃出全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1789；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1278；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:tin of tremorstones | <br>A set of dormant, magnetic earth elementals in the form of tiny, very heavy<br>pebbles. When released, the elementals are drawn magnetically to the center of<br>nearby monsters, where they literally explode with rage at their rest being<br>disturbed. Tremorstones usually land slightly off-target, and the user is<br>always at risk of being hit. However, armour is extremely effective at<br>repelling the lightweight fragments of rock from a tremorstone's explosion, so<br>a well-armoured wielder has little to fear. Evocations skill increases the<br>number of explosions. | <br>一组休眠的、有磁性的土元素，外形是微小的、非常重的鹅卵石。<br>当释放时，元素会被磁力吸引到附近怪物的中心，<br>在那里，它们会因在休眠时被扰动而愤怒地爆炸。<br>震颤石通常会稍微偏离目标，并且使用者总有被击中的风险。<br>然而，护甲在抵挡震颤石的爆炸中所迸发的轻质岩石碎片非常有效，<br>所以一个护甲精良的使用者没什么好担心的。提升魔力释放技能能增加爆炸次数。 | keep | 微重磁性土元聚怪中心爆炸怒、常偏且自伤风险、甲对轻碎屑很有效、技能增爆数全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1799；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1287；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:tower shield | <br>A large piece of wood and metal, to be strapped on one arm for defence. | <br>一大块木头和金属，通过绑在一只手臂上进行防御。 | keep | 木金属大塔盾绑单臂全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1795；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1283；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:treatise on traps | <br>An analytical volume discussing methods and materials with which to construct a<br>dizzying array of traps - from those intended to safeguard a pantry from ants to<br>ones which would please even the most sadistic dungeon architect. | <br>一本分析性的著作，讨论构建令人眼花缭乱的各种陷阱的方法和材料——<br>从旨在保护储藏室免受蚂蚁侵害的陷阱，到连最虐待狂的地牢建筑师<br>都会满意的陷阱。 | keep | 从防蚁到虐狂建筑师陷阱的方法材料分析全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1810；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1657；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:trident | <br>A fishing spear improved with a longer shaft and a three-pronged metal head. | <br>一把经过改进的鱼叉，有了更长的杆和三叉的金属头。 | keep | 鱼叉长柄三尖金属改进全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1816；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1296；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:triple crossbow | <br>A crossbow with three strings arranged in series to provide exceptional power,<br>initially designed as a siege weapon and then scaled down. It takes a<br>considerable amount of time to load and fire. | <br>一把将三根弦串联排列、因而威力非凡的弩，最初被设计为攻城武器，<br>后来缩小了规模。装填和发射都需要一些时间。 | keep | 三弦串联攻城弩缩小、装填射击耗时可观；一些时间轻化程度，可建议较长时间不阻挡。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1832；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1306；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:triple sword | <br>A formidable weapon created by a master craftsman. The blade of the sword forks<br>into three great razor-sharp edges. | <br>一把由大师级工匠打造的强大武器。这把剑的刀刃分叉成三个锋利的刀口。 | keep | 大师剑分三利刃全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1838；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1311；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:trishula | <br>A blessed trident moulded by cleansing flame, with three points symbolising the<br>combined might of the three holy gods. It is a favoured weapon of the Shining<br>One's servants. | <br>一把在净化之焰中铸就的三叉戟，三个尖端象征三位善神合在一起的力量。<br>这件武器深受光辉者的信徒喜爱。 | keep | 净化火铸三叉象三善神力量、光辉者仆偏爱全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1843；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1315；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:trismegistus codex | <br>A magical book<br>written by a<br>numerologically obsessed wizard.<br>Everything from sentence<br>length to overall<br>organization is structured.<br>It's unclear whether<br>the author thought<br>this was helpful. | <br>这本魔法书，由痴迷于数字命理学的巫师所写。<br>从句子长度到整体组织，都是结构化的。<br>目前尚不清楚作者是否认为这是有用的。 | keep | 三重伟大数秘作者句长组织结构全；英文每行三词形式未保留，中文形式可另议Suggestion。 本卡替代表达仅Suggestion，现译保留。 Suggestion S-CODEX-VERSE 保留，未作强制修改：源九行每行三词的数秘形式可在中文另设计，但信息本身完整。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1820；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1300；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:troll leather armour | <br>The stiff and knobbly skin of a troll. It magically regenerates its wearer's<br>flesh, once attuned to the wearer's body at full health. | <br>巨魔坚硬而多瘤节的外皮。穿戴后，当佩戴者生命值全满时，它会与其身体同调，<br>随后便能以魔法再生佩戴者的血肉。 | adjust | 巨魔皮同调只需之后达到满HP，不必满HP时穿戴；中文额外加入穿戴时机限制，player-equip同调检查与恢复后重检见证。 确认问题：满HP后同调被误为必须在已满HP时才穿戴，额外增加操作时机限制。 已修复 I-TROLL-ATTUNE：满HP后同调被误为必须在已满HP时才穿戴，额外增加操作时机限制。；处理：穿戴后在生命值回满时与身体同调，之后提升生命再生。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1849；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1320；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:vision talisman | <br>A small charm bearing the likeness of an eye. It gives the wearer supernatural<br>sight, allowing them to perceive the clouds of magical residue left behind<br>whenever beings cast spells. Touching those clouds allows them to convert that<br>leftover magic into unnerring projectiles against nearby foes.<br><br>This third eye even allows one to see from further distances than would<br>otherwise be possible{{<br>    if you.get_base_mutation_level("+LOS") &gt; 0 then<br>        return " (but your own vision is already as long as possible)."<br>    else<br>        return ", but be warned - creatures perceived this way will perceive you back."<br>    end<br>}} | <br>一个带有眼睛图样的小护符，会赋予佩戴者超自然的视觉，<br>让其看见生物施法时留下的魔法残余云雾。触碰这些云雾，<br>便能将残余魔法转化为必定命中的投射物，攻击附近敌人。<br><br>这第三只眼甚至能让人看见比原本更远的地方{{<br>    if you.get_base_mutation_level("+LOS") &gt; 0 then<br>        return "（不过，你自身的视野已经达到极限）。"<br>    else<br>        return "，但要当心——你以这种方式看到的生物也会看到你。"<br>    end<br>}} | keep | 视觉魔法残云触转必中弹、+LOS Lua已极限或双方可见警告两路全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1860；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1741；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:wand of acid | <br>A magical device which throws bolts of corrosive acid. | <br>一支可以射出腐蚀性酸液的魔法道具。 | keep | 酸杖射腐蚀酸液全，bolts并非实体弩箭且未误译。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1876；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1330；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:wand of charming | <br>A magical device which causes a creature to become fiercely, but briefly,<br>loyal to the user. | <br>这支魔法道具能使一个生物短暂但极其忠诚于使用者。 | keep | 魅惑短暂但强烈效忠全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1880；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1334；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:wand of digging | <br>A magical device which drills tunnels through unworked rock. | <br>一支能在未开凿岩石中钻出通道的魔法道具。 | keep | 挖掘仅未开凿岩石全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1885；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1338；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:wand of flame | <br>A magical device which throws little puffs of flame. | <br>一支能喷射出一些火焰的魔法道具。 | keep | 火焰小团喷发全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1889；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1342；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:wand of iceblast | <br>A magical device which creates a loud explosion of ice shards, bypassing half<br>of victims' resistance to cold. | <br>这支魔法道具，能造成轰鸣作响的碎冰爆炸，这能穿透受击者的一半寒抗。 | keep | 冰爆巨响碎冰无视半寒抗全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1893；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1346；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:wand of light | <br>A magical device which fires a ray of searing light, injuring and blinding<br>those struck. Only living, undead, demonic and angelic monsters can be blinded,<br>and tougher monsters will recover their vision more quickly. | <br>这支魔法道具，能发射灼热的光线，使被击中的怪物受伤和失明。<br>只有活物、亡灵、恶魔和天使类怪物才能失明。并且更强的怪物会更快地恢复视力。 | keep | 光杖伤盲，只活亡恶魔天使可盲且强者快恢复全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1898；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1350；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:wand of mindburst | <br>A magical device which launches a psychic attack on a target creature. If it<br>overcomes their willpower, it 'blows their mind' in a violently literal fashion,<br>dealing damage that bypasses their armour entirely. It is useless against<br>mindless creatures. | <br>一支能对目标生物发动心灵攻击的魔法道具。<br>若攻击压倒目标的意志力，就会猛烈地“轰爆其心智”——这绝非比喻，而是字面意义上的轰爆——<br>并造成完全无视护甲的伤害；对无心智生物无效。 | keep | 心爆压意志才伤、字面轰脑无视甲、无心智无效全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1904；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1355；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:wand of paralysis | <br>A magical device which can render a creature immobile, incapable of moving any<br>of its limbs. | <br>这支魔法道具，能使生物无法移动，且无法移动任何肢体。 | keep | 麻痹不能动任何肢全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1911；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1361；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:wand of polymorph | <br>A magical device which causes a creature to be transmogrified into another<br>form. It is especially effective against shape-changing creatures. | <br>这支魔法道具能将目标生物变形成另一种形态。它对拥有变形能力的怪物特别有效。 | keep | 变形为另形且对变形者更有效全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1916；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1365；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:wand of quicksilver | <br>A magical device which fires a beam of destructive energy, dispelling<br>enchantments on creatures struck. | <br>这支魔法道具，能发射一束破坏性能量，驱散被击中的生物身上的魔法状态。 | adjust | 水银杖驱散enchantments误作魔力，会被理解成耗MP；应驱散魔法状态/附魔。 确认问题：dispelling enchantments指驱散魔法状态，驱散魔力误导为清除目标MP。 已修复 I-QUICKSILVER-DISPEL：dispelling enchantments指驱散魔法状态，驱散魔力误导为清除目标MP。；处理：驱散被击中生物身上的魔法状态。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1921；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1369；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:wand of roots | <br>A magical device which fires a magical seed, entangling its target and adjacent<br>foes in quick-growing tree roots. Those entangled will be immobilised and take<br>damage over time until they escape or the roots wither away. The roots will only<br>sprout from solid ground. | <br>这件神奇的道具，能够发射一颗魔法种子，<br>将目标和相邻的敌人缠绕在快速生长的树根中。<br>那些被缠绕的怪物会被固定，并随着时间的推移受到伤害，<br>直到他们逃脱或根系枯萎。根系只会从坚实的土地中发芽。 | keep | 树根目标邻敌束缚固定持续伤、逃脱/枯萎终止且仅实地长全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1926；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1373；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:wand of warping | <br>A magical device which creates a brief but violent rift in space, damaging<br>everything caught in its wake and sometimes blinking them a short distance away. | <br>一个魔法装置，在空间中制造出短暂但猛烈的裂隙，对波及范围内的一切<br>造成伤害，有时会将它们闪烁到短距离外。 | keep | 扭曲短裂隙伤所有波及且可能短闪烁全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1933；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1663；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:war axe | <br>A military axe with a long haft and a single-bladed head. | <br>一把长柄、单刃的军用斧。 | keep | 长柄单刃军斧全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1938；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1380；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:wellspring talisman | <br>A small amphora from which pours a seemingly unending quantity of water.<br>Transforms the wearer's flesh into elemental water, allowing them to move flexibly<br>and reach to attack from a great distance, though without the precision needed<br>to stab from range. From time to time, they can even cause the water around them<br>to rise up and drown their enemies.<br><br>The malleability of this water preserves most other aspects of the wearer's<br>physiology such as their blood and bones, and even allows them to retain the<br>benefits of their physical mutations, but cold attacks can freeze it solid and<br>fire may cause it to erupt with steam. | <br>一个似乎能涌出无尽之水的小型双耳瓶。它会将佩戴者的血肉变成元素之水，<br>使其能够灵活移动，从很远的距离延伸攻击，但在远处无法完成偷袭所需的精确动作。<br>佩戴者时而甚至能让周围的水升起，淹没敌人。<br><br>这种水的可塑性保留了佩戴者生理构造的其他大部分特征，如血液与骨骼，<br>甚至能保留其身体变异带来的好处，但寒冷攻击能将其冻成固体，<br>火焰则可能使其迸发蒸汽。 | keep | 水源形延展远攻不可远偷袭、偶淹敌、保血骨物理变异、冷冻火蒸双弱全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1942；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1668；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |
| body:items:whip | <br>A long plaited strip of leather. Originally developed for use in disagreements<br>with cattle, this simple weapon is now widely used to settle differences<br>between all sorts of creatures. | <br>一条长长的编织皮条。这种简易武器最初用于解决与牲畜的分歧，<br>如今广泛用于解决各种生物之间的分歧。 | keep | 编皮鞭从牛争端到万类争端幽默全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt:1955；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt:1384；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:3060–3158；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:2636；crawl-ref/source/player-reacts.cc:1144；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc；crawl-ref/source/evoke.cc；crawl-ref/source/form-data.h；crawl-ref/source/transform.cc；crawl-ref/source/acquire.cc:1748；crawl-ref/source/zot.cc:254–377 |

| body:unrand:amulet of vitality | <br>A jewelled amulet famed for its powers of resilience and recuperation. After her final demise,<br>the amulet vanished from the pages of history. | <br>这条宝石项链以其增强生命韧性与恢复能力的效力而闻名。它恶名昭彰，<br>因为可怕的死灵法师博格尼尔使用过它，她依靠它来维持自己纤弱的生命。<br>在她最终去世后，这条项链也不知所踪。 | adjust | 宝石项链韧性与恢复双能力；中文只恢复，漏resilience；博格尼尔勉强维生与最终消失全。 确认问题：resilience and recuperation只留恢复能力，生命韧性这一独立效益遗漏。 已修复 I-VITALITY-RESILIENCE：resilience and recuperation只留恢复能力，生命韧性这一独立效益遗漏。；处理：以增强生命韧性与恢复能力闻名。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:516；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:447；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:arbalest "damnation" | <br>An unholy crossbow, forged in the fires of Gehenna. It imbues the bolts it<br>fires with the raw power of its namesake. Thankfully, the blasts this weapon<br>produces never harm the one firing. | <br>一把邪恶的弩，在欣嫩谷的火中锻造而成。它将天谴的原始力量注入弩箭。<br>值得庆幸的是，这把武器产生的爆炸不会对开火的人造成伤害。 | keep | 欣嫩谷锻邪弩天谴注弹、自身爆炸安全，对art-func.h:835 safe_to_user；Hell外部修复不回写本冻结。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:176；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:150；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:arc blade | <br>A blade somehow crafted from pure electricity. It arcs wildly between the<br>wielder and their foes as it strikes. | <br>这是一把用纯电制作的刀刃。<br>当它攻击时，它会在持用者和他们的敌人之间疯狂地释放电弧。 | keep | 纯电刃及持用者敌间电弧全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:580；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:503；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:arcane splint mail | <br>A truly ancient set of armour designed for maximum protection and flexibility.<br>Evidently intended for use by mounted hexslingers, its magic wards and sigils<br>are in a hopeless state of disrepair. Nevertheless, some traces of their power<br>still remain. | <br>一套真正古老的护甲，兼顾最大限度的防护与灵活性。<br>它显然是为骑乘的诅咒射手设计的，魔法结界与符印早已破败不堪，<br>无法修复。不过，它们的力量仍有些许残留。 | keep | 远古条板甲最大防护灵活、骑诅咒射手用、结界破败余力全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:936；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:830；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:armour of talos | <br>A huge and weighty suit of bronze plate armour. Only one with a correspondingly<br>huge body can wear it. | <br>一个巨大而笨重的青铜板甲。只有拥有与之相称的巨大身躯的人能够穿戴。 | defer terminology | 极巨大青铜甲只相称体型穿，全；Talos专名另卡。 延期理由：全文两语与所有可用条件已读，当前文字命题对应；但身份已移除/兼容，不把旧描述当现行正常玩法承诺，不作推测性重命名。 责任：parent / item lifecycle or compatibility restoration owner；重入：恢复此身份或明确要求覆盖其真实兼容暴露路径时重绑实现再审；此前保留本冻结中文。；保留值见中文列。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:656；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:571；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:athame "fimbulwinter" | <br>An instrument of terror crafted by some of Qazlal's most infamous prophets,<br>meant to coax forth a three-year winter preceding the end of time. Those chilled<br>by its wielder will feel fate's icy grip upon their throat.<br><br>As with all athames, blows made with it against those suffering baleful negative<br>statuses (other than poison) have increased base damage. | <br>卡兹拉尔麾下一些最臭名昭著的先知打造了这件恐怖的工具，<br>意图唤来末日之前长达三年的严冬。被其持用者的寒气侵袭者，<br>会感到命运冰冷的手扼住自己的喉咙。<br><br>与所有仪式匕首一样，用它攻击遭受有害负面状态（中毒除外）的目标时，<br>基础伤害会提高。 | keep | 卡兹拉尔恶名先知唤末前三年冬、寒侵命扼喉与仪匕负状态除毒全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:876；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:713；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:autumn katana | <br>An exquisitely crafted sword. Its blade is so sharp that it can cut through<br>space itself. | <br>一把做工精致的剑。它的刀刃非常锋利，甚至可以切开空间。 | keep | 利到切空间的精致刀全，非承诺每次触发多重攻击。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:523；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:453；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:axe of woe | <br>As you hold this axe your mind does not feel fully your own. Your body begins<br>to exhibit strength far beyond its capabilities, and your movements become<br>guided by Makhleb. | <br>手中拿着这柄斧子时，你感觉自己的心智似乎不再完全属于自己。<br>你的身体开始展现远超极限的力量，而马科列布似乎在指引着你的动作。 | keep | 心智不属己、身体超极力量和马科列布引导全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:542；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:471；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:black knight's barding | <br>A heavy barding made from pitch-black steel and inlaid with plates of black<br>diamond. It once protected the steed of the Black Knight during their reign of<br>terror. Those who wear it become partially undead, gaining some of the benefits<br>without the unfortunate downsides, although the great weight of metal and stone<br>slows the wearer somewhat. | <br>一件重装马铠，由乌黑的钢制成并嵌有黑色钻石板。<br>在黑骑士的恐怖统治期间，它曾保护过其坐骑。<br>穿戴者会部分转化为亡灵，获得其中一些益处，而不必承受所有恼人的弊端，<br>尽管金属和石头的巨大重量会让佩戴者变慢一些。 | keep | 黑钻黑钢马铠护黑骑士坐骑，部分亡灵收益无大部弊及重慢全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:508；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:440；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:blowgun of the assassin | <br>This blowgun seems to guide the needle to seek the most lethal point to hit<br>the target, packing a nasty punch. | <br>这把吹矢枪似乎会引导飞针寻找目标最致命的部位，打出狠辣的一击。 | defer terminology | 老刺客吹矢导针致命处全，兼容。 延期理由：全文两语与所有可用条件已读，当前文字命题对应；但身份已移除/兼容，不把旧描述当现行正常玩法承诺，不作推测性重命名。 责任：parent / item lifecycle or compatibility restoration owner；重入：恢复此身份或明确要求覆盖其真实兼容暴露路径时重绑实现再审；此前保留本冻结中文。；保留值见中文列。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:231；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:200；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:bone scales | <br>The half-stitched, or half-unstitched, torso of a bone dragon, fashioned (if one<br>may call it that) into a truly wretched piece of armour. Its jagged bones seem<br>to pulse with unlife, awaiting the command of some unholy master. | <br>一段缝合了一半，或拆开了一半的骨龙躯干，被制成了一件极其破烂的护甲，<br>如果这也能称为制作的话。它参差的骨头似乎搏动着不死之力，<br>等待着某个邪恶主人的命令。 | keep | 骨龙半缝半拆躯干破甲、死灵力待邪主全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:943；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:836；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:boots of the spider | <br>A novel pair of boots invented by a suitor of Arachne. | <br>由阿拉克涅的一名追求者发明的新奇靴子。 | defer terminology | 阿拉克涅追求者发明新靴全，兼容。 延期理由：全文两语与所有可用条件已读，当前文字命题对应；但身份已移除/兼容，不把旧描述当现行正常玩法承诺，不作推测性重命名。 责任：parent / item lifecycle or compatibility restoration owner；重入：恢复此身份或明确要求覆盖其真实兼容暴露路径时重绑实现再审；此前保留本冻结中文。；保留值见中文列。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:562；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:488；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:brooch of shielding | <br>A brooch with an intricate inlaid design, providing a range of magical<br>protections. Back in the good old days, every adventurer had one of these handy<br>devices. That, and a pony. | <br>一个设计复杂的胸针，提供一系列魔法保护。<br>从前，所有的冒险者都会带一个这种称手的东西。还有一匹小马。 | keep | 胸针镶嵌图复杂、多种魔防及从前人手一件还有小马笑话全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:472；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:408；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:captain's cutlass | <br>An infamous weapon, once used by a vile pirate captain to slaughter countless<br>innocents. He finally met his destiny when a kraken swallowed his ship, and the<br>cutlass was thought to be lost with him. | <br>曾经有个邪恶的海盗船长用这件臭名昭著的武器杀了无数的无辜之人。<br>当一只克拉肯吞下他的船时，他终于碰到了自己的劫数，<br>而那把短弯刀曾被认为和他一样，不知所踪。 | keep | 恶船长屠无辜、海怪吞船与弯刀认为同失全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:277；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:240；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:charlatan's orb | <br>This orb is the work of a master artificer, contracted to retrieve the orb, who<br>valued their life more than their professional integrity.
