While this fake<br>faithfully recreates the eerie glow and space-warping properties of the true<br>orb, the power it grants is artificial and only accessible to skilled evokers. | <br>这个球体是一位大师级工匠的作品，他受雇取回宝珠，却更珍视自己的生命<br>而非职业道德。虽然这个赝品忠实地再现了真正宝珠的诡异光芒和空间扭曲特性，<br>但它所赋予的力量是人造的，只有精通魔力释放技能的人才能使用。 | keep | 惧死胜职业操守的取珠工匠制假，重现幽光空间扭曲但仅魔力释放者能借力全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:818；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:707；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:cigotuvi's embrace | <br>A suit of armour borne of rotten flesh and bone and gristle, held intact by the<br>will of a long-dead sorcerer. The dreadful energies within it call to the bodies<br>of the recently dead, protecting the wearer with a cocoon of carrion. | <br>一套由腐肉、骨骼和软骨制成的护甲，一名死去已久的术士以意志维系着它的完整。<br>里面的可怕能量召唤着刚刚死去的人的尸体，用腐肉茧保护着穿戴者。 | keep | 腐肉骨软骨甲、亡术士意志维持、近期尸体甲茧；中文限制人的尸体，实际_harvest_corpses除Beogh兽人例外采各类尸体，不限人类。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:691；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:598；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:cloak of flash | <br>A cloak that twitches and jerks without any intervention. | <br>一件会自行抽动的披风。 | defer terminology | 无外力自行抽动披风全，兼容。 延期理由：全文两语与所有可用条件已读，当前文字命题对应；但身份已移除/兼容，不把旧描述当现行正常玩法承诺，不作推测性重命名。 责任：parent / item lifecycle or compatibility restoration owner；重入：恢复此身份或明确要求覆盖其真实兼容暴露路径时重绑实现再审；此前保留本冻结中文。；保留值见中文列。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:329；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:289；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:cloak of starlight | <br>A phosphorescent cloak, woven of pure light beams. The ripples of its folds<br>as the wearer leaps and swerves in combat may dazzle those who gaze on it. | <br>一件发出磷光的披风，由纯粹的光束织成。<br>当穿戴者在战斗中跳跃和转向时，其褶皱的起伏，可能会让注视它的人眼花缭乱。 | keep | 磷光纯光披风战斗闪转褶皱可能炫目全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:415；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:363；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:cloak of the thief | <br>A pitch-black cloak which allows its wearer to excel in the arts of thievery.<br>Even the clumsy will find their footsteps softer and the shouts of their<br>adversaries less attention-getting. | <br>一件漆黑的披风，能让它的穿着者精通盗窃艺术。<br>即便是笨手笨脚的人也会发现自己的脚步声变轻了，而敌人的喊叫声也变得不那么引人注目了。 | keep | 窃技披风让笨拙者脚步与敌喊变小全，声音作用双方。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:301；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:263；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:consecrated labrys | <br>An axe with a delicate blessing placed on it by one of the sacred Seraphim,<br>so that worthy adventurers would rid this world of demons. Rejoice, for it has<br>ways of bringing courage to its wielder in even the darkest places... | <br>这把斧头上有着神圣的炽天使的祝福，这样受赏识的冒险者就能斩除世上的恶魔。<br>欢欣吧，因为即使在最黑暗的地方，它也能给持用者带来勇气…… | keep | 炽天使祝福斧给配得者驱恶魔与黑暗中勇气全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:496；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:430；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:coolibah bardiche | <br>A massive polearm hewn in one piece from a coolibah tree. Its blade is no less<br>sharp for being made of wood, and those caught in its enchanted branches will<br>soon find themselves at home in the bog from which this deadly weapon sprouted. | <br>一件用整块库利巴木雕成的巨大长柄武器。<br>木制的刃口丝毫不减其锋利，而被它魔法枝杈困住的人很快就会发现，<br>自己已置身于这件致命武器生长的沼泽之中，仿佛回到了家。 | keep | 整木长柄斧木刃仍利、魔枝困敌与沼泽故乡隐喻全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:909；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:805；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:crown of dyrovepreva | <br>A large circlet of dull bronze, set with a dazzling array of gemstones. It was<br>first worn by a prince of the Titans, who sought protection from the incessant<br>warfare between his fellow princes. In practice, the main effect of the<br>artefact was to unite his rivals against him. | <br>一顶暗色青铜铸成的巨大王冠，镶嵌着许多光彩夺目的宝石。<br>一位泰坦族王子最先戴上它，希望它能保护自己，<br>免受其他王子之间无休止的战争波及。<br>实际上，这件神器的主要效果是让他的对手联合起来对抗他。 | adjust | 泰坦王子为同辈王子无休战乱寻防护，中文擅定王位争且漏无休；反令对手联手全。 确认问题：incessant warfare between fellow princes省无休止并擅定为王位争夺。 已修复 I-DYROVE-WARS：incessant warfare between fellow princes省无休止并擅定为王位争夺。；处理：为防同辈王子间无休止的战争伤及自身。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:312；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:273；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:crown of eternal torment | <br>A gold crown set with jet-black gems. It permanently afflicts its wearer with<br>agonising pain, substantially reducing their resilience but rendering them<br>immune to further torments. | <br>一个镶有乌黑色宝石的金王冠。<br>它使佩戴者永久遭受痛楚，大幅降低其承受伤害的能力，但也令其免受进一步的折磨。 | defer terminology | 金黑宝冠持续痛、减生命韧性但防进一步折磨全，旧兼容。 延期理由：全文两语与所有可用条件已读，当前文字命题对应；但身份已移除/兼容，不把旧描述当现行正常玩法承诺，不作推测性重命名。 责任：parent / item lifecycle or compatibility restoration owner；重入：恢复此身份或明确要求覆盖其真实兼容暴露路径时重绑实现再审；此前保留本冻结中文。；保留值见中文列。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:631；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:549；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:crown of vainglory | <br>An extravagant crown of gold filigree and glittering jewels that even a king<br>could feel immodest wearing. It grants its wearer a regal aura the match of any<br>in heaven and also a great deal of unearned confidence. | <br>一顶由金丝和闪亮珠宝制成的奢华王冠，即便是国王戴上它也会感到不够谦逊。<br>它赋予佩戴者堪比天界中任何存在的王者气场，以及大量不应得的自信。 | keep | 炫金冠连王都嫌傲，天界般威仪及无端自信全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:853；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:722；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:crystal ball of wucad mu | <br>A sphere of flawless crystal, shaped by countless mantras. When one focuses upon<br>it, the boundaries between 'self' and 'other' sometimes seem to blur.<br>{{<br>    if you.race() == "Djinni" then<br>        return "It is utterly useless to Djinn."<br>    end<br>}} | <br>一颗由无数咒语打磨而成的完美水晶球。当人们凝视它时，<br>"自我"与"他者"之间的边界似乎有时会变得模糊。<br><br>{{<br>    if you.race() == "Djinni" then<br>        return "它对灯神完全无用。"<br>    end<br>}} | keep | 完美水晶由mantras塑形、自他界模糊与Djinni无用Lua全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:40；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:29；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:dagger "morg" | <br>An ugly rusty dagger. Many years ago it was the property of a powerful mage<br>called Boris. He got lost in the Dungeon while seeking the Orb. | <br>一把丑陋、生锈的匕首。很多年前为一位名叫鲍里斯的强大法师所有。<br>他在地牢中搜寻宝珠时失踪了。 | defer terminology | 丑锈匕属鲍里斯昔寻宝失踪全，兼容。 延期理由：全文两语与所有可用条件已读，当前文字命题对应；但身份已移除/兼容，不把旧描述当现行正常玩法承诺，不作推测性重命名。 责任：parent / item lifecycle or compatibility restoration owner；重入：恢复此身份或明确要求覆盖其真实兼容暴露路径时重绑实现再审；此前保留本冻结中文。；保留值见中文列。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:129；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:109；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:dagger of chilly death | <br>A dagger made of one huge shard of sapphire. It covers opponents in ice,<br>slowing down their movement somewhat. | <br>这把匕首由一整块巨型蓝宝石制成。它将冰覆盖在敌人身上，使他们的移动有所迟缓。 | defer terminology | 巨蓝宝石匕覆冰缓移动全，兼容。 延期理由：全文两语与所有可用条件已读，当前文字命题对应；但身份已移除/兼容，不把旧描述当现行正常玩法承诺，不作推测性重命名。 责任：parent / item lifecycle or compatibility restoration owner；重入：恢复此身份或明确要求覆盖其真实兼容暴露路径时重绑实现再审；此前保留本冻结中文。；保留值见中文列。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:123；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:104；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:dark maul | <br>A large, iron-shod maul specialised for dealing massively powerful blows. Such<br>power comes at a price: the maul's head is so heavy it takes a great length of<br>time to lift it up for another swing. | <br>一柄硕大的包铁重锤，专为打出威力骇人的重击而制。<br>这种威力也有代价：锤头太重，要花很长时间才能再次抬起挥动。 | keep | 包铁巨槌超重击、抬起再挥极慢两项全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:566；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:492；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:delatra's gloves | <br>A pair of long ultramarine gloves, worn by a famed experimental alchemist in an<br>age long past. They channel the energy of discovery, empowering their wearer with<br>the force created by a blind step from ignorance to certainty. | <br>很久以前由一位著名的实验炼金术士戴过的一副群青色长手套。<br>它引导发现的能量，当佩戴者盲目地从未知到确定的探索时，会赋予其力量。 | keep | 古实验炼金术士群青长手套、从未知到确知的发现能量赋力全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:720；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:623；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:demon blade "bloodbane" | <br>A blade forged in Hell by the sacrifice of countless tortured souls. It<br>inflicts the rage and suffering of those souls upon its wielder. | <br>通过献祭无数受难灵魂而在地狱锻造出的一把剑。<br>它将那些灵魂的狂怒和苦难都施加到持有者的身上。 | defer terminology | 地狱献受难灵锻刃、狂怒苦难加己全，兼容。 延期理由：全文两语与所有可用条件已读，当前文字命题对应；但身份已移除/兼容，不把旧描述当现行正常玩法承诺，不作推测性重命名。 责任：parent / item lifecycle or compatibility restoration owner；重入：恢复此身份或明确要求覆盖其真实兼容暴露路径时重绑实现再审；此前保留本冻结中文。；保留值见中文列。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:91；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:74；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:demon blade "leech" | <br>A blade forged in Hell by the sacrifice of countless tortured souls. It fills<br>its wielder with the rage and suffering of those souls, and gorges itself<br>further on drained life force every time it strikes, leaving behind a mess of<br>blood and gore. | <br>通过献祭无数受难灵魂而在地狱锻造出的一把剑。<br>它让那些灵魂的愤怒和痛苦充斥着它的持有者，<br>每次命中还会大肆吞噬汲取的生命力，留下一片血肉狼藉。 | keep | 献魂刃使狂苦且每次命中吞生命血肉狼藉全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:115；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:97；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:demon trident "rift" | <br>A small wrinkle in the very fabric of reality, magically bound to a shaft by<br>some mad acolyte of Lugonu. Its attacks can warp through nearby space at the<br>wielder's command. | <br>卢格努的某个疯狂侍僧以魔法将现实结构中的细小皱褶绑在一根柄上。<br>在持用者的支配下，它的攻击可以扭曲穿越附近的空间。 | keep | 卢格努疯侍僧把现实褶皱绑柄、奉令穿空间攻击全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:680；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:588；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:demon whip "spellbinder" | <br>A weapon said to have once been used to keep unruly imprisoned wizards in line;<br>it violently disrupts the flow of magic around it. | <br>一把据说曾用来管束不服管束的巫师囚犯的武器；它会剧烈扰乱周围的魔力流动。 | keep | 管囚不服巫师鞭扰魔流全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:585；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:508；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:dragonskin cloak | <br>An opalescent cloak gleaming with the colours of all kinds of dragons. It<br>imbues the wearer with draconic resistances, although somewhat unreliably. | <br>这件乳白色的披风上闪烁着各种龙的颜色。<br>它为穿戴者注入了龙的抗性，但效果不是很可靠。 | keep | 龙皮虹彩、龙抗不可靠全；乳白与多色相邻可表达蛋白石光泽，不判错。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:532；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:461；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:dreamdust necklace | <br>A dull dusty mixture trapped within a cracked crystal on a thin silver chain. | <br>在一条细银链上，暗淡的尘土被束缚在一颗破碎的水晶中。 | keep | 薄银链裂晶困暗尘全；破碎可建议开裂更准，非玩法差异。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:709；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:613；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:dreamshard necklace | <br>A beautiful rainbow of colour and motion trapped within a delicate crystal on a<br>thin silver chain. Listening carefully, one can hear the distant echo of a<br>thousand dreams from all corners of reality, their melody giving a warm sense<br>of safety. | <br>在一条细银链上，色彩和运动的虹光被束缚在一颗精致的水晶中。<br>仔细聆听，你可以听到来自现实各个角落的一千个梦想的遥远回声，<br>它们的旋律给人一种温暖的安全感。 | keep | 薄银链精晶千梦虹动与安暖旋律全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:713；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:617；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:elemental staff | <br>A powerful staff which used to belong to the leader of the Guild of Five<br>Elements. It is imbued with protective and offensive enhancements from all<br>the elemental schools of magic. | <br>一支强大的法杖，曾经属于五行会的会长。<br>它注入了各种元素魔法流派的进攻和防御性增益。 | keep | 五元素会首领杖、各元素防御进攻增强全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:213；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:184；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:eveningstar "brilliance" | <br>Soon after falling, Yredelemnul attempted to twist holy energy into a dark<br>mockery of itself, turning it against its progenitors and weakening it against<br>undead and demons. It was discovered too late that such a complete perversion<br>was uncontrollable; the foul flame destabilised or destroyed everything it was<br>infused into, except for several demonic test subjects and one stolen holy<br>weapon. A lesser, and more stable, version of the dark energy proved more<br>workable, and became Yredelemnul's umbra.<br><br>This is that weapon: an eveningstar with its light long fled, despite its name,<br>and a shadow that repulses those its light used to comfort... | <br>伊莱德莱姆努尔在堕落不久后，试图将神圣能量扭曲成对自身的黑暗嘲讽，<br>使其转而对抗其源头，并削弱其对亡灵和恶魔的效力。<br>直到为时已晚，人们才发现如此彻底的扭曲是不可控的；污秽的火焰使注入的<br>一切不稳或毁灭，除了几个恶魔实验体和一件被窃的神圣武器。<br>一种较弱但更稳定的黑暗能量被证明是可行的，并为伊莱德莱姆努尔带来了暗影。<br><br>这就是那件武器：一把光芒早已消逝的昏星锤——尽管它名为"光辉"，<br>而其影子令那些它的光芒曾经抚慰过的人唯恐避之不及…… | keep | 失堕神扭圣力反源而削亡魔伤，失控毁各载体除恶魔实验与偷圣器、较弱稳定暗影起源；光辉名在而光失去、影排原安抚者全。 本卡替代表达仅Suggestion，现译保留。 Suggestion S-EVENINGSTAR 保留，未作强制修改：昏星与暮星为同义，不阻挡。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:102；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:86；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:faerie dragon scales | <br>An enchanted suit of armour created from the scales of a rare breed of dragon,<br>now thought to be extinct. This prized relic is now one of the last proofs that<br>the vividly coloured faerie dragons ever existed. | <br>这套魔力铠甲，由一种稀有品种的龙的鳞片制成，而这个物种现在被认为已经灭绝。<br>这件珍贵的遗物是色彩鲜艳的精灵龙曾经存在过的最后证据之一。 | keep | 稀龙被认灭绝、彩龙最后证据之一全；faerie显示仙灵龙而正文精灵龙，命名同根应明确仙灵龙。 本卡替代表达仅Suggestion，现译保留。 Suggestion S-FAERIE 保留，未作强制修改：精灵龙/仙灵龙是同一faerie类专名的合理变体，当前器名与正文可统一以便辨认。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:84；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:68；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:fencer's gloves | <br>A pair of gloves made of white silk. | <br>一副用白色丝绸织成的手套。 | keep | 白丝手套全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:411；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:359；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:fire dragon occultist's scales | <br>The resonating scales of the great fire-breathing dragon Zmysua, an ancient<br>occultist fond of debilitation and devastation. Her loving rivalry with the<br>elder dragon arcanist Yntzoia was legendarily destructive, and led to the both<br>of them seeking out endless mystic augmentations to triumph over one another-<br>even now, these scales still hum with thirst to confront what remains of their<br>opposite beyond death. | <br>喷火巨龙兹米苏娅身上鸣响的鳞片。她是一位古老的神秘学者，喜好衰弱与毁灭。<br>她与古龙奥术师因佐娅相爱相争，造成的破坏堪称传奇；为战胜彼此，<br>双方不断寻求无穷无尽的神秘强化。即使到了今天，这些鳞片仍在嗡鸣，<br>渴望在死亡之外，与对方留下的残骸再度交锋。 | keep | 火龙兹米苏娅喜衰弱破坏、恋争冰龙导致不断增幅求胜、死后仍欲交锋全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:885；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:727；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:force lance | <br>A plain iron lance, imbued with supernatural gravitas via the artifice of the<br>mage Gell. It strikes with a force many times stronger than that imparted by<br>the wielder. | <br>这根朴素的铁制骑枪经法师盖尔巧手改造，注入了超自然的重力。<br>它的打击力量比持用者所施加的力量强许多倍。 | keep | 盖尔铁骑枪魔造重力、打力大超持用者全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:785；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:683；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:forgewarden's cuirass | <br>A bronze chestpiece of masterful make. It is etched all over with religious<br>imagery, but the focus of the scene is obscured by a great dark stain {{<br>    if you.can_smell() then<br>        return "that smells strongly "<br>    end<br>}}of ashes and salt. It seems somehow blasphemous to wear. | <br>一件工艺精湛的青铜胸甲，上面遍刻宗教图像，但画面的中心<br>被一大片暗色的灰烬与盐渍遮住{{<br>    if you.can_smell() then<br>        return "，散发着浓烈的灰烬与盐的气味"<br>    end<br>}}。穿上它，似乎总有几分亵渎的意味。 | keep | 宗教铜胸甲图中心灰盐暗渍、can_smell两路味道与亵渎感全，中文额外具灰盐外观不抹分支。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:949；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:842；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:frozen axe "frostbite" | <br>A massive axe that looks like it was carved from a glacier, or possibly calved<br>from one. It leaves ice crystals in its wake as it swings through the air. | <br>一把巨大的斧头，像是在冰川上雕刻的，或是从冰川上崩裂下来的。<br>在空中挥舞它，会留下冰晶。 | keep | 巨冰斧从冰川刻或崩、挥留冰晶双关全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:650；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:565；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:fungal fisticloak | <br>The handiwork of a mad mycologist who once attempted to overcome the genetic<br>anxiety of wandering mushrooms by cultivating a species that could be easily<br>transported without disturbing them. The result is as much a living organism as<br>it is a piece of clothing, every linen fibre twined together with fungal mycelia<br>that draw both nutrients and confidence from whoever wears it. And in exchange<br>for such trifles as blood or peptides, the colony will instinctively lash out to<br>defend its wearer from whatever they perceive as a threat.<br><br>It's like wearing a thousand tiny friends at once! And the humming they fill<br>your mind with in the dark is actually quite lulling....<br><br>(This item also occupies your helmet slot.) | <br>一位疯狂真菌学家的作品，他曾试图通过培育一种可以轻松携带而不打扰<br>它们的物种来克服徘徊蘑菇的遗传焦虑。结果既是一件衣物，也是一个活的<br>有机体，每根亚麻纤维都与真菌菌丝交织在一起，从佩戴者身上汲取营养<br>和信心。作为对这些微不足道的血液或肽类物质的交换，菌落会本能地<br>猛烈反击被它们视为威胁的任何东西来保护佩戴者。<br><br>这就像同时穿着上千个小小的朋友！它们在黑暗中充满你心灵的嗡嗡声<br>其实相当催人入睡……<br><br>（这件物品也占据你的头盔槽位。） | keep | 真菌学家育方便携蘑菇抗遗传焦虑、亚麻菌丝汲营养信心交换血肽护主、千友暗嗡催眠与占头盔槽全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:838；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:734；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:gauntlets of war | <br>A pair of thick steel gauntlets. They were Okawaru's reward for a mighty<br>warlord. The owner is destined to die in battle, but what a death it will be! | <br>一双厚厚的钢手套。这是奥卡瓦鲁对伟大的将军的赏赐。<br>它的主人注定要死在战斗中，但那将是一场多么惨烈的死亡啊！ | keep | 厚钢护手奥卡瓦鲁赏战将、注定战死而壮烈全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:361；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:318；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:ghost crab claws | <br>A large pair of ghostly claws fashioned into gloves by a fenstrider coven for<br>use in necromantic rites. The magically inclined and pugilistically favoured<br>alike may grasp their connection with the spirits of the dead, but these pincers<br>make grasping anything else an exercise in frustration.<br><br>(This item prohibits the use of a weapon or shield while equipped.) | <br>一对巨大的幽灵蟹爪，被沼行女巫团制成手套，用于死灵仪式。<br>无论擅长魔法还是精于拳脚的人，都能把握它们与亡者灵魂的联系；<br>但若想用这对钳子握住别的东西，却只会徒增挫败。<br><br>（装备此物品时，无法使用武器或盾牌。） | keep | 沼行女巫团用幽灵蟹钳作死灵手套，魔武都连接亡灵但难握物，禁武器盾全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:859；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:792；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:giant club "skullcrusher" | <br>A massive enchanted cudgel that augments the already considerable strength of<br>anyone mighty enough to wield it. | <br>一根巨大被施入魔法的棍棒，会增强任何强大到能够挥舞它的人本就相当强大的力量。 | keep | 巨棒增强本已足强能挥者力量全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:155；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:133；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:giant spiked club "carina at dusk" | <br>Even the trolls have their share of nature poets, glassy-eyed dreamers, and<br>starving artists. This is the masterwork of one such restless soul, a paean to<br>the heavens far above. | <br>即使是巨魔之中，也不乏吟咏自然的诗人、目光迷离的梦想家和饥肠辘辘的艺术家。<br>这是其中一位不安灵魂的杰作，一曲献给高远苍穹的颂歌。 | keep | 巨魔诗人梦想家饥艺人中的焦魂苍穹颂全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:903；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:800；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:glaive of the guard | <br>A glaive commissioned several years ago by a wealthy queen fearful for the<br>safety of her vast treasury. No foe, the smith promised, could defeat a guard<br>wielding such a weapon!<br><br>It was stolen a few months later, along with the rest of the queen's treasury;<br>the guard, it transpired, had been caught napping. Still, it should serve more<br>than adequately in the hands of a waking user. | <br>几年前，一位富有的女王委托制造一把大刀，她担心自己庞大的国库的安全。<br>铁匠保证，没有任何敌人能打败一个手持这把武器的卫兵！<br><br>几个月后，它和女王金库里的其他东西一起被盗；据透露，这名卫兵被发现在打盹。<br>不过，如果使用者保持清醒，它应该仍能大显身手。 | keep | 女王委造护金库，卫兵再强但打盹遭窃，醒者仍有效反转全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:160；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:137；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:gloves of the gadgeteer | <br>A pair of suede gloves covered in a dizzying array of delicate sigils. While<br>originally intended to aid in the crafting of magical devices, they are<br>nonetheless useful for wringing every last drop of power out of someone else's<br>work. | <br>一双覆盖着令人眼花缭乱的精致符文的麂皮手套。虽然最初旨在帮助制造<br>魔法装置，但它们同样有助于从他人的作品中榨出每一滴力量。 | keep | 麂皮精符手套原助制装置、也榨别人成品能量全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:811；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:747；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:great mace "firestarter" | <br>A huge mace imbued with potent fire magic. It fills those it strikes with an<br>inner flame, and offers some protection against the resulting devastation. | <br>一把注入强大火焰魔力的巨型钉头锤。<br>它会使击中的目标充满内焰，也会保护持用者免受随后爆炸的部分伤害。 | keep | 火钉头锤注内焰及部分保护灾变全，免火云而非爆炸全免。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:596；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:518；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:great mace "undeadhunter" | <br>A weapon imbued with magic to disrupt and destroy the forces binding undead<br>creatures together. Legends say that, long ago, a lich lord created many<br>such weapons to ensure the loyalty of his undead servants. Sadly, this mace<br>might be the last one left. | <br>一种充满魔力的武器，能够瓦解、摧毁将亡灵生物的身体缚在一起的力量。<br>传说，很久以前，一个巫妖领主制造了许多这样的武器，以确保其亡灵仆从的忠诚。<br>遗憾的是，这把巨型钉头锤可能是仅存的一把。 | keep | 破坏束亡灵之力、昔巫妖领主以制仆忠诚、或仅存全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:254；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:220；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:greatsling "punk" | <br>A sling made of weird green leather, oozing corrosive slime. Originally the<br>weapon of a notorious mischief-maker and general scamp, it's since fallen into<br>less savoury hands. | <br>用奇怪的绿色皮革制成的投石索，渗出着腐蚀性的黏液。<br>它最初是臭名昭著的恶作剧制造者和小捣乱鬼的武器，后来落入令人不快的生物手中。 | keep | 腐绿皮索恶作剧者后落更坏手全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:142；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:122；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:hana's scimitar | <br>The favored sword of one of the battlemage Yara's most illustrious pupils, an<br>alleged demigoddess who often boasted that one spell and one slash were enough<br>to settle any battle. Indeed, all of her duels ended in just such a fashion,<br>including her last. | <br>战斗法师亚拉一位最杰出弟子的爱剑。传说这位弟子是半神女，<br>常夸口说只需一道法术、一记斩击，就足以解决任何战斗。<br>确实，她所有的决斗都是如此结束的，包括最后那场。 | keep | 亚拉出色半神女弟子夸一法一斩终决，末决也同句反讽全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:929；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:824；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:hand cannon "mule" | <br>Hand cannons use magical dust to launch projectiles. The alchemists who craft<br>them boast of their potency, but omit the smoke and noise blasted out with each<br>shot. Filled with powdered blastmotes, Mule packs an especially powerful kick. | <br>手铳使用魔尘来发射弹药。<br>制造它们的炼金术士吹嘘了它们的威力，但略过了每次发射都会喷出烟和噪音。<br>『骡子』装满了爆尘粉末，踢起来尤其有劲。 | keep | 魔尘手炮炼金者吹威略烟响，骡装爆尘粉更强后坐笑话全；手铳与名手炮建议同根。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:805；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:701；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:hat of pondering | <br>The favourite hat of the slug wizard Gastronok, stained with reddish slime and<br>enchanted to aid in his arcane pondering. It has been specially enchanted to<br>protect against the desiccating effects of salt. | <br>鼻涕虫巫师加斯特罗诺克最喜欢的帽子，上面沾着泛红的黏液，<br>并施有帮助他思索奥术的魔法。<br>它被特地施了魔法，以抵御盐的干燥作用。 | adjust | 加斯特罗诺克帽沾红黏液与施思考魔法是两关系；中文令黏液也助思考，应拆句，防盐干燥全。 确认问题：原文沾红黏液与附助思考魔法是两项；译文使红黏液也成为助其思考的因子。 已修复 I-PONDERING-SLIME：原文沾红黏液与附助思考魔法是两项；译文使红黏液也成为助其思考的因子。；处理：沾有红色黏液，并施有助他奥术思考的魔法。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:483；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:418；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:hat of the alchemist | <br>A dirty hat. It bears signs of surviving many weird explosions, which suggests<br>it may have means of protecting the head inside from the risks involved with<br>alchemy experiments. | <br>一顶肮脏的帽子。它似乎经过许多次奇怪的爆炸，但还是幸存下来，由此来看，<br>这顶帽子应该能在碰到炼金实验事故时保护下面的脑袋不受伤害。 | keep | 脏帽经奇爆幸存故或护炼金实验头全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:405；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:354；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:hat of the bear spirit | <br>A fur hat once owned by Ukta, a powerful ogre shaman. It houses the spirit of<br>an especially mighty bear, whose rages devastated the ogres until it was slain. | <br>这顶毛帽曾经是一位强大的食人魔萨满——乌克塔的所有物。<br>它里面寄宿着一头格外强大的熊之灵；在它被杀死前，其狂怒曾重创食人魔。 | keep | 乌克塔毛帽寄强熊灵，熊死前狂怒毁食人魔全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:319；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:279；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:hat of the high council | <br>A relic of some ancient wizarding war. Centuries later, it still crackles with<br>effects from the residual hexes and magical energies it was once subjected to<br>on a daily basis; spellcasters able to get a handle on its power, however, will<br>find it enhances the power of their spells. | <br>一件古代巫师战争的遗物。几个世纪后，它仍因昔日每天承受的残余诅咒与魔法能量<br>而噼啪作响；不过，能够驾驭其力量的施法者会发现它能增强法术威力。 | defer terminology | 古巫战残诅咒日常能量历世纪仍响，掌握可增法力全。 延期理由：全文两语与所有可用条件已读，当前文字命题对应；但身份已移除/兼容，不把旧描述当现行正常玩法承诺，不作推测性重命名。 责任：parent / item lifecycle or compatibility restoration owner；重入：恢复此身份或明确要求覆盖其真实兼容暴露路径时重绑实现再审；此前保留本冻结中文。；保留值见中文列。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:573；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:498；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:heavy crossbow "sniper" | <br>The sacred weapon of Toth-Mos, first apostle of the god Ashenzari. It grants<br>the wielder a fraction of Ashenzari's own vision, ensuring that every shot will<br>land true. | <br>这是艾申扎利第一位使徒托斯莫斯的神圣武器。<br>它可以让持用者获得艾申扎利的一部分视野，保证例无虚发。 | keep | 艾申扎利第一使徒托斯莫斯武器获部分视野保必中全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:219；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:189；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:hermit's pendant | <br>An ascetic once took a sacred vow, forswearing use of magical tools and ownership<br>of everything but this pendant. Which god they made this vow to remains a point of<br>bitter contention among the devout, but their pendant's power - and limitations -<br>are irrefutable. | <br>一位苦行者曾许下神圣誓言，不再使用魔法工具，也不再拥有这枚垂饰以外的任何东西。<br>是向哪一位神许下这个誓言仍然是虔诚者之间激烈争论的焦点，<br>但这枚垂饰的力量——以及它的局限——都无可辩驳。 | keep | 苦行者发誓不用魔装置且仅有坠，向何神之争与确证力量局限全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:772；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:672；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:hood of the assassin | <br>A soft hood, enchanted by members of the Assassin's Guild to allow the wearer<br>to sense potential victims nearby, and to easily spot vulnerabilities after<br>closing in on them. | <br>一种柔软的兜帽，被刺客公会成员施入魔法，可以让佩戴者感知附近潜在的猎物，<br>并在接近他们后，轻易发现其弱点。 | keep | 刺客会软兜帽感邻潜猎、靠近便察弱点全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:333；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:293；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:ice dragon arcanist's scales | <br>The thrumming scales of the great frost-breathing dragon Yntzoia, an ancient<br>arcanist fond of spectacle and destruction. Her tumultous relationship with the<br>elder dragon occultist Zmysua was quite infamous, and led to the both of them<br>seeking out endless mystic augmentations seeking more time for reconciliation-<br>even now, these scales still reverberate with hunger to return to what remains<br>of their opposite beyond death. | <br>喷霜巨龙因佐娅身上震颤的鳞片。她是一位古老的奥术师，喜好奇观与毁灭。<br>她与古龙神秘学者兹米苏娅动荡不定的关系声名狼藉；为了争取更多和解的时间，<br>双方不断寻求无穷无尽的神秘强化。即使到了今天，这些鳞片仍在回响，<br>渴望在死亡之外，回到对方留下的残骸身边。 | keep | 冰龙因佐娅喜奇观毁灭，与火龙恶恋互强化求和解时间、死后欲重返全，与火龙对照不同动机保留。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:894；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:752；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:justicar's regalia | <br>A gleaming breastplate with a slot in its centre for a holy symbol or bejewelled<br>coat of arms. Those who hear commands given by its wearer feel filled with the<br>power to carry them out, no matter the adversity. | <br>一件闪闪发光的胸甲，中央有一个槽位用于放置圣徽或珠宝纹章。<br>听到其佩戴者发出的命令的人会感到充满了执行命令的力量，无论面临多大困难。 | keep | 胸甲槽圣徽珠纹章，听令者获排难执行之力全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:825；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:759；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:knife of accuracy | <br>It is almost unerringly accurate. | <br>它几乎精准到了不象话的地步。 | defer terminology | 几乎不失手的精准之刃全，旧兼容。 延期理由：全文两语与所有可用条件已读，当前文字命题对应；但身份已移除/兼容，不把旧描述当现行正常玩法承诺，不作推测性重命名。 责任：parent / item lifecycle or compatibility restoration owner；重入：恢复此身份或明确要求覆盖其真实兼容暴露路径时重绑实现再审；此前保留本冻结中文。；保留值见中文列。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:267；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:231；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:kryia's mail coat | <br>A coat of armour said to have been forged for Queen Kryia in her old age. She<br>continued to insist on leading her armies from the front even into her dotage,<br>and as her aging body failed her, this coat helped to enhance the healing<br>draughts that kept her alive. | <br>一副据说是为晚年的克里娅女王锻造的盔甲。<br>即使年事已高，她仍坚持亲临前线；随着身体日渐衰弱，<br>这件链甲衫增强了维系她生命的治疗药剂。 | keep | 克里娅衰年仍领军前线，老躯靠甲增强治疗药续生全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:643；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:559；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:lajatang of order | <br>A silver-bladed lajatang, once bestowed upon a favoured worshipper of Zin. It<br>became the most prized weapon of the many priests of Zin. After their order was<br>destroyed, it fell into disuse and vanished from history. | <br>一柄带银刃的双头杖，曾被赐予辛的一位受宠信徒。<br>它成了辛的众多祭司的最宝贵的武器。<br>他们的教团覆灭后，它便遭到弃用，从历史中消失了。 | keep | 银双头杖受辛宠信者后祭司珍器、教团灭亡弃而失踪全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:590；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:512；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:lance "wyrmbane" | <br>An enchanted lance deadly to all dragonkind. It grows more powerful every time<br>it inflicts a killing blow on a strong dragon. The more powerful it grows, the<br>harder it will be to find a worthy opponent. | <br>“屠龙者”是一把对所有龙类致命的魔法骑枪。<br>每当它对一条强大的龙造成致命一击，威力就会增强。<br>它的威力越强，与它相称的强敌越少。 | keep | 屠龙骑枪龙类额外威、强龙致死成长且越来越难觅更强者全，art-func.h:596以plus&lt;dragonHD成长。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:236；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:204；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:lear's hauberk | <br>A well-made golden hauberk that covers all of its wearer's body parts. It<br>includes a chainmail coif, chausses and maille gauntlets. | <br>这套做工精良的黄金锁子甲能覆盖穿戴者的所有身体部位。<br>这套护甲中包含一顶锁子甲防护帽、一副腿甲，和一副链制手套。 | keep | 金锁甲全身含头腿手部全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:339；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:298；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:lehudib's crystal spear | <br>Presumably this relic led to the invention of the famous spell, or maybe the<br>other way around. | <br>也许是这件神器就是那道著名法术的原型，也可能正好相反。 | defer terminology | 水晶矛遗物与著名法术原型方向不明全；也许是就是重复可语言窄修。 延期理由：全文两语与所有可用条件已读，当前文字命题对应；但身份已移除/兼容，不把旧描述当现行正常玩法承诺，不作推测性重命名。 责任：parent / item lifecycle or compatibility restoration owner；重入：恢复此身份或明确要求覆盖其真实兼容暴露路径时重绑实现再审；此前保留本冻结中文。；保留值见中文列。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:272；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:236；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:lightning scales | <br>A set of armoured plates assembled to protect a creature with a long, scaly<br>lower body. Faintly crackling with electricity, they supercharge their wearer's<br>ability to cover distance. | <br>一套用来保护下半身长而有鳞的生物板甲。<br>它发出微弱的电荷爆裂声，让佩戴者风驰电掣。 | keep | 长鳞下身板甲微电令高速移全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:502；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:435；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:lochaber axe | <br>This brutal weapon, long thought lost to history, combines the extended reach<br>of a polearm with the cleaving sharpness of an axe. Ghosts of ancient warriors<br>linger about it, draining fickle users. | <br>这把野蛮的武器，长期被遗忘在历史的长河中，<br>它兼具长柄武器的攻击范围和斧头的锋利。<br>古代战士的鬼魂徘徊在它周围，汲取三心二意者的生命力。 | keep | 长柄触及与斧劈、古战士灵衰竭三心二意换用者全；锋利可建议劈砍以显示机制但不漏专属字段。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:766；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:666；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:longbow "piercer" | <br>An exceptionally large metal longbow. | <br>一张特别大的金属长弓。 | defer terminology | 特大金属长弓全，兼容。 延期理由：全文两语与所有可用条件已读，当前文字命题对应；但身份已移除/兼容，不把旧描述当现行正常玩法承诺，不作推测性重命名。 责任：parent / item lifecycle or compatibility restoration owner；重入：恢复此身份或明确要求覆盖其真实兼容暴露路径时重绑实现再审；此前保留本冻结中文。；保留值见中文列。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:226；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:195；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:longbow "zephyr" | <br>A golden bow, strung with a lock of hair from the West Wind themselves. Tales<br>say it was crafted as a gift to an unrequited love and even centuries after their<br>untimely death, one can still feel longing carried on the gentle breeze that<br>surrounds its wielder. | <br>一张金色的弓，以西风本人的一绺头发为弦。<br>传说，它是送给一位单恋对象的礼物。<br>即使那场过早的死亡已过去数百年，人们仍能在环绕持用者的轻柔微风中感到思念。 | keep | 西风发金弓单恋礼物、早死数世纪仍绕柔风恋慕全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:148；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:127；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:macabre finger necklace | <br>An ugly dangling finger on a string. Everything about it reeks of malign<br>influences... but it's hard to avoid thinking that it would look better with a<br>ring on it. | <br>一根丑陋的手指挂在绳子上。<br>它的一切都散发着邪恶影响……但人们不禁会想，若给这根手指戴枚戒指，应该会更好看。 | keep | 丑恶手指串邪气而想加戒指全，名称指骨可风格保留非伪机制。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:555；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:482；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:mace of variability | <br>A large mace said to have appeared when Xom grew bored with the predictability<br>of more ordinary instruments of chaos. | <br>据说，当佐姆厌倦了普通混沌工具那可预料的表现时，这把巨型钉头锤便出现了。 | keep | 佐姆嫌可预测混沌工具而造无常巨锤全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:22；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:21；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:mad mage's maulers | <br>A pair of gloves designed to carefully control and channel the flow of magic,<br>later misused and mangled by the lunatic murderer-mages of the Fifth Circle.<br>Their influence leaves the wearer utterly unable to cast spells - the wearer's<br>magic is redirected to far bloodier purposes. | <br>一副用来小心控制和引导魔法流动的手套，<br>后来却被第五环的疯狂杀人法师滥用并毁坏了。<br>它会让穿戴者完全无法施法——穿戴者的魔力被转而用于做更血腥的事情。 | keep | 控导魔流手套被五环狂杀法师滥毁、完全禁施魔转血用全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:702；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:607；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:majin-bo | <br>A staff inhabited by a mighty demon, tricked and trapped in this form long ago.<br>To survive, she now offers great arcane power in a terrible bargain: in<br>exchange for a tiny portion of the caster's life essence, taken every time its<br>wielder casts a spell, she will redirect the life essence of creatures damaged<br>by the spell to the caster. | <br>一个居住着强大的恶魔的法杖，很久之前她就被以这种形式欺骗和困住。<br>为了活命，她如今以一笔可怕的交易提供强大的奥术力量：<br>施法者每次施法时她会从中获取一小部分生命精华，<br>而她会将被法术伤害的生物的生命精华导向施法者。 | keep | 强女恶魔骗困杖，逐次施法取少己生换受伤者生命回己全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:608；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:528；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:mask of the dragon | <br>The mask of the High Priest of ancient Erebora. In ancient times, the gods of<br>the Ereborans ceased to answer their prayers, and in desperation, the people<br>turned to the forbidden worship of dragons. Now, of their works, only this mask<br>remains. | <br>古代埃雷博拉高级祭司的面具。昔日，埃雷博拉人的神灵不再回应他们的祈祷，<br>在绝望中，人们转而信奉遭禁的龙族。如今，他们的造物只剩下这副面具。 | keep | 古埃雷博拉神不应祈迫民禁拜龙仅遗面具全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:385；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:338；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:maxwell's etheric cage | <br>A fine mesh cage designed to capture magical energy. Experimental notes suggest<br>that research was abandoned when the cage began to capture magical<br>contamination almost as effectively. Anyone reckless enough to place it on<br>their head would find their magic regeneration dramatically increased, at the<br>cost of multiplying any magical contamination received. | <br>一个精致的网状笼子，旨在捕捉魔法能量。<br>实验记录表明，当笼子捕获诱变辐射的效果也变得几乎同样出色时，研究便中止了。<br>任何鲁莽地将其放在头上的人会发现魔力恢复能力大大增强，<br>而代价是所受到的诱变辐射成倍增加。 | adjust | 以太笼捕魔也捕诱变辐射研究弃、增MP恢复与倍受辐射全；魔法污染术语应更正。 确认问题：相同玩家机制 magical contamination 被写成魔法污染；不是环境污染。消散项链正文还将消退写成随时间流逝速度翻倍。 已修复 I-CONTAM：相同玩家机制 magical contamination 被写成魔法污染；不是环境污染。消散项链正文还将消退写成随时间流逝速度翻倍。；处理：采用诱变辐射，明确辐射与负面效果消退速度翻倍。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:622；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:541；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408；docs/glossary.md:820；crawl-ref/source/potion.cc:386；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:1889 |
| body:unrand:maxwell's patent armour | <br>A suit of armour created by the famous inventor Maxwell, providing unparalleled<br>protective qualities at a very affordable price. His unorthodox materials left<br>it with certain shortcomings, but he's yet to have anyone come back for a<br>refund. | <br>由著名发明家麦克斯韦制造的一套铠甲，以非常实惠的价格提供无与伦比的防护性能。<br>他用的非正统材料给它带来了一定的缺陷，但还没有人回来退款。 | keep | 麦克斯韦廉价强护甲材料怪有缺无人活来退款暗笑全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:378；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:333；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:maxwell's thermic engine | <br>A strange sword, one blade blistering hot and the other icy cold. When it hits<br>its target the thermal gradient increases. What causes this effect is unknown<br>but it is rumoured that otherworldly forces are involved. | <br>一把奇怪的剑，一个刃炽热，而另一个冰冷。当它击中目标时，热梯度会增大。<br>造成此效果的原因尚不清楚，但有传言说它与超自然的力量有关。 | keep | 双刃冷热命中梯度增、传超界力全，sourceRev另卡误译反转。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:674；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:583；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:mithril axe "arga" | <br>A beautiful mithril axe, probably lost by some dwarven hero. | <br>一把精致的秘银斧，这大概是某个矮人英雄遗落的武器吧。 | keep | 秘银斧或矮人英雄遗物全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:209；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:180；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:moon troll leather armour | <br>A suit of armour rumoured to have been created by enchanting the hide of a<br>now-extinct species of troll. Whether the name rings true or is merely<br>appropriated to add mystique is something of a mystery. The armour's innate<br>powers of regeneration and magical protection, however, are hard to dispute. | <br>传说，这件甲胄是用一种已经灭绝了的巨魔的毛皮强化而成。<br>这名称究竟名副其实，还是仅为增添神秘感而借用，仍是一个谜。<br>这件甲胄可以提升穿着者的再生能力并提供魔法防护，倒是实实在在的。 | adjust | 月巨魔皮来历真假未定、再生与魔法防护；后者被擅定魔法抗性而实际SPARM_SPIRIT_SHIELD+MP5，无意志抗，须魔法防护/精神护盾。 确认问题：magical protection擅定为魔法抗性，当前精神护盾+5MP而没有意志抗性。 已修复 I-MOON-TROLL-SPIRIT：magical protection擅定为魔法抗性，当前精神护盾+5MP而没有意志抗性。；处理：再生与魔法防护；可指明精神护盾而不捏造魔抗。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:548；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:476；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt:1306 |
| body:unrand:morningstar "eos" | <br>A jewelled morningstar, glowing brightly with the light of the dawn. It<br>illuminates the dungeon's recesses, revealing the machinations of those who<br>would prefer to stay invisible. | <br>一把镶有宝石的晨星锤，闪耀着黎明般的光芒。<br>它照亮了地牢的幽深处，令那些想要隐身的怪物的图谋无所遁形。 | adjust | 晨星自身发曙光而非处在曙光下，照地牢揭隐图谋全。 确认问题：自身发出黎明之光，中文在曙光下发光改变光源与条件。 已修复 I-EOS-LIGHT：自身发出黎明之光，中文在曙光下发光改变光源与条件。；处理：闪耀着黎明般的光芒。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:192；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:165；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:mountain boots | <br>These sturdy boots were created by an artificer who lived high up on a remote<br>mountain peak, as protection against the mountain's near-constant avalanches,<br>rockslides, and snowstorms. No force short of translocations magic will budge<br>the wearer from their position. | <br>这双结实的靴子是由一位住在偏远山峰上的工匠设计的，<br>用来抵御山上几乎不间断的雪崩、山崩和暴风雪。<br>除位移术外，没有任何力量能令穿戴者挪动分毫。 | keep | 山工匠防雪崩落岩雪暴靴、除传送系魔法不移全；位移术应与真实学派名称区分可用传送系。 本卡替代表达仅Suggestion，现译保留。 Suggestion S-TRANSLLOCATION 保留，未作强制修改：位移术可覆盖闪烁传送放逐，机制所指清楚，不因词面不同阻挡。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:759；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:660；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:necklace of bloodlust | <br>A necklace made of bloodstained human and animal teeth, and something that<br>appears to be a piece of spine. | <br>一条串着沾血人牙和兽牙的项链，其中似乎还混着一截脊椎骨。 | keep | 染血人兽牙与疑脊骨链全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:452；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:392；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:obsidian axe | <br>An axe with a powerful curse placed on it by one of the lords of Pandemonium,<br>so that unsuspecting adventurers would unleash demons into this world. Beware,<br>for it has ways of mesmerising its wielder, no matter how clear and focused<br>their mind... | <br>某位万魔殿领主在这把斧头上施加了强大的诅咒，<br>为的是让毫无戒心的冒险者将恶魔释放到这个世界。<br>务必当心，无论持用者的心智多么清醒专注，它都有办法将其迷惑…… | keep | 万魔殿领主诅咒斧放恶魔、不论清明都迷魂持用者全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:489；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:424；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:orange crystal plate armour | <br>A suit of armour carved from transparent orange crystal. It provides remarkable<br>protection for both mind and body. The wearer can even channel psychic energies<br>through the crystal itself, enhancing their magical abilities. However, it's<br>rather heavy... | <br>一套用透明的橙色水晶雕刻而成的护甲。可以为肉体和心灵提供卓越的保护能力。<br>穿戴者甚至可以通过水晶引导精神力量来增强魔法能力。但是相当重…… | keep | 透明橙水晶重甲护身心且可导精神强魔法全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:601；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:523；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:orb of dispater | <br>An orb pulsing with unholy energies, granting the power to unleash damnation<br>when held — although not without draining the wielder's vitality in the<br>process. It carries with it some of the corrosive malice of the Iron City of<br>Dis. | <br>这个涌动着邪恶能量的球体能赋予持有者释放天谴的能力，<br>但使用时也会汲取其生命力。它还带有几分迪斯铁城那腐蚀性的恶意。 | keep | 迪斯帕特球耗生命释放天谴，迪斯铁城腐蚀恶意全，Hell根沿当前已复核不改冻结。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:71；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:58；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:pair of quick blades "gyre" and "gimble" | <br>Two quick blades joined by a chain. Swinging one compels the wielder to swing<br>the other, as if they have minds of their own. | <br>两个由链条连接的快刃。<br>挥动一个会迫使持有者挥动另一个，仿佛它们有自己的想法一样。 | keep | 链双快刃挥一迫另一如有心全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:616；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:535；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:partisan of prune | <br>The partisan of Prune carries a terrible and insidious curse. Unless its wielder<br>maintains firm self-control, they are doomed to undergo a horrifying (albeit<br>temporary) transformation. This is normally trivial to resist, but incapacitated<br>wielders are certain to succumb, finding themselves nightmarishly purple, squishy,<br>and delicious. They can take comfort in learning that it's surprisingly hard to<br>injure a giant prune. | <br>梅干阔头枪带着可怕而阴险的诅咒。持用者若不能保持坚定的自制力，<br>便注定会经历一次骇人的变化，尽管变化只是暂时的。平时抵抗它轻而易举，<br>但失去行动能力的持用者必定会屈服，变成一颗噩梦般紫得发亮、软绵可口的梅干。<br>不过，知道巨型梅干出乎意料地难以伤害，或许能让他们稍感安慰。 | keep | 梅干诅咒平常易抗失能必屈、暂变紫软可口却耐伤全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:27；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:781；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:plutonium sword | <br>A triple sword made of weird glowing metal. It irradiates those it strikes,<br>causing a range of unpredictable effects — if they survive the impact of the<br>blade itself, that is. | <br>一把由奇异发光金属制成的三刃剑。它会辐射被其击中的目标，<br>造成一系列无法预料的效果——前提是目标能从剑刃本身的冲击下活下来。 | keep | 发光金属三刃剑辐射不定变形与活过剑伤前提全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:248；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:215；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:ratskin cloak | <br>A cloak stitched from the hides of hundreds of hell rats by an enchantress with<br>far too much time on her hands. Many more rats remain somehow concealed within<br>it, and may scurry out to assist the wearer. | <br>有个女巫闲得无聊，用数百只地狱鼠的皮缝制出这件披风。<br>还有更多的老鼠不知怎的藏在里面，它们可能会窜出来帮助穿戴者。 | keep | 百地狱鼠皮女巫太闲、更多鼠藏可助主全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:420；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:368；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:ring of shadows | <br>A black ring that can make its wearer one with the shadows. | <br>一枚黑色的戒指，它能使佩戴者融入阴影。 | keep | 黑戒融阴影全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:437；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:383；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:ring of the hare | <br>An unadorned malachite ring, half of an ancient pair. Its wearer is<br>exceptionally difficult to catch. | <br>一枚朴实无华的孔雀石戒指，是一对古老戒指中的一只。佩戴了它，很难被追上。 | keep | 野兔素孔雀石戒古一对之一难追全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:457；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:396；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:ring of the mage | <br>An enchanted sapphire, inset into a ring. | body:unrand:robe of augmentation | <br>A variegated robe, woven with enchantments to enhance the wearer's physical and<br>mental abilities. | body:unrand:robe of clouds | <br>A robe of a material as nebulous and insubstantial as the clouds. | body:unrand:robe of folly | <br>A dull grey robe. | body:unrand:robe of misfortune | <br>A splendid flowing robe of fur and silk whose lucky colour has faded. | <br>一件精美、顺滑的长袍，用毛皮和丝绸织成，其幸运的色彩已经褪去。 | keep | 毛丝华袍幸运色褪全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:324；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:284；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:robe of night | <br>A long black robe made of strange glossy material. It shrouds its wearer in<br>darkness, reducing the range of vision. | body:unrand:robe of vines | <br>A robe woven of living vines.
