| body:unrand:salamander hide armour | <br>Most salamanders' bodies are consigned to the fiery depths from which they<br>sprang. Rarely, though, salamanders instead preserve the skins of those that<br>passed. The runes and decorations on this hide suggest it once belonged to a<br>respected warrior or priest - perhaps even a king. The fiery spirit remains in<br>the skin, granting its power to the wearer. | <br>大多数火蜥蜴的尸体都被送到他们生长的火海深处。<br>然而，偶尔也会有火蜥蜴保存死者的皮肤。这张皮上的符文和装饰表明，<br>它曾经属于一位受人尊敬的战士或祭司，甚至可能是一位国王。<br>炽热的灵魂留在皮肤中，赋予穿戴者力量。 | keep | 火蜥蜴通常火葬少留尊者皮、战祭或王、火灵留给穿者全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:353；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:311；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:scales of the dragon king | <br>A suit of armour created from the enchanted scales of a once-mighty king of<br>dragons. In his time, titans and lesser dragons struggled with him in vain —<br>but as with all things, even he was eventually cast down and undone. Of his<br>life and deeds, this is all that remains. | <br>一套盔甲，由曾经强大的龙王的带有魔法的鳞片制成。<br>在他的时代，泰坦和较小的龙与他搏斗是徒劳的——但就像所有的事情一样，<br>即使是他最终也被打倒和毁灭。这是所有留存下来的，关于他的一生和事迹。 | keep | 龙王曾抗泰坦小龙终如万物败灭、只留鳞甲全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:398；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:348；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:scarf of invisibility | <br>A scarf that can be activated to render its wearer invisible. | <br>一条可激活以使佩戴者隐形的围巾。 | keep | 可激活隐形围巾全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:670；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:764；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:sceptre of asmodeus | <br>A bright ruby sceptre, carrying some of the powers of the arch-fiend Asmodeus.<br>It may call forth fiery demons from their infernal home to do the wielder's<br>bidding. | <br>一把明亮的红宝石节杖，带有魔王阿斯摩蒂斯的某些力量。<br>持有者能凭借它召唤、号令来自地狱巢穴的火系恶魔。 | keep | 红宝石阿斯摩蒂斯权杖可能召役地狱火恶魔全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:78；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:63；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:sceptre of torment | <br>An accursed bone sceptre, created by some unknown hellish power. When used in<br>combat, it causes agonising pain in all those unfortunate enough to gaze upon<br>it, save for the wielder. | <br>一把被诅咒的骨制节杖，由某种未知的地狱力量创造。<br>在战斗中使用时，它会给所有注视它的不幸者带来极度痛楚，除了持用者。 | keep | 骨节杖战斗给所有见者剧痛除持用者全；源专属称foes另核could_harm，不改为无差别全免。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:60；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:49；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:scimitar of flaming death | <br>A scimitar with a mysteriously smoking blade. Occasionally its heat leaks out,<br>covering opponents in magical flame. | <br>一把刀刃上冒着神秘烟气的弯刀。<br>有时它的热量会泄漏出来，将敌人裹在魔法火焰之中。 | defer terminology | 冒烟弯刀偶泄热裹敌魔火全，兼容。 延期理由：全文两语与所有可用条件已读，当前文字命题对应；但身份已移除/兼容，不把旧描述当现行正常玩法承诺，不作推测性重命名。 责任：parent / item lifecycle or compatibility restoration owner；重入：恢复此身份或明确要求覆盖其真实兼容暴露路径时重绑实现再审；此前保留本冻结中文。；保留值见中文列。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:97；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:80；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:screaming sword | <br>&lt;Singing Sword&gt; | <br>&lt;Singing Sword&gt; | keep | Screaming Sword别名精确引用Singing Sword，目标全文124已读，英文查询不翻译。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:11；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:11；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:scythe "finisher" | <br>A long and exceedingly sharp scythe, capable of eviscerating in a single blow.<br>Its extraordinary speed is the work of a mad wizard, who spent years refining<br>it before discarding it in a fit of rage.<br><br>The blade looses a low keen as it cuts through the air. | <br>一把锋利的长镰刀，一击就能将内脏掏出。<br>它那非凡的速度是出自一个疯狂的巫师的杰作，<br>他花了数年时间改进它，却一怒之下将其丢弃。<br><br>刀刃划过空气，留下咻咻的声音。 | keep | 快锐长镰一击掏脏、疯巫数年精炼怒弃与低哀鸣全；咻咻声音可建议低哀鸣。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:134；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:114；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:scythe of curses | <br>A scythe surrounded by an ominous aura of dread. It carries a terrible and<br>ancient curse, which it busily inflicts on both the wielder and their enemies. | <br>一把被环绕在不祥的恐惧光环下的镰刀。<br>它带有一种可怕而古老的诅咒，还不断将诅咒施加给持有者和敌人。 | keep | 恐惧古诅咒镰同时施己敌全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:55；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:44；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:seven-league boots | <br>An enchanted pair of boots which grant the ability to take strides of incredible<br>length, as long as the wearer is advancing bravely towards their foes. | <br>一双注入了魔法的靴子，只要穿着它勇敢地朝敌人前进，就可以迈出难以置信的步伐。 | keep | 勇往敌人才能超长步全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:697；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:603；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:shield of resistance | <br>A bronze shield, looking almost exactly like a tortoise's shell. It was built<br>by the adherents of an obscure minor faith, who imbued it with the power of<br>their god. As the god is said to, this shield protects against sword and sling,<br>frost and flame. | <br>一个青铜盾牌，看起来几乎和龟壳一模一样。<br>一个鲜为人知的小宗教的信徒们打造了它，将自己的神的力量注入其中。<br>据说他们的神祇也会如此，这面盾牌既能抵御刀剑和投石索，也能抵御严霜和烈焰。 | keep | 龟壳青铜盾小教神力，防剑索霜焰四全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:366；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:323；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:shield of the gong | <br>A heavy bronze gong that can be worn as a shield. Locked away in a temple for<br>many years, its bearer is shielded by decades of accumulated prayer. | <br>一个沉重的铜锣，可当盾牌用。<br>它被锁在寺庙里多年，它的持用者将承载着几十年积累的祈祷的庇佑。 | keep | 重铜锣寺庙锁多年、积累祈祷护持者全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:426；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:373；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:shillelagh "devastator" | <br>A wooden cudgel, loaded with more than just lead. | <br>这根木棍，灌的可不仅仅是铅。 | keep | 木棍灌不止铅的隐喻全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:528；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:457；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:singing sword | <br>An enchanted blade which loves nothing more than to sing to its owner, whether<br>they want it to or not. | <br>这件被施了魔法的有刃武器最喜欢对它的主人唱歌，<br>至于主人想不想听它唱，它可管不着。 | keep | 唱剑爱唱不论主人愿否全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:2；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:2；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:skin of zhor | <br>The {{<br>    if you.can_smell() then<br>        return "smelly "<br>    end<br>}}skin of some strange animal, native to cold and distant lands. It radiates<br>the chill of its native habitat. | <br>一件{{<br>    if you.can_smell() then<br>        return "难闻的"<br>    end<br>}}毛皮，源于某种在寒冷而遥远的地方生长的奇怪动物。它散发着原栖息地的寒意。 | keep | can_smell Lua难闻/无味词两支，遥寒异兽皮散故乡冷全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:344；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:303；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:skull of zonguldrok | <br>The skull of a legendary necromancer, seemingly parted from the rest of its<br>body. When held, it seems disinclined to explain the precise circumstances of<br>its ending up in this state, but offers no objection to others siphoning what<br>considerable necromantic power still remains in its ancient bones. | <br>一位传奇死灵法师的头骨，似乎与其身体的其余部分分离了。当被握持时，<br>它似乎不愿解释自己落得如此境地的确切情况，但对他人汲取其古老骨骼中<br>仍然存留的相当可观的死灵术力量并不反对。 | keep | 传奇死灵师断头骨拒解释处境却允汲余死灵力量全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:831；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:768；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:slick slippers | <br>Crafted from the tanned, smooth hide of a Western Skyshark, these slippers are<br>astonishingly comfortable. They lack the protective benefits of a good pair of<br>boots, but they can get their wearers out of almost any bind. | <br>这双拖鞋是用西方天鲨的光滑的皮鞣制而成的，舒适得令人称奇。<br>它没有好靴子那样的保护作用，但它能让穿着者摆脱几乎所有束缚。 | keep | 西天鲨鞣光皮拖鞋舒服、防护不及靴却脱几乎所有束缚全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:779；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:678；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:spear of the botono | <br>A dark and malign artefact. It increases the potency of hexes cast by anyone<br>unwise enough to risk wielding it. | <br>一把黑暗、邪恶的神器。任何不智到甘愿冒险持握它的人，<br>施放的诅咒系法术都会变得更强。 | defer terminology | 邪波托诺矛给冒险持者增Hex威力全，兼容。 延期理由：全文两语与所有可用条件已读，当前文字命题对应；但身份已移除/兼容，不把旧描述当现行正常玩法承诺，不作推测性重命名。 责任：parent / item lifecycle or compatibility restoration owner；重入：恢复此身份或明确要求覆盖其真实兼容暴露路径时重绑实现再审；此前保留本冻结中文。；保留值见中文列。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:199；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:171；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:sphere of battle | <br>An orb encased in vividly coloured scales, wrought by a long-forgotten wizard.<br>It was the mage Iskenderun's favourite playtoy. | <br>一个外面裹着艳丽鳞片的水晶球，由一个被遗忘已久的巫师制作。<br>这是法师伊斯肯德伦最喜欢的玩具。 | keep | 遗忘巫师造鳞包球为伊斯肯德伦爱玩具全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:686；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:593；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:spriggan's knife | <br>A dainty little knife which was made by Spriggans, or for Spriggans, or<br>possibly from Spriggans. Anyway, it's in some way associated with those fey<br>folk. | <br>一把精致的小刀，可能由小精灵制作，可能为小精灵制作，<br>也可能是用小精灵制作的。总之，它多少与那些妖精般的小家伙有关。 | keep | 小精灵造/为小精灵/由小精灵制三解与相关妖精幽默全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:242；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:210；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:staff of five virtues | <br>The staff of a venerable master monk who drove away her foes as easily as her<br>attachments and (so the legend says) eventually transcended life and death<br>altogether. A worthy wielder may unlock the staff's great potential, provided<br>they follow its former owner's peculiar ideas of balance and comportment. | <br>一位德高望重的僧侣大师的杖。她驱退敌人，就像摆脱自身执念一样轻松，<br>传说最终更彻底超脱了生死。只要遵循前任主人的独特平衡之道与举止准则，<br>配得上此杖的持用者便能释放其巨大潜能。 | keep | 老女僧退敌如断执、传脱生死，遵她平衡举止准则启杖潜力全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:915；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:811；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:staff of olgreb | <br>A staff which was once wielded by the great alchemist Olgreb. | <br>强大的炼金术士奥尔格雷布曾用过的一把法杖。 | adjust | 炼金者Olgreb正文奥格雷布与名称/法术奥尔格雷布同人不同根，须统一。 确认问题：同一炼金术士正文奥格雷布与当前器名/法术名奥尔格雷布词根不一致。 已修复 I-OLGREB-NAME：同一炼金术士正文奥格雷布与当前器名/法术名奥尔格雷布词根不一致。；处理：采用奥尔格雷布，与当前名字独立交叉核对一致。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:36；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:25；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408；docs/glossary.md:1701；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt:staff of Olgreb |
| body:unrand:staff of the meek | <br>A sacred relic of the Monks of St. Lee, followers of the renunciate archmage. Just<br>as St. Lee sought to atone for the destruction his spells wrought by protecting<br>others, so his staff protects its wielder. | <br>这是遁世大法师圣李的追随者——圣李修士会——所供奉的圣物。<br>正如圣李通过保护他人来弥补他的法术所造成的破坏一样，<br>他的法杖也保护着持用者。 | keep | 圣李退隐大法师会圣杖，护他者赎法术毁坏而护持者全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:739；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:641；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:stagehand's sword | <br>An unassuming sword resembling a prop weapon for theatrical use. But behold!<br>A twist here, a press there, and the real blade springs forth; glittering,<br>wicked, murderous. Has it killed before? If so, it left no witnesses. Shall it<br>kill for you? If you're sly enough, it will do just as you like. | <br>一把不起眼的剑，看上去像是戏剧用的道具武器。但看好了！<br>这边一拧，那边一按，真正的剑刃便弹了出来：寒光闪烁，凶险，致命。<br>它杀过人吗？若杀过，也没留下见证者。它会为你杀人吗？<br>只要你足够狡猾，它便会如你所愿。 | keep | 道具剑扭按弹真刃、无证人杀史与狡猾遂愿全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:922；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:817；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:storm bow | <br>A longbow with the colour of dark rain clouds that fires arrows like lightning. | <br>一张阴暗的雨云色的长弓，能射出闪电般的箭。 | keep | 暗雨云色长弓箭如雷全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:283；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:246；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:storm queen's shield | <br>A disc of crackling metal, created by a woman whose cunning artifice and<br>crafty politics once united a continent. Most of her surviving inventions are<br>closely guarded by various royals, ostensible proof of their claim to be her<br>true successor, but this early prototype slipped through their fingers. | <br>这块噼啪作响的金属圆盘，由一位女人所造。<br>她曾凭借精巧的造物技艺和巧妙的政治手腕统一了一块大陆。<br>她留存至今的大多数发明都被各个王室成员严密保管，<br>表面上充当着他们自称其真正继承者的证据，<br>但这个早期原型却从他们手中溜走了。 | adjust | 制造女王cunning artifice是精巧技艺而非狡猾诡计；遗物被皇室当继承正统证据的ostensible proof漏失，应补，政治统一大陆与原型漏手全。 确认问题：cunning artifice是精巧造物技艺，被误作狡猾诡计；皇室以遗存发明当正统继承证据的关系也遗漏。 已修复 I-STORM-QUEEN-ARTIFICE：cunning artifice是精巧造物技艺，被误作狡猾诡计；皇室以遗存发明当正统继承证据的关系也遗漏。；处理：精巧技艺与政治手腕统一大陆；遗存发明被皇室当作自称真正继承者的表面证据。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:798；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:693；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:sulking sword | <br>&lt;Singing Sword&gt; | <br>&lt;Singing Sword&gt; | keep | Sulking Sword同Singing Sword别名引用，目标124全文审。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:7；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:7；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:swamp witch's dragon scales | <br>A flamboyant suit of ancient armour that has led to many minor schisms between<br>historians, as it is uncertain whether it was made from some renowned witch's<br>pet dragon, or her frequent prey, or from her own non-human body itself.<br>Regardless of its origins, the magic woven into it freely rains toxins all<br>over its bearer's especially misfortunate foes. | <br>一套华丽的古代护甲，曾引发历史学家之间许多小规模的分歧。<br>没人能确定，它究竟是用某位著名女巫的宠物龙、她常猎捕的龙，<br>还是她自己的非人躯体制成。无论来源如何，织入其中的魔法<br>都会向持有者那些格外不幸的敌人肆意倾泻毒素。 | keep | 女巫宠龙/猎物/非人己身三源争历史、向特别倒霉敌倾毒全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:868；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:774；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:sword of cerebov | <br>A twisted blade, covered in eerie flames. Its demonic power burns away at the<br>very essence of those it is wielded against. | <br>一把扭曲的剑，周身被包裹在诡异的火焰中。它的恶魔力量会焚蚀敌人的本质。 | keep | 塞雷波夫扭火剑焚敌本质全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:66；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:54；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:sword of the dread knight | <br>An adamantine great sword. Its first wielder was a worshipper of Yredelemnul<br>who eschewed the use of magic in combat, preferring to destroy her enemies with<br>brute force. Unfortunately for her, not all of her opponents shared her<br>limitations.<br><br>It has felled countless great warriors under her grip, and the souls of those<br>who had their lives taken beckon it to take even more under its new owner. | <br>一把刚劲的巨剑。第一个持有它的人是伊莱德莱姆努尔的信徒，<br>她不屑于使用魔法，喜欢用蛮力毁灭敌人。<br>对她而言不幸的是，并非所有敌人像她那样局限。<br><br>在她的紧握下，这把剑击倒了无数强大的战士，<br>而那些被夺去生命的灵魂正召唤着它在新的主人手中夺取更多的生命。 | keep | adamantine可作坚硬无比的形容，不单凭该词强定精金材质；刚劲较生硬属Suggestion。原主女信徒厌魔重蛮输于不限者、夺命灵求续杀全。 本卡替代表达仅Suggestion，现译保留。 Suggestion S-DREAD-ADAMANTINE 保留，未作强制修改：adamantine可作坚硬无比的形容，不能单凭该词强定游戏材质为精金；刚劲用于剑较生硬但保留坚硬强劲意象。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:182；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:156；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:throatcutter | <br>Taken from a paladin of the Shining One by the common cutpurse who murdered her,<br>Throatcutter was used for a long series of increasingly sordid deeds thereafter.<br>Blood, murder and betrayal stain its history and blade both, and little trace now<br>remains of the blade which once stood between danger and the innocent. | <br>一个普通的扒手谋杀了一位光辉者的圣骑士，<br>并从其手上夺走了割喉者，此后用它干了一系列越来越肮脏的事迹。<br>鲜血、谋杀和背叛玷污了它的历史和刀锋，<br>如今已几乎看不出，这把刀曾挺身挡在危险与无辜者之间。 | keep | 圣骑士被扒手谋杀夺剑，越作恶背叛染史、守无辜原貌几无全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:732；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:634；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:toga "victory" | <br>An ancient artefact of Okawaru, these woolen robes were lost when a former<br>champion failed a duel. Its enchantments increase in power when the wearer<br>emerges victorious from threatening combat, but resorting to the use of scrolls<br>or potions for assistance causes them to fade away again. | <br>这件羊毛长袍是奥卡瓦鲁的一件古代神器，前冠军在决斗失败后遗落了它。<br>当穿戴者在有威胁的战斗中获胜时，其附着的魔力会增强，<br>但若在有敌对怪物可见时求助于卷轴或药水，这些加成便会再次消失。 | adjust | 敌战有威胁获胜才增强，不是必须险胜；且喝药读卷清零仅有敌可见，专属准确但正文缺该关键限定。 确认问题：threatening combat被写成险胜（不是必须胜得艰难）；正文还省略有敌对怪在视野内用药/卷才清零的限制。 已修复 I-VICTORY-CONDITIONS：threatening combat被写成险胜（不是必须胜得艰难）；正文还省略有敌对怪在视野内用药/卷才清零的限制。；处理：在有威胁的战斗中获胜会增强；有敌可见时求助药水/卷轴才使加成消退。。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:791；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:688；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:1679；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt:Victory；crawl-ref/source/item-use.cc:VICTORY_CONDUCT_KEY |
| body:unrand:tower shield "bullseye" | <br>Just in case you had trouble getting hit. | <br>专为怕你挨不着打而备。 | defer terminology | 靶心反讽专让容易挨打全，兼容。 延期理由：全文两语与所有可用条件已读，当前文字命题对应；但身份已移除/兼容，不把旧描述当现行正常玩法承诺，不作推测性重命名。 责任：parent / item lifecycle or compatibility restoration owner；重入：恢复此身份或明确要求覆盖其真实兼容暴露路径时重绑实现再审；此前保留本冻结中文。；保留值见中文列。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:308；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:269；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:tower shield of ignorance | <br>A shield unearthed from the remains of a ruined city. It bears an inscription<br>written in an ancient language. Scholars and wise men laboured for countless<br>hours to decipher it, and in time, a translation was finally settled on:<br><br>"With a shield like this, who needs to think?" | <br>从城市废墟中出土的盾牌。上面有用古文书写的铭文。<br>学者和智者们花费了无数的时间来破译它，最终，译文敲定了：<br><br>“有了这样的盾牌，谁需要思考？” | keep | 废城古铭学者耗久最终有此盾何需思考笑话全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:287；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:250；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:trident of the octopus king | <br>A trident stolen many years ago from the Octopus King's garden. Luckily, he<br>seems to be in no hurry to get it back. | <br>一把多年前从章鱼王的花园中偷来的三叉戟。幸运的是，他似乎不急于寻回。 | keep | 章鱼王花园多年前失戟但不急索全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:204；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:176；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:trishula "condemnation" | <br>A weapon to bring forth guilt from the guilty. It was first wielded by the archangel<br>Lucriel, who, on seeing the suffering of the first mortals, led them as an army<br>against the cruelty of the gods. The ragged survivors of Lucriel's army took this<br>weapon with them into the wilderness, the sole remnant of an archangel's virtue. | <br>一把让罪人产生罪恶感的武器。它最先是由天使长卢克利尔使用，<br>他看到了第一批凡人的苦难，就率领他们对抗残酷的诸神。<br>卢克利尔大军中衣衫褴褛的幸存者带着这件武器进入荒野，<br>它也成了天使长美德唯一留存的见证。 | keep | 天使长卢克利尔率首凡抵残神、幸存者流荒持唯一美德遗武全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:745；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:647；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:vampire's tooth | <br>An ivory-like quick blade that looks like it could have been crafted from the<br>tooth of some enormous predatory creature. It is lethally vampiric. | <br>一把形同象牙的快刃，看上去像是雕琢自某种巨型肉食动物的牙。它有着致命的吸血之力。 | keep | 象牙样快刃似巨猎兽牙与致命吸血全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:50；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:40；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:warlock's mirror | <br>A handheld array of hexagonal mirrors, synthesised from a truly exotic<br>substance and polished to a blinding sheen. | <br>一个手持的六边形镜子阵列，由真正的奇异物质制成，并经过抛光，发出眩目的光泽。 | keep | 异质六角镜阵眩亮全，专属反射错另卡。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:661；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:575；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:whip "snakebite" | <br>A double-ended whip made from the cured hides of black mambas, and enchanted<br>with toxins ranging from ordinary venoms to asphyxiating curare. | <br>一种由黑曼巴蛇的皮制成的双端鞭，附有从普通的毒液到令人窒息的箭毒碱毒素。 | keep | 双端黑曼巴皮鞭普通毒至窒息箭毒全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:261；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:226；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:woodcutter's axe | <br>A weapon that chops foes down as steadily and methodically as a forester cutting<br>wood. The unchanging rhythm of its work has settled on it with the force of<br>natural law, and no amount of force or skill can make it swing faster or slower. | <br>这把武器，能像伐木工砍伐树木一样有条不紊地砍倒敌人。<br>它的工作节奏一成不变，这是自然法则所决定的，<br>再强的力量或技能也无法使它挥动得更快或更慢。 | keep | 伐木斧定律节奏不论力量技艺快慢不可变全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:726；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:628；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:wrath of trog | <br>A bloodstained axe that was the favourite weapon of the old god Trog, before it<br>was lost. It induces a bloodthirsty berserker rage when used in battle, although<br>mere mortals who wield it will find themselves temporarily overwhelmed by Trog's<br>power. | <br>这把血迹斑斑的斧头在遗失之前，曾是古神特洛格最爱的武器。<br>当在战斗中使用它时，它会引发嗜血狂暴，<br>凡人哪怕只是装备它，暂时都会被特洛格的力量所压倒。 | keep | 特洛格战斧嗜血且凡人挥受神力压倒；中文哪怕只是装备是附加时机，但代码确实equip结束狂暴带慢疲惫，不因源mere mortals误删准确接口信息。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:15；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:15；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |
| body:unrand:zealot's sword | <br>A sword made of one huge piece of crystal. Legend says it was the Shining One's<br>gift to a worshipper. This blade is notorious for inducing bloodthirsty rage in<br>both the wielder and all of their followers. | <br>这把剑由一大块巨型水晶制成。传言是光辉者赐予其信徒的。<br>这把剑因在持用者及其所有追随者中引起嗜血的狂暴而臭名昭著。 | keep | 巨晶剑光辉者赐信徒、令己与全随从狂暴恶名全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/unrand.txt:170；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/unrand.txt:145；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408 |

| body:egos:archery (archery) armour ego | <br>It has one-third the normal encumbrance for the purpose of ranged combat, and<br>slightly increases ranged damage depending on the wearer's armour skill. | <br>进行远程战斗时，它的负重仅为正常值的三分之一，<br>并会根据穿戴者的护甲技能略微增加远程伤害。 | keep | 只对远程计算负重为1/3，并随护甲技能小幅增伤；非所有行动总负重降低。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:149；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:138；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849 |
| body:egos:atropa-tipped (atropa) missile ego | <br>It is tipped with a substance that causes blindness and brief confusion.<br><br>The chance of successfully applying its effect increases with your Throwing and<br>Stealth skill. | <br>它的尖端涂有一种能导致失明和短暂混乱的物质。<br><br>成功施加效果的概率随你的投掷和潜行技能提升。 | adjust | 失明、短暂混乱、投掷+潜行成功概率双技能完整；困惑状态词需改混乱。 已独立读取附属实际名称各形式；不是仅把正文键当显示名。 确认问题：confusion状态误为困惑 已修复 I-EGO-atropa-tipped-0：confusion状态误为困惑；处理：改短暂混乱。 正文关联显示形式：atropa-tipped→涂颠茄；atropa→颠茄。英文描述查找键保留。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:358；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:335；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849；dat/descript/egos.txt:atropa；docs/glossary.md:confusion |
| body:egos:attunement (attunement) armour ego | <br>When worn alongside a magical staff, it doubles the effectiveness of that<br>staff's primary enhancer and causes melee attacks made with it to restore a<br>small amount of MP. | <br>当与魔法杖一同穿戴时，它会使该法杖的主要增强效果加倍，<br>并使使用它进行的近战攻击恢复少量法力。 | keep | 同时持魔法杖才双倍主要增强、使用此杖近战回少量MP；指代在前句法杖明确。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:154；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:143；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849 |
| body:egos:chaos (chaos) missile ego | <br>When thrown, it has a random effect. | <br>投掷时，它会产生随机效果。 | keep | 投掷产生随机效果，未虚构每次同效。 已独立读取附属实际名称各形式；不是仅把正文键当显示名。 正文关联显示形式：chaos→混沌。英文描述查找键保留。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:365；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:341；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849 |
| body:egos:chaos (chaos) weapon ego | <br>Each hit from it has a different, random effect. | <br>它的每次命中都会产生不同的随机效果。 | adjust | 每次命中随机效果被写为每次攻击，误含未命中。 确认问题：每次命中被写成每次攻击，误含未命中 已修复 I-EGO-chaos-0：每次命中被写成每次攻击，误含未命中；处理：改每次命中。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:11；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:11；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849；attack.cc:apply_damage_brand |

| body:egos:command (command) armour ego | <br>It improves the power and success of your Summoning spells in proportion to your<br>Armour skill. | <br>它根据你的护甲技能比例提升你的召唤法术的威力和成功率。 | keep | 随护甲技能成比例提高召唤法术威力与成功率，两项都保留。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:164；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:152；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849 |
| body:egos:concussion (concuss) weapon ego | <br>It pushes those it hits backwards, briefly stunning them in the process. If a<br>solid feature prevents this, they instead take additional damage averaging<br>approximately three-eighths of any damage that pierces their armour. | <br>它会将命中的目标向后推开，并使其短暂眩晕。<br>若实体障碍阻止了这一过程，目标则会改为受到额外伤害，<br>其平均值约为穿透目标护甲伤害的八分之三。 | adjust | 击退+短暂stagger及撞实体障碍替代伤害两路；中文撞击地形关系错，当前源文1/3也与random2(damage_done)*3/4+1公式不一致。 确认问题：实体障碍碰撞写成推到坚固地形上，且没有替代关系；EN/ZH共同源文1/3伤害与当前random2(damage_done)*3/4+1不一致 已修复 I-EGO-concussion-0：实体障碍碰撞写成推到坚固地形上，且没有替代关系；处理：改无法推退而撞到实体障碍时，则改为额外受伤；同步核源数字。 已修复 I-EGO-concussion-1：EN/ZH共同源文1/3伤害与当前random2(damage_done)*3/4+1不一致；处理：由源文owner按当前公式明确附伤，平均约3/8并含取整；不擅改机制。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:15；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:15；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849；melee-attack.cc:662；melee-attack.cc:677 |
| body:egos:corrosion resistance (rcorr) armour ego | <br>It protects you from the effects of acid and corrosion. | <br>它可以保护你免受酸液和腐蚀的影响。 | keep | 保护对象酸液及腐蚀明确，不虚构完全免疫；数值由装备属性另列。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:169；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:156；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849 |
| body:egos:curare-tipped (curare) missile ego | <br>It is tipped with a substance that causes asphyxiation, dealing direct damage as<br>well as poisoning and slowing those it strikes.<br><br>It is twice as likely to be destroyed on impact as other darts. | <br>它的尖端涂有一种能导致窒息的物质，造成直接伤害，同时使被击中的目标<br>中毒和减速。<br><br>它在命中时被摧毁的概率是其他飞镖的两倍。 | keep | 窒息直接伤+中毒+减速与其他飞镖2倍毁坏概率四命题完整。 已独立读取附属实际名称各形式；不是仅把正文键当显示名。 正文关联显示形式：curare-tipped→涂箭毒；curare→箭毒。英文描述查找键保留。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:369；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:345；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849 |
| body:egos:datura-tipped (datura) missile ego | <br>It is tipped with a substance that sends those it hits into a mindless frenzy,<br>attacking friend and foe alike.<br><br>The chance of successfully applying its effect increases with your Throwing and<br>Stealth skill. | <br>它的尖端涂有一种能使被击中者陷入盲目狂乱的物质，使其不分敌友地攻击。<br><br>成功施加效果的概率随你的投掷和潜行技能提升。 | keep | 狂乱不分敌友，成功率依投掷与潜行；没有把frenzy误成普通berserk。 已独立读取附属实际名称各形式；不是仅把正文键当显示名。 正文关联显示形式：datura-tipped→涂曼陀罗；datura→曼陀罗。英文描述查找键保留。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:376；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:352；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849 |
| body:egos:death (death) armour ego | <br>It empowers your Necromancy spells and improves their success rate. When you<br>cast a Necromancy spell, it may drain the life force of susceptible adjacent<br>enemies to heal you; the chance and power of this effect depend on the spell's<br>level. | <br>它会增强你的死灵系法术并提高其成功率。<br>施放死灵系法术时，它可能从相邻且能受此效果影响的敌人身上汲取生命力来治疗你；<br>触发概率和效果强度取决于法术等级。 | keep | 死灵威力/成功增强、每次该系施法可能吸相邻易感敌治己、概率和强度随法术等级，完整。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:173；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:160；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849 |
| body:egos:devious (devious) weapon ego | <br>It has an increased chance to perform stab attacks against vulnerable targets,<br>and temporarily increases the wielder's EV and slaying each time they do so. | <br>它有更高的概率对脆弱的目标发动偷袭攻击，并在每次成功偷袭时暂时提升<br>使用者的闪避和杀戮值。 | keep | 易受偷袭目标更易刺杀、每次偷袭暂加EV/slaying，主体和持续时限齐全。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:27；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:25；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849 |
| body:egos:dexterity (dex+3) armour ego | <br>It increases your dexterity (Dex +3). | <br>它可以提升你的敏捷（敏捷 +3）。 | keep | 指定敏捷+3数值及对象完整。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:180；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:166；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849 |
| body:egos:disjunction (disjunct) missile ego | <br>It causes any target it hits to become temporarily untethered in space, blinking<br>away from you for several turns and taking minor damage each time it does so. | <br>它使被击中的目标暂时在空间中失去锚定，连续数回合向远离你的方向闪烁，<br>每次闪烁时受到少量伤害。 | keep | 暂时空间失锚、多回合向远处闪烁、每次少量伤，均对应。 已独立读取附属实际名称各形式；不是仅把正文键当显示名。 正文关联显示形式：disjunction→空间分离；disjunct→移位。英文描述查找键保留。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:384；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:358；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849 |
| body:egos:dispersal (disperse) missile ego | <br>It causes any target it hits to blink, with a tendency towards blinking further<br>away from you. | <br>它使被击中的目标进行闪烁，且倾向于向远离你的方向闪烁。 | keep | 命中使闪烁，倾向远离而非保证最远，情态保留。 已独立读取附属实际名称各形式；不是仅把正文键当显示名。 正文关联显示形式：dispersal→空间驱离；disperse→驱。英文描述查找键保留。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:389；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:363；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849 |
| body:egos:distortion (distort) weapon ego | <br>It warps and distorts space around it, and may blink, banish, or inflict extra<br>damage upon those it strikes. Unwielding it can teleport you to foes or banish<br>you to the Abyss. | <br>它扭曲并扰乱周围的空间，可能会使击中的目标闪烁、放逐或受到额外伤害。<br>卸下它时可能会将你传送到敌人身边或放逐到深渊。 | keep | 空间扭曲三可能命中效果及卸下传敌/深渊两后果齐全；may未变保证。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:21；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:20；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849 |

| body:egos:light (light) armour ego | <br>It surrounds you with a glowing halo, revealing invisible creatures, increasing<br>accuracy against all within it other than you, and reducing your stealth. | <br>它使你周围环绕着发光的光环，揭示隐形的生物，增加对光环内除你之外<br>所有生物的命中率，并降低你的潜行能力。 | keep | 光环揭隐形、对其中除己所有生物命中提高、潜行降，全部目标与例外保留。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:243；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:225；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849 |
| body:egos:mayhem (mayhem) armour ego | <br>It causes witnesses of your kills to go into a frenzy, attacking everything<br>nearby with great strength and speed. | <br>它使目睹你击杀的生物陷入狂乱，以巨大的力量和速度攻击附近的一切。 | keep | 目击杀敌者进入狂乱且更强更快不分敌友，未混为只增强玩家。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:248；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:230；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849 |
| body:egos:mesmerism (mesmerism) armour ego | <br>When you are struck in melee, it briefly dazes all nearby enemies, then must<br>recharge by standing still for a while. Its duration, radius, and recharge<br>speed are improved by your Evocations skill.<br><br>It goes briefly dormant whenever you enter a different floor. | <br>当你在近战中被击中时，它会短暂地使附近所有敌人眩晕，<br>之后需要通过静止不动一段时间来重新充能。<br>其持续时间、范围和充能速度随你的魔力释放技能提升而增加。<br><br>每当你进入不同楼层时，它都会暂时休眠。 | keep | 近战挨打触发邻敌daze、站定再充、祈魔释放升时长半径速度、换层暂休全保留。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:253；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:234；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849 |
| body:egos:pain (pain) weapon ego | <br>It inflicts extra damage on living creatures proportional to your Necromancy<br>skill.{{<br>    if you.god() == "Trog" then<br>        return " Trog prevents you from unleashing this effect.";<br>    end<br>}}{{<br>    if you.is_useless_skill("necromancy") then<br>        return " Your inability to study Necromancy prevents you from drawing on the full power of this weapon.";<br>    end<br>}} | <br>它对活着的生物造成与你的死灵系技能成比例的额外伤害。{{<br>    if you.god() == "Trog" then<br>        return "特洛格阻止你释放此效果。";<br>    end<br>}}{{<br>    if you.is_useless_skill("necromancy") then<br>        return "你无法学习死灵系，因此无法发挥这把武器的全部力量。";<br>    end<br>}} | keep | 仅活物、死灵技能比例；两Lua独立条件Trog与无用死灵技能均保留，返回句虽去空格中文标点连接正常。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:83；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:76；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849 |
| body:egos:parrying (parrying) armour ego | <br>It shields you if your last action was a melee attack. The shielding is half as<br>effective if your offhand is occupied by an item other than a weapon. | <br>如果你的上一个动作是近战攻击，它会为你提供护盾。如果你的副手拿着的<br>是除武器以外的物品，护盾效果将减半。 | keep | 上一动作近战才SH、副手非武器占用折半，条件对象完整。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:261；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:242；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849 |
| body:egos:penetration (penet) weapon ego | <br>Any ammunition fired by it continues flying after striking targets, potentially<br>hitting everything in its path until it leaves sight. | <br>从它发射的任何弹药在击中目标后会继续飞行，可能会穿透路径上的所有目标，<br>直到飞出视野。 | keep | 发射弹药击中继续飞，可能穿路径全目标直至出视野，未说保证命中全部。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:96；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:88；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849 |
| body:egos:poison resistance (rpois) armour ego | <br>It protects you from poison. | <br>它可以保护你免受毒素伤害。 | keep | 保护对象毒素明确，不虚构完全免疫；数值由装备属性另列。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:266；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:247；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849 |
| body:egos:poisoned (poison) missile ego | <br>It is coated with poison. | <br>它涂有毒药。 | adjust | 涂毒物质，对应毒弹药，未增恒中毒承诺。 已独立读取附属实际名称各形式；不是仅把正文键当显示名。 确认问题：正文自身已正确，但附属实际全名用T_(poisoned)得到中毒，组合为中毒飞镖，误称弹药自身中毒；本义是涂有毒药。 已修复 I-POISONED-MISSILE-NAME：正文自身已正确，但附属实际全名用T_(poisoned)得到中毒，组合为中毒飞镖，误称弹药自身中毒；本义是涂有毒药。；处理：使用导弹/弹药名称专用上下文将poisoned译淬毒/涂毒，保持其他poisoned状态中毒不变。。 正文关联显示形式：poisoned→涂毒；poison→毒素。英文描述查找键保留。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:394；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:367；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849；crawl-ref/source/item-name.cc:366；crawl-ref/source/item-name.cc:1824 |
| body:egos:ponderousness (ponderous) armour ego | <br>It is very cumbersome, slowing your movement. | <br>它非常笨重，会减慢你的移动速度。 | keep | 笨重只减移动速度，不扩大到所有行动速度。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:270；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:251；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849 |
| body:egos:positive energy (rn+) armour ego | <br>It protects you from the effects of negative energy. | <br>它可以保护你免受负能量的影响。 | keep | 保护对象负能量明确，不虚构完全免疫；数值由装备属性另列。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:274；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:255；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849 |
| body:egos:protection (ac+3) armour ego | <br>It protects you from most sources of damage (AC +3). | <br>它可以保护你免受大多数伤害来源（AC +3）。 | keep | AC3保护多数伤，句式可改抵御大多数来源的伤害但数值齐全。 本卡替代表达仅Suggestion，现译保留。 Suggestion I-EGO-protection-0 保留，未作强制修改：免受大多数伤害来源句式生硬。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:278；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:259；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849；dat/descript/egos.txt:protection |
| body:egos:protection (protect) weapon ego | <br>It grants you temporary protection after it strikes (+7 AC). | <br>它在击中目标后为你提供临时防护（+7 AC）。 | keep | 命中后暂+7AC，条件与时间均在。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:101；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:93；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849 |
| body:egos:pyromania (pyromania) armour ego | <br>It enhances your Fire magic and may unleash a blast of flames around you<br>whenever you kill an enemy by any means other than an attack. The explosion<br>chance and damage both scale with Evocations and it may trigger no more than<br>once each turn. | <br>它可以增强你的火焰魔法，并可能在你以攻击之外的任何方式击杀敌人时<br>在你周围释放火焰爆发。爆炸概率和伤害都随魔力释放技能提升，<br>每回合最多触发一次。 | keep | 火系增强、非攻击击杀概率周身爆炸、魔力释放概率伤害双加、每回合至多一次完整。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:282；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:263；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849 |
| body:egos:rampaging (rampage) armour ego | <br>It causes one to take an extra step when moving towards enemies, briefly<br>stunning them if this results in an attack. | <br>它使你在向敌人移动时可以多走一步，如果这导致了攻击，<br>会短暂地眩晕它们。 | keep | 向敌多一步导致攻击时短暂stun，移动触发和攻击限定完整。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:289；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:269；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849 |
| body:egos:reaping (reap) weapon ego | <br>Any living, holy, or demonic foe damaged by it may be temporarily reanimated<br>upon death as a friendly spectral, with an increasing chance as more damage is<br>dealt. | <br>任何被它伤害的活着的、神圣的或恶魔类的敌人，在死亡时可能会被暂时复活为<br>友好的幽灵，造成的伤害越多，概率越高。 | keep | 伤活物/神圣/恶魔，死后可能暂友spectral且伤越多概率越高，全部限定在。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:105；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:97；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849 |
| body:egos:rebuke (rebuke) weapon ego | <br>It shields the wearer if their last action was a melee attack (+10 SH) and<br>redirects blocked melee attacks to other nearby enemies. | <br>如果使用者的上一个动作是近战攻击，它会为穿戴者提供护盾（+10 SH），<br>并将格挡的近战攻击转向附近的其他敌人。 | keep | 上动作近战+10SH、格挡近战转给邻近敌人，未扩大远程转移。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:111；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:102；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849 |
| body:egos:reflection (reflect) armour ego | <br>It reflects blocked missile attacks. | <br>它可以反射被格挡的远程攻击。 | keep | 格挡是反射前提明确。远程攻击是本项目正文普通同义概括，建议窄成投射物但不因形式范围偏好阻挡。 本卡替代表达仅Suggestion，现译保留。 Suggestion I-EGO-reflection-0 保留，未作强制修改：missile扩成远程攻击，可能误含非投射物远程伤。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:294；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:274；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849；dat/descript/egos.txt:reflection |
| body:egos:repulsion (repulsion) armour ego | <br>It helps you evade both magical and non-magical projectiles (EV +15). | <br>它帮助你躲避魔法和非魔法投射物（EV +15）。 | keep | 魔法与非魔法投射物EV15都保留，不虚构绝对反射。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:298；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:278；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849 |
| body:egos:resistance (rc+ rf+) armour ego | <br>It protects you from the effects of both fire and cold. | <br>它可以保护你免受火焰和寒冷的伤害。 | keep | 火冷二抗，未多添电毒抗。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/egos.txt:302；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/egos.txt:282；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:1857–1869；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:2382；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:659–681,1194–1415；crawl-ref/source/melee-attack.cc:662–684,5084；crawl-ref/source/ranged-attack.cc:685–775；crawl-ref/source/beam.cc:2159；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6551；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:429–446,849 |

| body:cards:the shaft card | <br>The card depicts a traveller plummeting into a chasm that has opened beneath<br>them.<br><br>Drawing this card will create a shaft beneath the user, and possibly beneath<br>their enemies. | <br>这张牌上描绘着一名旅人跌入其下方的裂口。<br><br>抽出此牌会在使用者下方生成地洞，也有可能生成在敌人的脚下。 | defer terminology | 旅人掉裂口图、自身必有井敌也可能；只保留已移除卡正文，不让现有bug路径冒充旧效果。 延期理由：全文两语与所有可用条件已读，当前文字命题对应；但身份已移除/兼容，不把旧描述当现行正常玩法承诺，不作推测性重命名。 责任：parent / item lifecycle or compatibility restoration owner；重入：恢复此身份或明确要求覆盖其真实兼容暴露路径时重绑实现再审；此前保留本冻结中文。；保留值见中文列。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/cards.txt:28；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/cards.txt:26；crawl-ref/source/decks.h；crawl-ref/source/decks.cc:1085–1805；crawl-ref/source/spl-goditem.cc:660–810；crawl-ref/source/timed-effects.cc:852 |
| body:cards:the storm card | <br>The card depicts a ship at sea sinking in a thunderstorm.<br><br>Drawing this card unleashes a storm of wind and electrical discharges.<br>Increasing card power will result in a stronger wind force and stronger, more<br>numerous discharges. | <br>这张牌上描绘着在海上的雷暴中沉没的一艘船。<br><br>抽出此牌会释放风暴和电流。<br>增加牌的能量会生成更强的风和更强、更多的电流。 | keep | 海船雷暴沉没图、风电且随威力更强更多，风力及伤骰/爆数都核。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/cards.txt:56；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/cards.txt:52；crawl-ref/source/decks.h；crawl-ref/source/decks.cc:1085–1805；crawl-ref/source/spl-goditem.cc:660–810；crawl-ref/source/timed-effects.cc:852 |

| body:cards:the tomb card | <br>The card depicts a royal crypt, its entrance sealed by a heavy stone slab.<br><br>Drawing this card entombs its user in protective, temporary walls of solid rock.<br>At lower power levels or with adjacent creatures, the tomb may be imperfect.<br><br>The tomb is sustained by the presence of its creator within it, and moving from<br>the centre of the tomb will cause its walls to crumble away. | <br>这张牌上描绘着一个皇陵，其入口被沉重的石板密封。<br><br>抽出此牌会将使用者封入具有临时保护作用的坚硬的岩墙中。<br>在能量不高或有相邻生物时，这个墓可能有缺陷。<br><br>这个坟墓要有其创建者在内部维持，如果从坟墓中心离开，墙壁就会倒塌。 | keep | 王陵石封图、暂实体岩墙保护、低威力或邻生物不完美、离中心坍塌全三段保留。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/cards.txt:10；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/cards.txt:9；crawl-ref/source/decks.h；crawl-ref/source/decks.cc:1085–1805；crawl-ref/source/spl-goditem.cc:660–810；crawl-ref/source/timed-effects.cc:852 |
| body:cards:the wraith card | <br>The card depicts absolutely nothing.<br><br>Drawing this card will drain the user. | <br>这张牌上什么也没有。<br><br>抽出此牌会让使用者衰竭。 | keep | 全空白图、抽卡己衰竭，drain_player扣生命上限对应。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/cards.txt:143；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/cards.txt:128；crawl-ref/source/decks.h；crawl-ref/source/decks.cc:1085–1805；crawl-ref/source/spl-goditem.cc:660–810；crawl-ref/source/timed-effects.cc:852 |
| body:cards:torment card | <br>The card depicts a screaming figure being tortured on the rack.<br><br>Drawing this card will cause agonising injury to the user. | <br>这张牌上描绘着一个尖叫的人在架子上受到拷打。<br><br>抽出此牌会让使用者承受痛苦的伤害。 | keep | 刑架尖叫图、自伤痛苦，亡灵恶魔改holy_word实际避免按Torment免疫误说无伤。 | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/cards.txt:155；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/cards.txt:140；crawl-ref/source/decks.h；crawl-ref/source/decks.cc:1085–1805；crawl-ref/source/spl-goditem.cc:660–810；crawl-ref/source/timed-effects.cc:852 |
| body:cards:velocity card | <br>The card depicts an empty, well-worn pair of boots. | artefact-detail:UNRAND_BRILLIANCE:DESCRIP:0 | Umbra:     It surrounds you with an aura of shadow, increasing your stealth and making creatures within it harder to hit for attackers without night vision. | 被暗影笼罩: 它以暗影光环环绕你，提升你的潜行能力，并使缺乏夜视能力的攻击者更难击中光环内的生物。 | adjust | 逐句读取此实际显示段“Umbra:     It surrounds you with an aura of shadow, increasing your stealth and reducing the accuracy of all others within it.”和中文，连同同一DESCRIP/DBRAND组全部兄弟段核对象、条件、概率/数值、时限和例外。标签作为属性/能力简称独立判断；描述的限定与受事保留。 确认问题：EN/ZH称降低光环内所有其他生物命中不准确：命中修正在攻击者无nightvision且防御者处于umbra时发生；亡灵、Yred信徒及天生umbra者等不受该惩罚。 已修复 I-UMBRA-SCOPE：EN/ZH称降低光环内所有其他生物命中不准确：命中修正在攻击者无nightvision且防御者处于umbra时发生；亡灵、Yred信徒及天生umbra者等不受该惩罚。；处理：双方表述暗影提高自身潜行，并令缺乏夜视者更难击中处于暗影中的目标；保留夜视例外。。 | crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt:eveningstar "Brilliance"；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276；crawl-ref/source/monster.cc:6678；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:7692 |

| artefact-detail:UNRAND_SHADOWS:DESCRIP:0 | Umbra:     It surrounds you with an aura of shadow, increasing your stealth and making creatures within it harder to hit for attackers without night vision. | 被暗影笼罩: 它以暗影光环环绕你，提升你的潜行能力，并使缺乏夜视能力的攻击者更难击中光环内的生物。 | adjust | 逐句读取此实际显示段“Umbra:     It surrounds you with an aura of shadow, increasing your stealth and reducing the accuracy of all others within it.”和中文，连同同一DESCRIP/DBRAND组全部兄弟段核对象、条件、概率/数值、时限和例外。标签作为属性/能力简称独立判断；描述的限定与受事保留。 确认问题：EN/ZH称降低光环内所有其他生物命中不准确：命中修正在攻击者无nightvision且防御者处于umbra时发生；亡灵、Yred信徒及天生umbra者等不受该惩罚。 已修复 I-UMBRA-SCOPE：EN/ZH称降低光环内所有其他生物命中不准确：命中修正在攻击者无nightvision且防御者处于umbra时发生；亡灵、Yred信徒及天生umbra者等不受该惩罚。；处理：双方表述暗影提高自身潜行，并令缺乏夜视者更难击中处于暗影中的目标；保留夜视例外。。 | crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt:ring of Shadows；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276；crawl-ref/source/monster.cc:6678；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:7692 |

| artefact-detail:UNRAND_FIVE_VIRTUES:DESCRIP:0 | VirtueSH: It provides +5 SH for each of five conditions: You have at least 20 intelligence; at least 25 base EV; at least 15 base Invocations skill; at least +++++ stealth; your Staves skill is your highest skill, or is at the maximum skill level. | 五德格挡: 以下五项条件每满足一项，就提供+5护盾值：智力至少20；基础闪避至少25；基础祈神技能至少15；潜行至少+++++；棍杖技能是你最高的技能，或已达到最高等级。 | adjust | 逐句读取此实际显示段“VirtueSH: It provides +5 SH for each of five conditions: You have at least 20 intelligence; at least 25 base EV; at least 15 base Invocations skill; at least +++++ stealth; your Staves skill is your highest skill, or is at the maximum skill level.”和中文，连同同一DESCRIP/DBRAND组全部兄弟段核对象、条件、概率/数值、时限和例外。标签作为属性/能力简称独立判断；描述的限定与受事保留。 player.cc:10006五判据与6200至少三项多一次格挡；并列最高技能依best_skill技能顺序选择，不擅改实现。 确认问题：Invocations技能名祈神误为祈祷，五项判据中的一项必须准确。 已修复 I-VIRTUES-INVO：Invocations技能名祈神误为祈祷，五项判据中的一项必须准确。；处理：基础祈神技能至少15；其余四条件保留。。 | crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt:staff of Five Virtues；crawl-ref/source/describe.cc:885；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:1899；crawl-ref/source/art-data.txt；crawl-ref/source/art-func.h:93–1970；crawl-ref/source/util/art-data.pl:305–323；crawl-ref/source/item-prop.cc:3850；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:6200,7692,10006；crawl-ref/source/player-equip.cc:134,541,2431；crawl-ref/source/spl-cast.cc:695–714,849–884；crawl-ref/source/attack.cc:276,1285–1315；crawl-ref/source/ouch.cc:1408；crawl-ref/source/player.cc:10006 |

### 生成与保存边界
随机神器/书名在生成时存为显示快照，旧名字不回译；@branch_name@仅翻译有限分支显示值，实际branch身份不变。普通单学派owner键修复空格，主题书名和非佐姆神赠恩宠采用完整位置参数context。DESC_DBNAME绕过随机名，但普通物品基名仍可能随语言变化，只有既有英文guard/专用英文accessor可证明规范英文；本批不改全局DBNAME。Gizmo保存规范选择recipe并无RNG重放当前语言；当前生产recipe闭包不含colourname，补齐杂色池不是修复已存颜色ordinal。monname姓名与DBNAME分离，RANDGEN不等于待译英文模板。
